verses.sanskrit: सर्ववेदान्तसिद्धान्तगोचरं तमगोचरम् । गोविन्दं परमानन्दं सद्गुरुं प्रणतोऽस्म्यहम्
verses.transliteration: sarvavedāntasiddhāntagocaraṃ tamagocaram | govindaṃ paramānandaṃ sadguruṃ praṇato'smyaham
verses.translation: I bow to Govinda, the supreme bliss, the true teacher, who is the goal of the conclusions of all the Vedanta, yet beyond the reach of the senses.
verses.hindi: समस्त वेदान्त-सिद्धान्तों के परम लक्ष्य, इन्द्रियों से अगोचर, परमानन्द-स्वरूप सद्गुरु श्रीगोविन्द (सच्चिदानन्द परमात्मा) को मैं सादर प्रणाम करता हूँ।

verses.sanskrit: जन्तूनां नरजन्म दुर्लभमतः पुंस्त्वं ततो विप्रता तस्माद्वैदिकधर्ममार्गपरता विद्वत्त्वमस्मात्परम् । आत्मानात्मविवेचनं स्वनुभवो ब्रह्मात्मना संस्थितिः मुक्तिर्नो शतजन्मकोटिसुकृतैः पुण्यैर्विना लभ्यते
verses.transliteration: jantūnāṃ narajanma durlabhamataḥ puṃstvaṃ tato vipratā tasmādvaidikadharmamārgaparatā vidvattvamasmātparam | ātmānātmavivecanaṃ svanubhavo brahmātmanā saṃsthitiḥ muktirno śatajanmakoṭisukṛtaiḥ puṇyairvinā labhyate
verses.translation: Among all beings, human birth is rare; rarer still is full human development; rarer is commitment to the path of dharma; rarest of all is wisdom.
verses.hindi: सभी प्राणियों में मनुष्य जन्म दुर्लभ है; उससे भी दुर्लभ है पूर्ण पुरुषत्व; उससे भी दुर्लभ है वैदिक धर्म में निष्ठा; और उससे भी दुर्लभ है वास्तविक तत्त्व-विद्वत्ता। आत्मा और अनात्मा का यथार्थ विवेक, आत्मानुभूति और ब्रह्मरूप में स्थिति—यह मुक्ति करोड़ों जन्मों के संचित पुण्यों के बिना प्राप्त नहीं होती।
verses.wordMeaning: Shankara opens with a ladder of rarity: existence → human existence → full development → ethical commitment → wisdom. The rarest of all gifts is not wealth, health, or talent — it is viveka: discriminative wisdom. This verse is a call to urgency.
verses.explanation: Shankara opens with a ladder of rarity: existence → human existence → full development → ethical commitment → wisdom. The rarest of all gifts is not wealth, health, or talent — it is viveka: discriminative wisdom. This verse is a call to urgency.
verses.commentary: Shankara opens with a ladder of rarity: existence → human existence → full development → ethical commitment → wisdom. The rarest of all gifts is not wealth, health, or talent — it is viveka: discriminative wisdom. This verse is a call to urgency.
verses.science: सभी प्राणियों में मनुष्य जन्म दुर्लभ है; उससे भी दुर्लभ है पूर्ण पुरुषत्व; उससे भी दुर्लभ है वैदिक धर्म में श्रद्धा; और उससे भी दुर्लभ है विद्वत्ता (वास्तविक…। धीमी श्वास वेगस तंत्रिका को सक्रिय कर भय-प्रतिक्रिया को शांत करती है। यह पंक्ति उसी श्वास और मन के संबंध को कहती है।

verses.sanskrit: दुर्लभं त्रयमेवैतद्देवानुग्रहहेतुकम् । मनुष्यत्वं मुमुक्षुत्वं महापुरुषसंश्रयः
verses.transliteration: durlabhaṃ trayamevaitaddevānugrahahetukam | manuṣyatvaṃ mumukṣutvaṃ mahāpuruṣasaṃśrayaḥ
verses.translation: Three things are rare and come only by the grace of God: human birth, the desire for liberation, and the company of a great teacher.
verses.hindi: तीन चीजें अत्यंत दुर्लभ हैं और केवल ईश्वर की विशेष कृपा से प्राप्त होती हैं: मनुष्य जन्म, मुमुक्षुत्व (मोक्ष की तीव्र अभीप्सा), और ब्रह्मनिष्ठ महापुरुष का संश्रय।
verses.wordMeaning: Shankara identifies three essential ingredients for spiritual transformation: the instrument (human birth), the motivation (genuine desire for liberation — not temporary enthusiasm but sustained yearning), and the method (guidance from an authentic teacher). All three must be present. Intelligence without genuine seeking produces mere scholarship.
verses.explanation: Shankara identifies three essential ingredients for spiritual transformation: the instrument (human birth), the motivation (genuine desire for liberation — not temporary enthusiasm but sustained yearning), and the method (guidance from an authentic teacher). All three must be present. Intelligence without genuine seeking produces mere scholarship.
verses.commentary: Shankara identifies three essential ingredients for spiritual transformation: the instrument (human birth), the motivation (genuine desire for liberation — not temporary enthusiasm but sustained yearning), and the method (guidance from an authentic teacher). All three must be present. Intelligence without genuine seeking produces mere scholarship.
verses.science: तीन चीजें बड़ी दुर्लभ हैं और ईश्वर की कृपा से मिलती हैं: मनुष्य जन्म, मुमुक्षुत्व (मोक्ष की इच्छा), और महापुरुष का संग। जो विषय बार-बार मन में आता है, वही अगली क्रिया की दिशा बनता है। यह पंक्ति उसी मानसिक चयन को अपना विषय बनाती है।

verses.sanskrit: लब्ध्वा कथञ्चिन्नरजन्म दुर्लभं तत्रापि पुंस्त्वं श्रुतिपारदर्शनम् । यस्त्वात्ममुक्तौ न यतेत मूढधीः स ह्यात्महा स्वं विनिहन्त्यसद्ग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: labdhvā kathañcinnarajanma durlabhaṃ tatrāpi puṃstvaṃ śrutipāradarśanam | yastvātmamuktau na yateta mūḍhadhīḥ sa hyātmahā svaṃ vinihantyasadgrahāt
verses.translation: Having somehow gained a human birth, so hard to get, and in it manhood and thorough learning in the scriptures — the fool who does not strive for liberation of the Self kills himself by clinging to what is unreal.
verses.hindi: किसी प्रकार दुर्लभ मनुष्य जन्म पाकर और उसमें भी पौरुष तथा शास्त्रों का अध्ययन प्राप्त करके भी जो मूढ़बुद्धि आत्म-मुक्ति के लिए यत्न नहीं करता, वह आत्मघाती है और असत् में आसक्त होकर अपना ही हनन करता है।

verses.sanskrit: इतः को न्वस्ति मूढात्मा यस्तु स्वार्थे प्रमाद्यति । दुर्लभं मानुषं देहं प्राप्य तत्रापि पौरुषम्
verses.transliteration: itaḥ ko nvasti mūḍhātmā yastu svārthe pramādyati | durlabhaṃ mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ prāpya tatrāpi pauruṣam
verses.translation: Who then is more foolish than one who is careless of his own good, having obtained this rare human body and in it manhood?
verses.hindi: इस दुर्लभ मानव शरीर और सामर्थ्य को प्राप्त करके भी जो अपने परम कल्याण में प्रमाद करता है, उससे बढ़कर मूढ़ात्मा इस संसार में और कौन होगा?

verses.sanskrit: वदन्तु शास्त्राणि यजन्तु देवान् कुर्वन्तु कर्माणि भजन्तु देवताः । आत्मैक्यबोधेन विनापि मुक्तिर्न सिध्यति ब्रह्मशतान्तरेऽपि
verses.transliteration: vadantu śāstrāṇi yajantu devān kurvantu karmāṇi bhajantu devatāḥ | ātmaikyabodhena vināpi muktirna sidhyati brahmaśatāntare'pi
verses.translation: Let them recite the scriptures, worship the gods, perform rites, and pray to the deities — without the knowledge of the oneness of the Self, liberation is not attained even in a hundred Brahma-lifetimes.
verses.hindi: भले ही लोग शास्त्रों का व्याख्यान करें, यज्ञ करें, विविध कर्म करें और देवताओं की उपासना करें—किन्तु आत्मा की एकता के बोध के बिना सौ ब्रह्म-कल्पों में भी मुक्ति सिद्ध नहीं होती।

verses.sanskrit: अमृतत्त्वस्य नाशास्ति वित्तेनेत्येव हि श्रुतिः । ब्रवीति कर्मणो मुक्तेरहेतुत्वं स्फुटं यतः
verses.transliteration: amṛtattvasya nāśāsti vittenetyeva hi śrutiḥ | bravīti karmaṇo mukterahetutvaṃ sphuṭaṃ yataḥ
verses.translation: "There is no hope of immortality through wealth," says the scripture, clearly showing that works are no cause of liberation.
verses.hindi: ‘धन से अमरत्व की आशा नहीं है’—श्रुति का यह वचन स्पष्ट उद्घोष करता है कि सकाम कर्म मोक्ष का हेतु नहीं हो सकते।

verses.sanskrit: अतो विमुक्त्यै प्रयतेत विद्वान् सन्न्यस्तबाह्यार्थसुखस्पृहः सन् । सन्तं महान्तं समुपेत्य देशिकं तेनोपदिष्टार्थसमाहितात्मा
verses.transliteration: ato vimuktyai prayateta vidvān sannyastabāhyārthasukhaspṛhaḥ san | santaṃ mahāntaṃ samupetya deśikaṃ tenopadiṣṭārthasamāhitātmā
verses.translation: Therefore the wise man should strive for liberation, having renounced the desire for pleasure in outer objects; approaching a good and great teacher, and with his mind concentrated on the meaning taught by him,
verses.hindi: अतः विद्वान् पुरुष बाह्य विषयों के सुख की स्पृहा त्यागकर, शांत व महान् सद्गुरु की शरण में जाकर, उनके द्वारा उपदेशित अर्थ में चित्त एकाग्र करके मुक्ति के लिए यत्न करे।

verses.sanskrit: उद्धरेदात्मनाऽऽत्मानं मग्नं संसारवारिधौ । योगारूढत्वमासाद्य सम्यग्दर्शननिष्ठया
verses.transliteration: uddharedātmanā''tmānaṃ magnaṃ saṃsāravāridhau | yogārūḍhatvamāsādya samyagdarśananiṣṭhayā
verses.translation: let him lift up his self by the Self, sunk in the ocean of worldly existence, by attaining steadfastness in yoga and devotion to right vision.
verses.hindi: संसार-सागर में डूबे हुए अपने-आपको अपनी ही आत्मा द्वारा, सम्यग्दर्शन (यथार्थ ज्ञान) की निष्ठा से योगारूढ़ होकर उबारे।

verses.sanskrit: सन्न्यस्य सर्वकर्माणि भवबन्धविमुक्तये । यत्यतां पण्डितैर्धीरैरात्माभ्यास उपस्थितैः
verses.transliteration: sannyasya sarvakarmāṇi bhavabandhavimuktaye | yatyatāṃ paṇḍitairdhīrairātmābhyāsa upasthitaiḥ
verses.translation: Renouncing all works, for release from the bonds of worldly existence, let the wise and steadfast strive, devoted to the practice of the Self.
verses.hindi: संसार-बंधन से मुक्ति के लिए समस्त सकाम कर्मों का संन्यास करके, आत्म-साधना में तत्पर धीर और पंडित जन पूर्ण यत्न करें।

verses.sanskrit: चित्तस्य शुद्धये कर्म न तु वस्तूपलब्धये । वस्तुसिद्धिर्विचारेण न किञ्चित्कर्मकोटिभिः
verses.transliteration: cittasya śuddhaye karma na tu vastūpalabdhaye | vastusiddhirvicāreṇa na kiñcitkarmakoṭibhiḥ
verses.translation: Work is for the purification of the mind, not for the perception of the Reality; the Reality is established by inquiry, not even a little by crores of works.
verses.hindi: कर्म केवल चित्त की शुद्धि के लिए है, आत्म-वस्तु की उपलब्धि के लिए नहीं। तत्त्व-वस्तु की सिद्धि तो यथार्थ विचार से होती है, करोड़ों कर्मों से भी लेशमात्र नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: सम्यग्विचारतः सिद्धा रज्जुतत्त्वावधारणा । भ्रान्तोदितमहासर्पभयदुःखविनाशिनी
verses.transliteration: samyagvicārataḥ siddhā rajjutattvāvadhāraṇā | bhrāntoditamahāsarpabhayaduḥkhavināśinī
verses.translation: The ascertainment of the truth of the rope is accomplished by right inquiry, and it destroys the fear and pain caused by the great snake that arose from delusion.
verses.hindi: सम्यक् विचार से रज्जु (रस्सी) के यथार्थ स्वरूप का निश्चय होता है, जो भ्रमवश उत्पन्न हुए महासर्प के भय और दुःख का समूल विनाश कर देता है।

verses.sanskrit: भ्रान्त्यो अर्थस्य निश्चयो दृष्टो विचारेण हितोक्तितः । न स्नानेन न दानेन प्राणायामशतेन वा
verses.transliteration: bhrāntyo arthasya niścayo dṛṣṭo vicāreṇa hitoktitaḥ | na snānena na dānena prāṇāyāmaśatena vā
verses.translation: The determination of a matter is seen to come through inquiry and wholesome advice — not by bathing, nor by giving, nor by a hundred breath-controls.
verses.hindi: वस्तु के यथार्थ रूप का निश्चय विचार और हितोपदेश से ही होता है—न स्नान से, न दान से और न सैकड़ों प्राणायामों से।

verses.sanskrit: अधिकारिणमाशास्ते फलसिद्धिर्विशेषतः । उपाया देशकालाद्याः सन्त्यस्मिन्सहकारिणः
verses.transliteration: adhikāriṇamāśāste phalasiddhirviśeṣataḥ | upāyā deśakālādyāḥ santyasminsahakāriṇaḥ
verses.translation: The attainment of the fruit especially requires one who is qualified; place, time and the like are the helpers in this.
verses.hindi: फल की सिद्धि विशेष रूप से अधिकारी पर निर्भर करती है; देश, काल आदि तो इसमें केवल सहायक कारण हैं।

verses.sanskrit: सन्त्यस्यां अतो विचारः कर्तव्यो जिज्ञासोरात्मवस्तुनः ॥ समासाद्य दयासिन्धुं गुरुं ब्रह्मविदुत्तमम्
verses.transliteration: santyasyāṃ ato vicāraḥ kartavyo jijñāsorātmavastunaḥ || samāsādya dayāsindhuṃ guruṃ brahmaviduttamam
verses.translation: Therefore inquiry into the reality of the Self is to be made by the seeker, approaching a teacher who is an ocean of compassion and the best of the knowers of Brahman.
verses.hindi: अतः आत्म-तत्त्व के जिज्ञासु को दया के सागर, ब्रह्मविदों में श्रेष्ठ सद्गुरु की शरण में जाकर तत्त्व का विचार करना चाहिए।

verses.sanskrit: मेधावी पुरुषो विद्वानूहापोहविचक्षणः । अधिकार्यात्मविद्यायामुक्तलक्षणलक्षितः
verses.transliteration: medhāvī puruṣo vidvānūhāpohavicakṣaṇaḥ | adhikāryātmavidyāyāmuktalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ
verses.translation: A person who is intelligent, learned, skilled in argument and counter-argument, and marked by the characteristics stated, is qualified for the knowledge of the Self.
verses.hindi: जो मेधावी, विद्वान् तथा तर्क-वितर्क (ऊहापोह) में निपुण हो, वही आत्म-विद्या का यथार्थ अधिकारी माना गया है।

verses.sanskrit: विवेकिनो विरक्तस्य शमादिगुणशालिनः । मुमुक्षोरेव हि ब्रह्मजिज्ञासायोग्यता मता
verses.transliteration: vivekino viraktasya śamādiguṇaśālinaḥ | mumukṣoreva hi brahmajijñāsāyogyatā matā
verses.translation: One who is discriminating, dispassionate, endowed with the qualities beginning with calmness, and who longs for liberation alone, is considered fit for the inquiry into Brahman.
verses.hindi: जो विवेकी, विरक्त, शम-दमादि गुणों से सम्पन्न और केवल मोक्ष का अभिलाषी हो, वही ब्रह्मजिज्ञासा का सच्चा पात्र है।

verses.sanskrit: साधनान्यत्र चत्वारि कथितानि मनीषिभिः । येषु सत्स्वेव सन्निष्ठा यदभावे न सिध्यति
verses.transliteration: sādhanānyatra catvāri kathitāni manīṣibhiḥ | yeṣu satsveva sanniṣṭhā yadabhāve na sidhyati
verses.translation: Four means have been named here by the wise: only when they exist is steadfastness possible, and in their absence it is not accomplished.
verses.hindi: विद्वानों ने यहाँ साधन-चतुष्टय कहे हैं; जिनके होने पर ही सत्य में निष्ठा होती है और जिनके अभाव में वह सिद्ध नहीं होती।

verses.sanskrit: आदौ नित्यानित्यवस्तुविवेकः परिगण्यते । इहामुत्रफलभोगविरागस्तदनन्तरम् । शमादिषट्कसम्पत्तिर्मुमुक्षुत्वमिति स्फुटम्
verses.transliteration: ādau nityānityavastuvivekaḥ parigaṇyate | ihāmutraphalabhogavirāgastadanantaram | śamādiṣaṭkasampattirmumukṣutvamiti sphuṭam
verses.translation: First is reckoned the discrimination between the eternal and the non-eternal; then dispassion for enjoying results here and hereafter; then the six-fold wealth beginning with calmness; and the longing for liberation — clearly so.
verses.hindi: प्रथम साधन ‘नित्यानित्य-वस्तु-विवेक’ है; उसके पश्चात् इहलोक और परलोक के भोगों से विराग; फिर शम-दमादि षट्-सम्पत्ति; और उसके बाद मुमुक्षुत्व स्पष्ट रूप से गिना जाता है।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्म सत्यं जगन्मिथ्येत्येवंरूपो विनिश्चयः । सोऽयं नित्यानित्यवस्तुविवेकः समुदाहृतः
verses.transliteration: brahma satyaṃ jaganmithyetyevaṃrūpo viniścayaḥ | so'yaṃ nityānityavastuvivekaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ
verses.translation: The firm conviction "Brahman is real, the world is unreal" — this is called the discrimination between the eternal and the non-eternal.
verses.hindi: ‘ब्रह्म ही सत्य है और जगत् मिथ्या (परिवर्तनशील आभास) है’—इस प्रकार का दृढ़ निश्चय ही ‘नित्यानित्य-वस्तु-विवेक’ कहा गया है।

verses.sanskrit: तद्वैराग्यं जिहासा या दर्शनश्रवणादिभिः । जुगुप्सा या देहादिब्रह्मपर्यन्ते ह्यनित्ये भोगवस्तुनि
verses.transliteration: tadvairāgyaṃ jihāsā yā darśanaśravaṇādibhiḥ | jugupsā yā dehādibrahmaparyante hyanitye bhogavastuni
verses.translation: That is dispassion: the desire to give up, arising from seeing, hearing and the like, and revulsion toward all perishable objects of enjoyment from the body up to Brahma's world.
verses.hindi: दृष्ट और श्रुत विषयों में दोष देखकर, देह से लेकर ब्रह्मलोक पर्यन्त समस्त अनित्य भोग-वस्तुओं के प्रति जो विरक्ति और त्याग की इच्छा होती है, वह वैराग्य है।

verses.sanskrit: भोग्यवस्तुनि विरज्य विषयव्राताद्दोषदृष्ट्या मुहुर्मुहुः । स्वलक्ष्ये नियतावस्था मनसः शम उच्यते
verses.transliteration: bhogyavastuni virajya viṣayavrātāddoṣadṛṣṭyā muhurmuhuḥ | svalakṣye niyatāvasthā manasaḥ śama ucyate
verses.translation: Having turned away from the multitude of objects of enjoyment by repeatedly seeing their faults, the mind's steady abiding on its own goal is called calmness (shama).
verses.hindi: भोग्य विषयों के समूह से बार-बार दोष-दृष्टि के द्वारा विरक्त होकर, मन का अपने लक्ष्य (परमात्मा) में स्थिर रहना ही ‘शम’ कहलाता है।

verses.sanskrit: विषयेभ्यः परावर्त्य स्थापनं स्वस्वगोलके । उभयेषामिन्द्रियाणां स दमः परिकीर्तितः । बाह्यानालम्बनं वृत्तेरेषोपरतिरुत्तमा
verses.transliteration: viṣayebhyaḥ parāvartya sthāpanaṃ svasvagolake | ubhayeṣāmindriyāṇāṃ sa damaḥ parikīrtitaḥ | bāhyānālambanaṃ vṛttereṣoparatiruttamā
verses.translation: Turning both kinds of senses away from their objects and placing them in their own seats is called self-control (dama); the mind's not depending on external things is the highest withdrawal (uparati).
verses.hindi: दोनों प्रकार की इन्द्रियों (ज्ञानेन्द्रिय व कर्मेन्द्रिय) को उनके विषयों से हटाकर उनके अपने स्थानों में स्थापित करना ‘दम’ कहलाता है; और चित्त-वृत्ति का बाह्य आलंबन न लेना उत्तम ‘उपरति’ है।

verses.sanskrit: सहनं सर्वदुःखानामप्रतीकारपूर्वकम् । चिन्ताविलापरहितं सा तितिक्षा निगद्यते
verses.transliteration: sahanaṃ sarvaduḥkhānāmapratīkārapūrvakam | cintāvilāparahitaṃ sā titikṣā nigadyate
verses.translation: Bearing all sorrows without seeking to redress them, and free from worry and lament — this is called forbearance (titiksha).
verses.hindi: बिना किसी प्रतिकार की इच्छा के, तथा चिंता और विलाप से रहित होकर समस्त दुःखों को समभाव से सहना ‘तितिक्षा’ कही जाती है।

verses.sanskrit: शास्त्रस्य गुरुवाक्यस्य सत्यबुद्ध्यवधारणम् । सत्यबुद्ध्यावधारणा सा श्रद्धा कथिता सद्भिर्यया वस्तूपलभ्यते
verses.transliteration: śāstrasya guruvākyasya satyabuddhyavadhāraṇam | satyabuddhyāvadhāraṇā sā śraddhā kathitā sadbhiryayā vastūpalabhyate
verses.translation: Firm acceptance, as true, of what the scriptures and the teacher say — this the good call faith (shraddha), by which the Reality is attained.
verses.hindi: शास्त्र और गुरु के वचनों को यथार्थ सत्य रूप में दृढ़ता से धारण करना ‘श्रद्धा’ है, जिससे परम तत्त्व की उपलब्धि होती है।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वदा स्थापनं बुद्धेः शुद्धे ब्रह्मणि सर्वदा । सम्यगास्थापनं तत्समाधानमित्युक्तं न तु चित्तस्य लालनम्
verses.transliteration: sarvadā sthāpanaṃ buddheḥ śuddhe brahmaṇi sarvadā | samyagāsthāpanaṃ tatsamādhānamityuktaṃ na tu cittasya lālanam
verses.translation: Constant, right placing of the intellect on pure Brahman is called concentration (samadhana), not the indulging of the mind.
verses.hindi: अपनी बुद्धि को सदा शुद्ध ब्रह्म में सम्यक् प्रकार से स्थापित रखना ‘समाधान’ कहलाता है, मन का स्वेच्छाचारी लाड़-प्यार नहीं।

verses.sanskrit: अहङ्कारादिदेहान्तान् बन्धानज्ञानकल्पितान् । स्वस्वरूपावबोधेन मोक्तुमिच्छा मुमुक्षुता
verses.transliteration: ahaṅkārādidehāntān bandhānajñānakalpitān | svasvarūpāvabodhena moktumicchā mumukṣutā
verses.translation: The wish to free oneself, through knowledge of one's own nature, from the bonds — from ego down to the body — that are imagined through ignorance, is the longing for liberation (mumukshuta).
verses.hindi: अहंकार से लेकर स्थूल देह पर्यन्त अज्ञान-कल्पित बंधनों से अपने आत्मस्वरूप के बोध द्वारा मुक्त होने की तीव्र इच्छा ‘मुमुक्षुता’ है।

verses.sanskrit: मन्दमध्यमरूपापि वैराग्येण शमादिना । प्रसादेन गुरोः सेयं प्रवृद्धा सूयते फलम्
verses.transliteration: mandamadhyamarūpāpi vairāgyeṇa śamādinā | prasādena guroḥ seyaṃ pravṛddhā sūyate phalam
verses.translation: Even if weak or moderate, this (longing), strengthened by dispassion, calmness and the like and by the teacher's grace, bears fruit.
verses.hindi: यह मुमुक्षुता मंद या मध्यम होने पर भी वैराग्य, शम आदि और गुरु की कृपा से पुष्ट होकर फल देती है।

verses.sanskrit: वैराग्यं च मुमुक्षुत्वं तीव्रं यस्य तु विद्यते । तस्मिन्नेवार्थवन्तः स्युः फलवन्तः शमादयः
verses.transliteration: vairāgyaṃ ca mumukṣutvaṃ tīvraṃ yasya tu vidyate | tasminnevārthavantaḥ syuḥ phalavantaḥ śamādayaḥ
verses.translation: In one in whom dispassion and the longing for liberation are intense, calmness and the rest become meaningful and fruitful.
verses.hindi: जिसमें वैराग्य और मुमुक्षुत्व दोनों तीव्र होते हैं, उसी में शम आदि साधन अर्थवान् और फलदायी सिद्ध होते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: एतयोर्मन्दता यत्र विरक्तत्वमुमुक्षयोः । मरौ सलिलवत्तत्र शमादेर्भानमात्रता
verses.transliteration: etayormandatā yatra viraktatvamumukṣayoḥ | marau salilavattatra śamāderbhānamātratā
verses.translation: Where these two — dispassion and longing for liberation — are weak, calmness and the rest are a mere appearance, like water in a desert.
verses.hindi: जहाँ वैराग्य और मुमुक्षुत्व मंद होते हैं, वहाँ शम आदि साधन मरुस्थल में मृगमरीचिका के जल के समान केवल नाममात्र के प्रतीत होते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षकारणसामग्र्यां भक्तिरेव गरीयसी । स्वस्वरूपानुसन्धानं भक्तिरित्यभिधीयते
verses.transliteration: mokṣakāraṇasāmagryāṃ bhaktireva garīyasī | svasvarūpānusandhānaṃ bhaktirityabhidhīyate
verses.translation: Among the means to liberation devotion is greatest; the constant seeking of one's own true nature is called devotion.
verses.hindi: मोक्ष के समस्त साधनों में भक्ति ही सबसे श्रेष्ठ है; अपने निज वास्तविक स्वरूप का निरंतर अनुसंधान (चिंतन) करना ही भक्ति कहलाता है।

verses.sanskrit: स्वात्मतत्त्वानुसन्धानं भक्तिरित्यपरे जगुः । उक्तसाधनसम्पन्नस्तत्त्वजिज्ञासुरात्मनः । उपसीदेद्गुरुं प्राज्ञं यस्माद्बन्धविमोक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: svātmatattvānusandhānaṃ bhaktirityapare jaguḥ | uktasādhanasampannastattvajijñāsurātmanaḥ | upasīdedguruṃ prājñaṃ yasmādbandhavimokṣaṇam
verses.translation: Others say that devotion is the seeking of the truth of one's own Self. One who is endowed with the means described, and who wishes to know the truth of the Self, should approach a wise teacher, from whom release from bondage comes.
verses.hindi: दूसरे आचार्यों का कथन है कि अपने आत्म-तत्त्व का अनुसंधान ही भक्ति है। साधन-सम्पन्न जिज्ञासु को ऐसे ज्ञानी गुरु के समीप जाना चाहिए जो बंधन से मुक्त कराने में समर्थ हों।

verses.sanskrit: श्रोत्रियोऽवृजिनोऽकामहतो यो ब्रह्मवित्तमः । ब्रह्मण्युपरतः शान्तो निरिन्धन इवानलः । अहेतुकदयासिन्धुर्बन्धुरानमतां सताम्
verses.transliteration: śrotriyo'vṛjino'kāmahato yo brahmavittamaḥ | brahmaṇyuparataḥ śānto nirindhana ivānalaḥ | ahetukadayāsindhurbandhurānamatāṃ satām
verses.translation: (Such a teacher is) one learned in the Vedas, sinless, unstruck by desire, the best of the knowers of Brahman, resting in Brahman, tranquil like a fire without fuel, an ocean of causeless compassion, a friend of the good who bow to him.
verses.hindi: वे सद्गुरु श्रोत्रिय (वेदों के मर्मज्ञ), निष्पाप, कामना-रहित, ब्रह्मविदों में श्रेष्ठ, ब्रह्म में लीन, ईंधन-रहित अग्नि की भाँति शांत, अकारण दया के सागर और शरणागतों के परम सखा होते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: तमाराध्य गुरुं भक्त्या प्रह्वप्रश्रयसेवनैः । प्रह्वः प्रसन्नं तमनुप्राप्य पृच्छेज्ज्ञातव्यमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: tamārādhya guruṃ bhaktyā prahvapraśrayasevanaiḥ | prahvaḥ prasannaṃ tamanuprāpya pṛcchejjñātavyamātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Having worshipped that teacher with devotion, by humility, respect and service, and having approached him when he is pleased, let him ask what is to be known of the Self.
verses.hindi: उन गुरु की भक्ति, विनम्रता और सेवा द्वारा आराधना करके, जब वे प्रसन्न हों, तब उनसे आत्म-ज्ञान के विषय में पूछना चाहिए।

verses.sanskrit: स्वामिन्नमस्ते नतलोकबन्धो कारुण्यसिन्धो पतितं भवाब्धौ । मामुद्धरात्मीयकटाक्षदृष्ट्या ऋज्व्यातिकारुण्यसुधाभिवृष्ट्या
verses.transliteration: svāminnamaste natalokabandho kāruṇyasindho patitaṃ bhavābdhau | māmuddharātmīyakaṭākṣadṛṣṭyā ṛjvyātikāruṇyasudhābhivṛṣṭyā
verses.translation: "Master, homage to you, friend of those who bow, ocean of compassion — I have fallen into the sea of worldly existence. Lift me up with your own glance, showering the nectar of your straight and great compassion."
verses.hindi: शिष्य प्रार्थना करता है: ‘हे स्वामिन्! हे शरणागत-वत्सल! हे करुणा-सिन्धु! आपको नमस्कार है। इस संसार-सागर में गिरे हुए मेरा अपनी कृपा-कटाक्ष की अमृतमयी वर्षा से उद्धार कीजिए।’

verses.sanskrit: दुर्वारसंसारदवाग्नितप्तं दोधूयमानं दुरदृष्टवातैः । भीतं प्रपन्नं परिपाहि मृत्योः शरण्यमन्यद्यदहं न जाने
verses.transliteration: durvārasaṃsāradavāgnitaptaṃ dodhūyamānaṃ duradṛṣṭavātaiḥ | bhītaṃ prapannaṃ paripāhi mṛtyoḥ śaraṇyamanyadyadahaṃ na jāne
verses.translation: "Scorched by the unquenchable forest-fire of worldly existence, shaken by the winds of adverse fortune, afraid, I have come to you. Protect me from death; I know no other refuge."
verses.hindi: ‘दुर्निवार संसार-रूपी दावानल से तपे हुए और दुर्भाग्य की वायु से झकझोरे गए, भयभीत मुझ शरणागत की मृत्यु से रक्षा कीजिए; मैं आपके अतिरिक्त अन्य किसी को अपना आश्रय नहीं जानता।’

verses.sanskrit: अन्यं शान्ता महान्तो निवसन्ति सन्तो वसन्तवल्लोकहितं चरन्तः । तीर्णाः स्वयं भीमभवार्णवं जनानहेतुनान्यानपि तारयन्तः
verses.transliteration: anyaṃ śāntā mahānto nivasanti santo vasantavallokahitaṃ carantaḥ | tīrṇāḥ svayaṃ bhīmabhavārṇavaṃ janānahetunānyānapi tārayantaḥ
verses.translation: Peaceful, great, good people live (in the world) like spring, doing good to all; having themselves crossed the dreadful ocean of existence, they without any cause help others across too.
verses.hindi: ‘संत-महात्मा वसंत ऋतु के समान संसार का कल्याण करते हुए शांत भाव से विचरते हैं; वे स्वयं इस भीषण भव-सागर को पार कर चुके हैं और दूसरों को भी बिना किसी स्वार्थ के पार उतारते हैं।’

verses.sanskrit: अयं स्वभावः स्वत एव यत्परश्रमापनोदप्रवणं महात्मनाम् । सुधांशुरेष स्वयमर्ककर्कशप्रभाभितप्तामवति क्षितिं किल
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ svabhāvaḥ svata eva yatparaśramāpanodapravaṇaṃ mahātmanām | sudhāṃśureṣa svayamarkakarkaśaprabhābhitaptāmavati kṣitiṃ kila
verses.translation: This is the very nature of the great: to remove the toil of others. The moon itself, indeed, protects the earth scorched by the harsh rays of the sun.
verses.hindi: ‘दूसरों के ताप को दूर करना महापुरुषों का स्वाभाविक धर्म है; जैसे चंद्रमा सूर्य की तीव्र किरणों से तपी हुई पृथ्वी को स्वतः अपनी शीतल किरणों से तृप्त करता है।’

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मानन्दरसानुभूतिकलितैः पूतैः सुशीतैर्युतैर्युष्मद्वाक्कलशोज्झितैः श्रुतिसुखैर्वाक्यामृतैः सेचय । सन्तप्तं भवतापदावदहनज्वालाभिरेनं प्रभो धन्यास्ते भवदीक्षणक्षणगतेः पात्रीकृताः स्वीकृताः
verses.transliteration: brahmānandarasānubhūtikalitaiḥ pūtaiḥ suśītairyutairyuṣmadvākkalaśojjhitaiḥ śrutisukhairvākyāmṛtaiḥ secaya | santaptaṃ bhavatāpadāvadahanajvālābhirenaṃ prabho dhanyāste bhavadīkṣaṇakṣaṇagateḥ pātrīkṛtāḥ svīkṛtāḥ
verses.translation: "With the nectar of your words — purified, cool, soothing to hear, poured from the vessel of your speech, and imbued with the experience of the taste of Brahman's bliss — sprinkle me, O Lord, who am scorched by the flames of the forest-fire of worldly suffering. Blessed are those who, by even a moment of your glance, have been made fit and accepted."
verses.hindi: ‘हे प्रभो! अपनी वाणी के कलश से निसृत, ब्रह्मानंद-रस से परिपूर्ण, शीतल और कर्णप्रिय वचनामृत से इस संसार-दावानल से संतप्त मुझ सेवक को सींचिए।’

verses.sanskrit: कथं तरेयं भवसिन्धुमेतं का वा गतिर्मे कतमोऽस्त्युपायः । जाने न किञ्चित्कृपयाऽव मां प्रभो संसारदुःखक्षतिमातनुष्व
verses.transliteration: kathaṃ tareyaṃ bhavasindhumetaṃ kā vā gatirme katamo'styupāyaḥ | jāne na kiñcitkṛpayā'va māṃ prabho saṃsāraduḥkhakṣatimātanuṣva
verses.translation: "How shall I cross this ocean of existence? What is my way, what means is there? I know nothing. Protect me out of compassion, Lord, and end the suffering of worldly life."
verses.hindi: ‘मैं इस भव-सागर को कैसे पार करूँ? मेरी क्या गति होगी और इसका क्या उपाय है? मैं कुछ नहीं जानता; हे प्रभो! कृपा करके मेरी रक्षा कीजिए और सांसारिक दुःखों का नाश कीजिए।’

verses.sanskrit: तथा वदन्तं शरणागतं स्वं संसारदावानलतापतप्तम् । निरीक्ष्य कारुण्यरसार्द्रदृष्ट्या दद्यादभीतिं सहसा महात्मा
verses.transliteration: tathā vadantaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ svaṃ saṃsāradāvānalatāpataptam | nirīkṣya kāruṇyarasārdradṛṣṭyā dadyādabhītiṃ sahasā mahātmā
verses.translation: Seeing him thus speaking, taking refuge, scorched by the heat of the forest-fire of worldly existence, the great soul, with a glance moist with compassion, should at once give him freedom from fear.
verses.hindi: इस प्रकार आर्त भाव से बोलते हुए, संसार-दावानल से संतप्त शरणागत शिष्य को देखकर करुणा-द्रवित दृष्टि से महात्मा गुरु तत्काल उसे अभयदान देते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: विद्वान् स तस्मा उपसत्तिमीयुषे मुमुक्षवे साधु यथोक्तकारिणे । प्रशान्तचित्ताय शमान्विताय तत्त्वोपदेशं कृपयैव कुर्यात्
verses.transliteration: vidvān sa tasmā upasattimīyuṣe mumukṣave sādhu yathoktakāriṇe | praśāntacittāya śamānvitāya tattvopadeśaṃ kṛpayaiva kuryāt
verses.translation: That wise one should, out of compassion alone, teach the truth to the seeker who has come to him, who longs for liberation, does as instructed, has a tranquil mind and is endowed with calmness.
verses.hindi: वे ज्ञानी गुरु अपनी शरण में आए हुए, आज्ञाकारी, शांतचित्त और शम-सम्पन्न मुमुक्षु को कृपापूर्वक तत्त्व का उपदेश देते हैं।

verses.sanskrit: मा भैष्ट विद्वंस्तव नास्त्यपायः संसारसिन्धोस्तरणेऽस्त्युपायः । येनैव याता यतयोऽस्य पारं तमेव मार्गं तव निर्दिशामि
verses.transliteration: mā bhaiṣṭa vidvaṃstava nāstyapāyaḥ saṃsārasindhostaraṇe'styupāyaḥ | yenaiva yātā yatayo'sya pāraṃ tameva mārgaṃ tava nirdiśāmi
verses.translation: "Do not fear, O wise one; there is no danger for you. There is a way to cross the sea of worldly existence; I shall show you the very path by which the ascetics have gone to its farther shore."
verses.hindi: गुरु कहते हैं: ‘हे विद्वन्! डरो मत, तुम्हारे लिए कोई संकट नहीं है। संसार-सागर से पार होने का निश्चित उपाय है; जिस मार्ग से यति-जन पार गए हैं, वही मार्ग मैं तुम्हें दिखाता हूँ।’

verses.sanskrit: अस्त्युपायो महान्कश्चित्संसारभयनाशनः । तेन तीर्त्वा भवाम्भोधिं परमानन्दमाप्स्यसि
verses.transliteration: astyupāyo mahānkaścitsaṃsārabhayanāśanaḥ | tena tīrtvā bhavāmbhodhiṃ paramānandamāpsyasi
verses.translation: "There is a great means that destroys the fear of worldly existence; by it you will cross the ocean of existence and attain supreme bliss."
verses.hindi: ‘संसार के भय का नाश करने वाला एक महान् उपाय है; उसके द्वारा इस भव-सागर को पार करके तुम परमानंद को प्राप्त करोगे।’

verses.sanskrit: वेदान्तार्थविचारेण जायते ज्ञानमुत्तमम् । तेनात्यन्तिकसंसारदुःखनाशो भवत्यनु
verses.transliteration: vedāntārthavicāreṇa jāyate jñānamuttamam | tenātyantikasaṃsāraduḥkhanāśo bhavatyanu
verses.translation: "From inquiry into the meaning of the Vedanta arises the highest knowledge; by that follows the final destruction of the suffering of worldly existence."
verses.hindi: ‘वेदान्त के अर्थ के विचार से उत्तम आत्म-ज्ञान उत्पन्न होता है; और उससे संसार के आत्यंतिक दुःखों का समूल विनाश हो जाता है।’

verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धाभक्तिध्यानयोगान्मुमुक्षोः मुक्तेर्हेतून्वक्ति साक्षाच्छ्रुतेर्गीः । यो वा एतेष्वेव तिष्ठत्यमुष्य मोक्षोऽविद्याकल्पिताद्देहबन्धात्
verses.transliteration: śraddhābhaktidhyānayogānmumukṣoḥ mukterhetūnvakti sākṣācchrutergīḥ | yo vā eteṣveva tiṣṭhatyamuṣya mokṣo'vidyākalpitāddehabandhāt
verses.translation: The scripture itself declares the causes of liberation for the seeker: faith, devotion, meditation and yoga. Whoever abides in these, his liberation comes from the bondage of the body imagined through ignorance.
verses.hindi: ‘श्रुति स्वयं कहती है कि श्रद्धा, भक्ति, ध्यान और योग ही मुमुक्षु के मोक्ष के साधन हैं। जो इनमें स्थित रहता है, वह अज्ञान-कल्पित देह-बंधन से मुक्त हो जाता है।’

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानयोगात्परमात्मनस्तव ह्यनात्मबन्धस्तत एव संसृतिः । तयोर्विवेकोदितबोधवह्निः अज्ञानकार्यं प्रदहेत्समूलम्
verses.transliteration: ajñānayogātparamātmanastava hyanātmabandhastata eva saṃsṛtiḥ | tayorvivekoditabodhavahniḥ ajñānakāryaṃ pradahetsamūlam
verses.translation: "Through ignorance, your Supreme Self is bound to the not-Self, and from that alone comes transmigration. The fire of knowledge, arisen from discrimination between the two, burns up the effect of ignorance together with its root."
verses.hindi: ‘अज्ञान के कारण ही तुम परमात्मा का अनात्मा से संबंध (बंधन) प्रतीत हो रहा है, और उसी से यह संसार-चक्र चल रहा है। दोनों के विवेक से उत्पन्न ज्ञान की अग्नि अज्ञान के कार्य को समूल भस्म कर देती है।’

verses.sanskrit: शिष्य उवाच । कृपया श्रूयतां स्वामिन्प्रश्नोऽयं क्रियते मया । यदुत्तरमहं श्रुत्वा कृतार्थः स्यां भवन्मुखात्
verses.transliteration: śiṣya uvāca | kṛpayā śrūyatāṃ svāminpraśno'yaṃ kriyate mayā | yaduttaramahaṃ śrutvā kṛtārthaḥ syāṃ bhavanmukhāt
verses.translation: The disciple said: "Master, please listen; I ask this question, on hearing the answer to which from your mouth I shall have fulfilled my purpose."
verses.hindi: शिष्य ने कहा: ‘हे स्वामिन्! कृपा करके सुनिए, मैं एक प्रश्न पूछता हूँ; आपके मुखारविंद से जिसका उत्तर सुनकर मैं कृतार्थ हो जाऊँगा।’

verses.sanskrit: को नाम बन्धः कथमेष आगतः कथं प्रतिष्ठास्य कथं विमोक्षः । कोऽसावनात्मा परमः क आत्मा तयोर्विवेकः कथमेतदुच्यताम्
verses.transliteration: ko nāma bandhaḥ kathameṣa āgataḥ kathaṃ pratiṣṭhāsya kathaṃ vimokṣaḥ | ko'sāvanātmā paramaḥ ka ātmā tayorvivekaḥ kathametaducyatām
verses.translation: "What is bondage? How has it come? How does it persist? How is there release from it? What is the not-Self? What is the Supreme Self? And how is the distinction between the two made? Please tell me this."
verses.hindi: ‘बंधन क्या है? यह कैसे आया? यह कैसे स्थित रहता है? इससे मुक्ति कैसे होती है? यह अनात्मा क्या है? परम आत्मा कौन है? और इन दोनों का विवेक कैसे किया जाता है—यह सब मुझे बताइए।’

verses.sanskrit: श्रीगुरुवाच । धन्योऽसि कृतकृत्योऽसि पावितं ते कुलं त्वया । पावितं यदविद्याबन्धमुक्त्या ब्रह्मीभवितुमिच्छसि
verses.transliteration: śrīguruvāca | dhanyo'si kṛtakṛtyo'si pāvitaṃ te kulaṃ tvayā | pāvitaṃ yadavidyābandhamuktyā brahmībhavitumicchasi
verses.translation: The venerable teacher said: "You are blessed, your purpose is fulfilled, and your family is made pure by you, since you wish to become Brahman by release from the bond of ignorance."
verses.hindi: सद्गुरु बोले: ‘तुम धन्य हो, कृतकृत्य हो और तुमने अपने कुल को पवित्र कर दिया, जो अविद्या के बंधन से मुक्त होकर ब्रह्म-रूप होने की इच्छा करते हो।’

verses.sanskrit: ऋणमोचनकर्तारः पितुः सन्ति सुतादयः । बन्धमोचनकर्ता तु स्वस्मादन्यो न कश्चन
verses.transliteration: ṛṇamocanakartāraḥ pituḥ santi sutādayaḥ | bandhamocanakartā tu svasmādanyo na kaścana
verses.translation: "Sons and others can discharge a father's debts; but no one other than oneself can release oneself from bondage."
verses.hindi: ‘पिता के ऋण को चुकाने वाले पुत्र आदि हो सकते हैं; किन्तु अपने आत्म-बंधन को काटने वाला अपने सिवा दूसरा कोई नहीं हो सकता।’

verses.sanskrit: मस्तकन्यस्तभारादेर्दुःखमन्यैर्निवार्यते । क्षुधादिकृतदुःखं तु विना स्वेन न केनचित्
verses.transliteration: mastakanyastabhārāderduḥkhamanyairnivāryate | kṣudhādikṛtaduḥkhaṃ tu vinā svena na kenacit
verses.translation: "The suffering of one carrying a load on his head can be removed by others, but the suffering caused by hunger and the like cannot be removed by anyone except oneself."
verses.hindi: ‘सिर पर रखे भार आदि के दुःख को दूसरे दूर कर सकते हैं; किन्तु भूख-प्यास आदि से उत्पन्न दुःख को अपने अतिरिक्त कोई दूसरा नहीं मिटा सकता।’

verses.sanskrit: पथ्यमौषधसेवा च क्रियते येन रोगिणा । आरोग्यसिद्धिर्दृष्टाऽस्य नान्यानुष्ठितकर्मणा
verses.transliteration: pathyamauṣadhasevā ca kriyate yena rogiṇā | ārogyasiddhirdṛṣṭā'sya nānyānuṣṭhitakarmaṇā
verses.translation: "A patient follows a healthy diet and takes medicine himself; the cure is seen for him, not through what others do."
verses.hindi: ‘रोगी स्वयं पथ्य का सेवन और औषधि-पान करता है, तभी उसे आरोग्य प्राप्त होता है; दूसरों द्वारा किए गए उपचार से नहीं।’

verses.sanskrit: वस्तुस्वरूपं स्फुटबोधचक्षुषा स्वेनैव वेद्यं न तु पण्डितेन । चन्द्रस्वरूपं निजचक्षुषैव ज्ञातव्यमन्यैरवगम्यते किम्
verses.transliteration: vastusvarūpaṃ sphuṭabodhacakṣuṣā svenaiva vedyaṃ na tu paṇḍitena | candrasvarūpaṃ nijacakṣuṣaiva jñātavyamanyairavagamyate kim
verses.translation: "The nature of the Reality is to be known by oneself through the eye of clear knowledge, not by a scholar. The form of the moon must be known by one's own eyes; can it be understood through others?"
verses.hindi: ‘परम वस्तु का यथार्थ स्वरूप निर्मल ज्ञान-चक्षु द्वारा स्वयं ही जाना जाता है, किसी पंडित के कहने मात्र से नहीं। चंद्रमा का रूप अपनी ही आँखों से देखा जा सकता है, दूसरों द्वारा कैसे जाना जा सकता है?’

verses.sanskrit: अविद्याकामकर्मादिपाशबन्धं विमोचितुम् । कः शक्नुयाद्विनाऽऽत्मानं कल्पकोटिशतैरपि
verses.transliteration: avidyākāmakarmādipāśabandhaṃ vimocitum | kaḥ śaknuyādvinā''tmānaṃ kalpakoṭiśatairapi
verses.translation: "Who, except the Self, could loosen the bonds of ignorance, desire, action and the rest, even in hundreds of crores of ages?"
verses.hindi: ‘अविद्या, काम और कर्म आदि के पाश-बंधन को अपनी आत्मा के अतिरिक्त और कौन करोड़ों कल्पों में भी छुड़ा सकता है?’

verses.sanskrit: न योगेन न साङ्ख्येन कर्मणा नो न विद्यया । ब्रह्मात्मैकत्वबोधेन मोक्षः सिध्यति नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: na yogena na sāṅkhyena karmaṇā no na vidyayā | brahmātmaikatvabodhena mokṣaḥ sidhyati nānyathā
verses.translation: "Not by yoga, not by Sankhya, not by works, and not by learning, but by the knowledge of the oneness of Brahman and the Self is liberation achieved, not otherwise."
verses.hindi: ‘न योग से, न सांख्य से, न कर्म से और न कोरी विद्या से—केवल ब्रह्म और आत्मा की एकता के साक्षात्कार से ही मोक्ष सिद्ध होता है, अन्य किसी प्रकार नहीं।’

verses.sanskrit: वीणाया रूपसौन्दर्यं तन्त्रीवादनसौष्ठवम् । प्रजारञ्जनमात्रं तन्न साम्राज्याय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: vīṇāyā rūpasaundaryaṃ tantrīvādanasauṣṭhavam | prajārañjanamātraṃ tanna sāmrājyāya kalpate
verses.translation: "The beauty of the lute's form and the skill of playing its strings only please people; they do not lead to sovereignty."
verses.hindi: ‘वीणा का रूप-सौंदर्य और तंत्री-वादन की निपुणता केवल लोगों के मन को रिझाती है, उससे साम्राज्य की प्राप्ति नहीं होती।’

verses.sanskrit: वाग्वैखरी शब्दझरी शास्त्रव्याख्यानकौशलम् । वैदुष्यं विदुषां तद्वद्भुक्तये न तु मुक्तये
verses.transliteration: vāgvaikharī śabdajharī śāstravyākhyānakauśalam | vaiduṣyaṃ viduṣāṃ tadvadbhuktaye na tu muktaye
verses.translation: "Fluent speech, a shower of words, and skill in expounding the scriptures — such scholarship of scholars is for enjoyment, not for liberation."
verses.hindi: ‘वाणी की चतुरता, शब्दों की झड़ी, शास्त्रों की व्याख्या का कौशल और विद्वानों की विद्वत्ता—ये सब सांसारिक भोग और यश के साधन हैं, मोक्ष के नहीं।’

verses.sanskrit: अविज्ञाते परे तत्त्वे शास्त्राधीतिस्तु निष्फला । विज्ञातेऽपि परे तत्त्वे शास्त्राधीतिस्तु निष्फला
verses.transliteration: avijñāte pare tattve śāstrādhītistu niṣphalā | vijñāte'pi pare tattve śāstrādhītistu niṣphalā
verses.translation: "When the Supreme Reality is not known, the study of scriptures is fruitless; and when the Supreme Reality is known, the study of scriptures is also fruitless."
verses.hindi: ‘जब तक परमतत्त्व का ज्ञान न हो, तब तक शास्त्रों का अध्ययन निष्फल है; और जब परमतत्त्व का साक्षात्कार हो जाए, तब भी शास्त्रों का अध्ययन निष्फल ही रह जाता है।’

verses.sanskrit: शब्दजालं महारण्यं चित्तभ्रमणकारणम् । अतः प्रयत्नाज्ज्ञातव्यं तत्त्वज्ञैस्तत्त्वमात्मनः
verses.transliteration: śabdajālaṃ mahāraṇyaṃ cittabhramaṇakāraṇam | ataḥ prayatnājjñātavyaṃ tattvajñaistattvamātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "A net of words is a great forest that causes the mind to wander; therefore the knowers of the Reality should, with effort, know the truth of the Self."
verses.hindi: ‘शब्दों का जाल एक विशाल वन के समान है जो चित्त को भटकाता है; अतः आत्मज्ञानी पुरुषों को प्रयत्नपूर्वक आत्म-तत्त्व को ही जानना चाहिए।’

verses.sanskrit: तत्त्वज्ञात्तत्त्व अज्ञानसर्पदष्टस्य ब्रह्मज्ञानौषधं विना । किमु वेदैश्च शास्त्रैश्च किमु मन्त्रैः किमौषधैः
verses.transliteration: tattvajñāttattva ajñānasarpadaṣṭasya brahmajñānauṣadhaṃ vinā | kimu vedaiśca śāstraiśca kimu mantraiḥ kimauṣadhaiḥ
verses.translation: "For one bitten by the snake of ignorance, what use are Vedas, scriptures, mantras or medicines, without the medicine of the knowledge of Brahman?"
verses.hindi: ‘अज्ञान-रूपी सर्प से डसे हुए पुरुष के लिए ब्रह्मज्ञान-रूपी औषधि के बिना वेदों, शास्त्रों, मंत्रों या सामान्य औषधियों से क्या लाभ?’

verses.sanskrit: न गच्छति विना पानं व्याधिरौषधशब्दतः । विनाऽपरोक्षानुभवं ब्रह्मशब्दैर्न मुच्यते
verses.transliteration: na gacchati vinā pānaṃ vyādhirauṣadhaśabdataḥ | vinā'parokṣānubhavaṃ brahmaśabdairna mucyate
verses.translation: "A disease does not go merely by the word 'medicine' without drinking it; without direct experience, one is not liberated by the words 'Brahman'."
verses.hindi: ‘औषधि का केवल नाम लेने से रोग दूर नहीं होता, जब तक उसे पिया न जाए; वैसे ही अपरोक्ष आत्मानुभव के बिना केवल ब्रह्म शब्द कहने से कोई मुक्त नहीं होता।’

verses.sanskrit: अकृत्वा दृश्यविलयमज्ञात्वा तत्त्वमात्मनः । ब्रह्मशब्दैः कुतो मुक्तिरुक्तिमात्रफलैर्नृणाम्
verses.transliteration: akṛtvā dṛśyavilayamajñātvā tattvamātmanaḥ | brahmaśabdaiḥ kuto muktiruktimātraphalairnṛṇām
verses.translation: "Without dissolving the visible world and without knowing the truth of the Self, how can there be liberation for men by mere words, whose only fruit is talk?"
verses.hindi: ‘दृश्य प्रपंच का लय किए बिना और आत्म-तत्त्व को जाने बिना केवल कोरे ब्रह्म-शब्दों के उच्चारण मात्र से मनुष्यों को मुक्ति कैसे मिल सकती है?’

verses.sanskrit: बाह्यशब्दैः अकृत्वा शत्रुसंहारमगत्वाखिलभूश्रियम् । राजाहमिति शब्दान्नो राजा भवितुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: bāhyaśabdaiḥ akṛtvā śatrusaṃhāramagatvākhilabhūśriyam | rājāhamiti śabdānno rājā bhavitumarhati
verses.translation: "Without destroying enemies and without acquiring the wealth of the whole earth, one does not become a king by saying 'I am a king.'"
verses.hindi: ‘शत्रुओं का विनाश किए बिना और राज्य के ऐश्वर्य को हस्तगत किए बिना केवल ‘मैं राजा हूँ’ कहने से कोई राजा नहीं बन जाता।’

verses.sanskrit: आप्तोक्तिं खननं तथोपरिशिलाद्युत्कर्षणं स्वीकृतिं निक्षेपः समपेक्षते न हि बहिःशब्दैस्तु निर्गच्छति । तद्वद्ब्रह्मविदोपदेशमननध्यानादिभिर्लभ्यते मायाकार्यतिरोहितं स्वममलं तत्त्वं न दुर्युक्तिभिः
verses.transliteration: āptoktiṃ khananaṃ tathopariśilādyutkarṣaṇaṃ svīkṛtiṃ nikṣepaḥ samapekṣate na hi bahiḥśabdaistu nirgacchati | tadvadbrahmavidopadeśamananadhyānādibhirlabhyate māyākāryatirohitaṃ svamamalaṃ tattvaṃ na duryuktibhiḥ
verses.translation: "As buried treasure requires trustworthy words, digging, the lifting away of the stones above, and acceptance (taking it up), and does not come out by mere outer words — so the pure truth of the Self, hidden by the effect of illusion, is gained through the teaching of a knower of Brahman, reflection and meditation, and not by wrong reasonings."
verses.hindi: ‘भूमि में गड़े हुए धन को प्राप्त करने के लिए विश्वस्त व्यक्ति की वाणी, खुदाई, पत्थर आदि हटाना और स्वयं ग्रहण करना आवश्यक है; केवल ‘हे धन, बाहर आओ’ पुकारने से धन नहीं मिलता। वैसे ही ब्रह्मविदों के उपदेश, मनन और निदिध्यासन से माया से आच्छादित आत्म-तत्त्व उपलब्ध होता है, कुतर्कों से नहीं।’

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन भवबन्धविमुक्तये । स्वैरेव यत्नः कर्तव्यो रोगादाविव पण्डितैः
verses.transliteration: tasmātsarvaprayatnena bhavabandhavimuktaye | svaireva yatnaḥ kartavyo rogādāviva paṇḍitaiḥ
verses.translation: "Therefore, for release from the bonds of worldly existence, the wise should make effort by themselves, as in a disease and the like."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Therefore, for release from the bonds of संसार, the wise should make effort by themselves, as in a disease and the like.।

verses.sanskrit: रोगादेरिव यस्त्वयाद्य कृतः प्रश्नो वरीयाञ्छास्त्रविन्मतः । सम्मतः सूत्रप्रायो निगूढार्थो ज्ञातव्यश्च मुमुक्षुभिः
verses.transliteration: rogāderiva yastvayādya kṛtaḥ praśno varīyāñchāstravinmataḥ | sammataḥ sūtraprāyo nigūḍhārtho jñātavyaśca mumukṣubhiḥ
verses.translation: "The question you have asked today, like (a question about) a disease and the like, is excellent, approved by knowers of the scriptures, agreed upon, brief in form and of deep meaning, and it is to be known by seekers of liberation."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The question you have asked today, like (a question about) a disease and the like, is excellent, approved by knowers of the scriptures, agreed upon, brief in form and of deep meaning, and it is to be known by seekers of मोक्ष.।

verses.sanskrit: शृणुष्वावहितो विद्वन्यन्मया समुदीर्यते । तदेतच्छ्रवणात्सद्यो भवबन्धाद्विमोक्ष्यसे
verses.transliteration: śṛṇuṣvāvahito vidvanyanmayā samudīryate | tadetacchravaṇātsadyo bhavabandhādvimokṣyase
verses.translation: "Listen attentively, wise one, to what I now say; by hearing it you will at once be freed from the bonds of worldly existence."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Listen attentively, wise one, to what I now say; by hearing it you will at once be freed from the bonds of संसार.।

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षस्य हेतुः प्रथमो निगद्यते वैराग्यमत्यन्तमनित्यवस्तुषु । ततः शमश्चापि दमस्तितिक्षा न्यासः प्रसक्ताखिलकर्मणां भृशम्
verses.transliteration: mokṣasya hetuḥ prathamo nigadyate vairāgyamatyantamanityavastuṣu | tataḥ śamaścāpi damastitikṣā nyāsaḥ prasaktākhilakarmaṇāṃ bhṛśam
verses.translation: "The first cause of liberation is said to be extreme dispassion toward perishable things; then calmness, self-control, forbearance, and thorough renunciation of all the works one is engaged in."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The first cause of मोक्ष कहा जाता है extreme वैराग्य toward perishable things; then शम, दम, तितिक्षा, and thorough renunciation of all the works one is engaged in.।

verses.sanskrit: ततः श्रुतिस्तन्मननं सतत्त्वध्यानं चिरं नित्यनिरन्तरं मुनेः । ततोऽविकल्पं परमेत्य विद्वान् इहैव निर्वाणसुखं समृच्छति
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śrutistanmananaṃ satattvadhyānaṃ ciraṃ nityanirantaraṃ muneḥ | tato'vikalpaṃ parametya vidvān ihaiva nirvāṇasukhaṃ samṛcchati
verses.translation: "Then hearing the scripture, reflection, and long, constant, unbroken meditation on the truth by the sage; then, attaining the supreme undifferentiated state, the wise one obtains the bliss of liberation right here."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Then hearing the scripture, reflection, and long, constant, unbroken meditation on the truth by the sage; then, attaining परमेश्वर undifferentiated state, विद्वान्/ज्ञानी obtains the आनंद of मोक्ष right here.।

verses.sanskrit: यद्बोद्धव्यं तवेदानीमात्मानात्मविवेचनम् । तदुच्यते मया सम्यक् श्रुत्वात्मन्यवधारय
verses.transliteration: yadboddhavyaṃ tavedānīmātmānātmavivecanam | taducyate mayā samyak śrutvātmanyavadhāraya
verses.translation: "What you now need to know is the discrimination between the Self and the not-Self; I shall tell it fully — hear it and fix it in yourself."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: What you now need to know is the विवेक between आत्मा and अनात्मा; I shall tell it fully — hear it and fix it in yourself.।

verses.sanskrit: मज्जास्थिमेदःपलरक्तचर्मत्वगाह्वयैर्धातुभिरेभिरन्वितम् । पादोरुवक्षोभुजपृष्ठमस्तकैः अङ्गैरुपाङ्गैरुपयुक्तमेतत्
verses.transliteration: majjāsthimedaḥpalaraktacarmatvagāhvayairdhātubhirebhiranvitam | pādoruvakṣobhujapṛṣṭhamastakaiḥ aṅgairupāṅgairupayuktametat
verses.translation: "This (body) is composed of the substances called marrow, bone, fat, flesh, blood, skin and cuticle, and furnished with feet, thighs, chest, arms, back, head, and limbs and sub-limbs."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: This (body) is composed of the substances called marrow, bone, fat, flesh, blood, skin and cuticle, and furnished with feet, thighs, chest, arms, back, head, and limbs and sub-limbs.।

verses.sanskrit: अहम्ममेति प्रथितं शरीरं मोहास्पदं स्थूलमितीर्यते बुधैः । नभोनभस्वद्दहनाम्बुभूमयः सूक्ष्माणि भूतानि भवन्ति तानि
verses.transliteration: ahammameti prathitaṃ śarīraṃ mohāspadaṃ sthūlamitīryate budhaiḥ | nabhonabhasvaddahanāmbubhūmayaḥ sūkṣmāṇi bhūtāni bhavanti tāni
verses.translation: "The body, known as 'I' and 'mine', the seat of delusion, is called by the wise the gross body. Space, air, fire, water and earth are the subtle elements."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: शरीर/देह, known as 'I' and 'mine', the seat of मोह/भ्रम, कहलाता है by the wise the gross body. Space, air, fire, water and earth are the subtle elements.।

verses.sanskrit: परस्परांशैर्मिलितानि भूत्वा स्थूलानि च स्थूलशरीरहेतवः । मात्रास्तदीया विषया भवन्ति शब्दादयः पञ्च सुखाय भोक्तुः
verses.transliteration: parasparāṃśairmilitāni bhūtvā sthūlāni ca sthūlaśarīrahetavaḥ | mātrāstadīyā viṣayā bhavanti śabdādayaḥ pañca sukhāya bhoktuḥ
verses.translation: "Mixed with parts of one another, they become gross and are the causes of the gross body; their fine measures, sound and the other five, are the objects, for the pleasure of the enjoyer."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Mixed with parts of one another, they become gross and are the causes of the gross body; their fine measures, sound and the other five, are the objects, for the pleasure of the enjoyer.।

verses.sanskrit: य एषु मूढा विषयेषु बद्धा रागोरुपाशेन सुदुर्दमेन । आयान्ति निर्यान्त्यध ऊर्ध्वमुच्चैः स्वकर्मदूतेन जवेन नीताः
verses.transliteration: ya eṣu mūḍhā viṣayeṣu baddhā rāgorupāśena sudurdamena | āyānti niryāntyadha ūrdhvamuccaiḥ svakarmadūtena javena nītāḥ
verses.translation: "The deluded who are bound to these objects by the strong, hard-to-subdue cord of attachment go and come, down and up, carried swiftly by the messenger of their own karma."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The deluded who are bound to these objects by the strong, hard-to-subdue cord of attachment go and come, down and up, carried swiftly by the messenger of their own karma.।

verses.sanskrit: शब्दादिभिः पञ्चभिरेव पञ्च पञ्चत्वमापुः स्वगुणेन बद्धाः । कुरङ्गमातङ्गपतङ्गमीनभृङ्गा नरः पञ्चभिरञ्चितः किम्
verses.transliteration: śabdādibhiḥ pañcabhireva pañca pañcatvamāpuḥ svaguṇena baddhāḥ | kuraṅgamātaṅgapataṅgamīnabhṛṅgā naraḥ pañcabhirañcitaḥ kim
verses.translation: "By the five — sound and the rest — five (creatures) have met death, each bound by its own quality: deer, elephant, moth, fish and bee. What then of a man, seized by all five?"
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: By the five — sound and the rest — five (creatures) have met death, each bound by its own quality: deer, elephant, moth, fish and bee. What then of a man, seized by all five?।

verses.sanskrit: दोषेण तीव्रो विषयः कृष्णसर्पविषादपि । विषं निहन्ति भोक्तारं द्रष्टारं चक्षुषाप्ययम्
verses.transliteration: doṣeṇa tīvro viṣayaḥ kṛṣṇasarpaviṣādapi | viṣaṃ nihanti bhoktāraṃ draṣṭāraṃ cakṣuṣāpyayam
verses.translation: "The objects are worse in fault than the poison of a black snake: poison kills only the one who takes it, but this (the object) kills even the one who merely looks at it with his eyes."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The objects are worse in fault than the poison of a black snake: poison kills only the one who takes it, but this (the object) kills even the one who merely looks at it with his eyes.।

verses.sanskrit: विषयाशामहापाशाद्यो विमुक्तः सुदुस्त्यजात् । स एव कल्पते मुक्त्यै नान्यः षट्शास्त्रवेद्यपि
verses.transliteration: viṣayāśāmahāpāśādyo vimuktaḥ sudustyajāt | sa eva kalpate muktyai nānyaḥ ṣaṭśāstravedyapi
verses.translation: "He who is freed from the great noose of desire for objects, so hard to give up, alone is fit for liberation, and no other, even one who knows the six systems."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: He who is freed from the great noose of desire for objects, so hard to give up, alone is fit for मोक्ष, and no other, even one who knows the six systems.।

verses.sanskrit: आपातवैराग्यवतो मुमुक्षून् भवाब्धिपारं प्रतियातुमुद्यतान् । आशाग्रहो मज्जयतेऽन्तराले निगृह्य कण्ठे विनिवर्त्य वेगात्
verses.transliteration: āpātavairāgyavato mumukṣūn bhavābdhipāraṃ pratiyātumudyatān | āśāgraho majjayate'ntarāle nigṛhya kaṇṭhe vinivartya vegāt
verses.translation: "For seekers of liberation who have only a passing dispassion and are trying to reach the farther shore of the ocean of existence, the crocodile of desire seizes them by the throat midway and drags them back by force."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: For seekers of मोक्ष who have only a passing वैराग्य and are trying to reach the farther shore of the ocean of existence, the crocodile of desire seizes them by the throat midway and drags them back by force.।

verses.sanskrit: विषयाख्यग्रहो येन सुविरक्त्यसिना हतः । स गच्छति भवाम्भोधेः पारं प्रत्यूहवर्जितः
verses.transliteration: viṣayākhyagraho yena suviraktyasinā hataḥ | sa gacchati bhavāmbhodheḥ pāraṃ pratyūhavarjitaḥ
verses.translation: "He who has slain the crocodile called the object with the sword of true dispassion crosses the ocean of worldly existence free from obstacles."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: He who has slain the crocodile called the object with the sword of true वैराग्य crosses the ocean of संसार से रहित obstacles.।

verses.sanskrit: विषमविषयमार्गैर्गच्छतोऽनच्छबुद्धेः प्रतिपदमभियातो मृत्युरप्येष विद्धि । हितसुजनगुरूक्त्या गच्छतः स्वस्य युक्त्या प्रभवति फलसिद्धिः सत्यमित्येव विद्धि
verses.transliteration: viṣamaviṣayamārgairgacchato'nacchabuddheḥ pratipadamabhiyāto mṛtyurapyeṣa viddhi | hitasujanagurūktyā gacchataḥ svasya yuktyā prabhavati phalasiddhiḥ satyamityeva viddhi
verses.translation: "Know that for one of unclear mind who walks along the rough paths of objects, death approaches at every step; but for one who walks by the words of good and wise teachers and by his own reason, know that success comes truly."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Know that for one of unclear mind who walks along the rough paths of objects, death approaches at every step; but for one who walks by the words of good and wise teachers and by his own reason, know that success comes truly.।

verses.sanskrit: मोक्षस्य काङ्क्षा यदि वै तवास्ति त्यजातिदूराद्विषयान्विषं यथा । पीयूषवत्तोषदयाक्षमार्जवप्रशान्तिदान्तीर्भज नित्यमादरात्
verses.transliteration: mokṣasya kāṅkṣā yadi vai tavāsti tyajātidūrādviṣayānviṣaṃ yathā | pīyūṣavattoṣadayākṣamārjavapraśāntidāntīrbhaja nityamādarāt
verses.translation: "If you have a desire for liberation, shun sense-objects from afar like poison, and always with reverence cultivate, like nectar, contentment, compassion, forgiveness, straightforwardness, tranquillity and self-control."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: If you have a desire for मोक्ष, shun sense-objects from afar like poison, and always with reverence cultivate, like nectar, contentment, compassion, forgiveness, straightforwardness, tranquillity and दम.।

verses.sanskrit: अनुक्षणं यत्परिहृत्य कृत्यं अनाद्यविद्याकृतबन्धमोक्षणम् । देहः परार्थोऽयममुष्य पोषणे यः सज्जते स स्वमनेन हन्ति
verses.transliteration: anukṣaṇaṃ yatparihṛtya kṛtyaṃ anādyavidyākṛtabandhamokṣaṇam | dehaḥ parārtho'yamamuṣya poṣaṇe yaḥ sajjate sa svamanena hanti
verses.translation: "Whoever, giving up what must be done every moment for freedom from the bonds made by beginningless ignorance, is intent on nourishing this body — which exists for the sake of another — kills himself thereby."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Whoever, giving up what must be done every moment for freedom from the bonds made by beginningless अविद्या/अज्ञान, is intent on nourishing this body — which exists for the sake of another — kills himself thereby.।

verses.sanskrit: शरीरपोषणार्थी सन् य आत्मानं दिदृक्षति । दिदृक्षते ग्राहं दारुधिया धृत्वा नदीं तर्तुं स गच्छति
verses.transliteration: śarīrapoṣaṇārthī san ya ātmānaṃ didṛkṣati | didṛkṣate grāhaṃ dārudhiyā dhṛtvā nadīṃ tartuṃ sa gacchati
verses.translation: "He who, intent on nourishing the body, wishes to see the Self, is like one who seizes a crocodile, thinking it a log, in order to cross the river."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: He who, intent on nourishing शरीर/देह, wishes to see आत्मा, is like one who seizes a crocodile, thinking it a log, in order to cross the river.।

verses.sanskrit: स इच्छति मोह एव महामृत्युर्मुमुक्षोर्वपुरादिषु । मोहो विनिर्जितो येन स मुक्तिपदमर्हति
verses.transliteration: sa icchati moha eva mahāmṛtyurmumukṣorvapurādiṣu | moho vinirjito yena sa muktipadamarhati
verses.translation: "Delusion about the body and the like is the great death of the seeker of liberation. He who has conquered delusion is fit for the state of liberation."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: मोह/भ्रम about शरीर/देह and the like is the great death of the seeker of मोक्ष. He who has conquered मोह/भ्रम is fit for the state of मोक्ष.।

verses.sanskrit: मोहं जहि महामृत्युं देहदारसुतादिषु । यं जित्वा मुनयो यान्ति तद्विष्णोः परमं पदम्
verses.transliteration: mohaṃ jahi mahāmṛtyuṃ dehadārasutādiṣu | yaṃ jitvā munayo yānti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam
verses.translation: "Conquer delusion, the great death, about body, wife, children and the like; having conquered it, the sages reach that supreme abode of Vishnu."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Conquer मोह/भ्रम, the great death, about body, wife, children and the like; having conquered it, the sages reach that supreme abode of Vishnu.।

verses.sanskrit: त्वङ्मांसरुधिरस्नायुमेदोमज्जास्थिसङ्कुलम् । पूर्णं मूत्रपुरीषाभ्यां स्थूलं निन्द्यमिदं वपुः
verses.transliteration: tvaṅmāṃsarudhirasnāyumedomajjāsthisaṅkulam | pūrṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣābhyāṃ sthūlaṃ nindyamidaṃ vapuḥ
verses.translation: "This gross body, a mass of skin, flesh, blood, sinew, fat, marrow and bone, full of urine and excrement, is contemptible."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: This gross body, a mass of skin, flesh, blood, sinew, fat, marrow and bone, full of urine and excrement, is contemptible.।

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चीकृतेभ्यो भूतेभ्यः स्थूलेभ्यः पूर्वकर्मणा । समुत्पन्नमिदं स्थूलं भोगायतनमात्मनः । अवस्था जागरस्तस्य स्थूलार्थानुभवो यतः
verses.transliteration: pañcīkṛtebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ sthūlebhyaḥ pūrvakarmaṇā | samutpannamidaṃ sthūlaṃ bhogāyatanamātmanaḥ | avasthā jāgarastasya sthūlārthānubhavo yataḥ
verses.translation: "This gross body, produced from the gross elements after their fivefold combination, through past actions, is the abode of the Self's enjoyment. Its state is the waking state, in which gross objects are experienced."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: This gross body, produced from the gross elements after their fivefold combination, through past actions, is the abode of आत्मा's enjoyment. Its state is the waking state, in which gross objects are experienced.।

verses.sanskrit: बाह्येन्द्रियैः स्थूलपदार्थसेवां स्रक्चन्दनस्त्र्यादिविचित्ररूपाम् । करोति जीवः स्वयमेतदात्मना तस्मात्प्रशस्तिर्वपुषोऽस्य जागरे
verses.transliteration: bāhyendriyaiḥ sthūlapadārthasevāṃ srakcandanastryādivicitrarūpām | karoti jīvaḥ svayametadātmanā tasmātpraśastirvapuṣo'sya jāgare
verses.translation: "The soul, by the outer senses, serves gross objects of many kinds — garlands, sandal paste, women and the like — and does it all by itself; therefore the body is praised in the waking state."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: जीव, by the outer senses, serves gross objects of many kinds — garlands, sandal paste, women and the like — and does it all by itself; therefore शरीर/देह is praised in the waking state.।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वोऽपि बाह्यसंसारः पुरुषस्य यदाश्रयः । विद्धि देहमिदं स्थूलं गृहवद्गृहमेधिनः
verses.transliteration: sarvo'pi bāhyasaṃsāraḥ puruṣasya yadāśrayaḥ | viddhi dehamidaṃ sthūlaṃ gṛhavadgṛhamedhinaḥ
verses.translation: "Know this gross body to be the house of the Person, on which the whole outer world depends, as a house is to a householder."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Know this gross body to be the house of the Person, on which the whole outer world depends, as a house is to a householder.।

verses.sanskrit: स्थूलस्य सम्भवजरामरणानि धर्माः स्थौल्यादयो बहुविधाः शिशुताद्यवस्थाः । वर्णाश्रमादिनियमा बहुधाऽऽमयाः स्युः पूजावमानबहुमानमुखा विशेषाः
verses.transliteration: sthūlasya sambhavajarāmaraṇāni dharmāḥ sthaulyādayo bahuvidhāḥ śiśutādyavasthāḥ | varṇāśramādiniyamā bahudhā''mayāḥ syuḥ pūjāvamānabahumānamukhā viśeṣāḥ
verses.translation: "Birth, decay and death are properties of the gross body, and so are stoutness and many other conditions like childhood, the rules of castes and stages of life, the many diseases, and the special modes of worship, disrespect and honour."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Birth, decay and death are properties of the gross body, and so are stoutness and many other conditions like childhood, the rules of castes and stages of life, the many diseases, and the special modes of worship, disrespect and honour.।

verses.sanskrit: बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि श्रवणं त्वगक्षि घ्राणं च जिह्वा विषयावबोधनात् । वाक्पाणिपादा गुदमप्युपस्थः कर्मेन्द्रियाणि प्रवणेन कर्मसु
verses.transliteration: buddhīndriyāṇi śravaṇaṃ tvagakṣi ghrāṇaṃ ca jihvā viṣayāvabodhanāt | vākpāṇipādā gudamapyupasthaḥ karmendriyāṇi pravaṇena karmasu
verses.translation: "The organs of knowledge are ear, skin, eye, nose and tongue, because they make objects known; the organs of action are speech, hands, feet, anus and genital, because they are prone to act."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The organs of ज्ञान are ear, skin, eye, nose and tongue, because they make objects known; the organs of action are speech, hands, feet, anus and genital, because they are prone to act.।

verses.sanskrit: प्रवणानि निगद्यतेऽन्तःकरणं मनोधीः अहङ्कृतिश्चित्तमिति स्ववृत्तिभिः । मनस्तु सङ्कल्पविकल्पनादिभिः बुद्धिः पदार्थाध्यवसायधर्मतः
verses.transliteration: pravaṇāni nigadyate'ntaḥkaraṇaṃ manodhīḥ ahaṅkṛtiścittamiti svavṛttibhiḥ | manastu saṅkalpavikalpanādibhiḥ buddhiḥ padārthādhyavasāyadharmataḥ
verses.translation: "The inner organ, called mind, intellect, ego and memory, is named by its functions: the mind by will and doubt, the intellect by its property of determining objects,"
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The inner organ, called mind, intellect, ego and memory, is named by its functions: मन by will and doubt, बुद्धि by its property of determining objects,।

verses.sanskrit: अत्राभिमानादहमित्यहङ्कृतिः । स्वार्थानुसन्धानगुणेन चित्तम्
verses.transliteration: atrābhimānādahamityahaṅkṛtiḥ | svārthānusandhānaguṇena cittam
verses.translation: "the ego by identification ('I') in these, and the memory by its property of seeking its own aims."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: अहंकार by identification ('I') in these, and the memory by its property of seeking its own aims.।

verses.sanskrit: प्राणापानव्यानोदानसमाना भवत्यसौ प्राणः । स्वयमेव वृत्तिभेदाद्विकृतिभेदात्सुवर्णसलिलादिवत्
verses.transliteration: prāṇāpānavyānodānasamānā bhavatyasau prāṇaḥ | svayameva vṛttibhedādvikṛtibhedātsuvarṇasalilādivat
verses.translation: "It is breath, which becomes prana, apana, vyana, udana and samana, by the difference of its functions, as gold and water take different forms."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: It is breath, which becomes prana, apana, vyana, udana and samana, by the difference of its functions, as gold and water take different forms.।

verses.sanskrit: विकृतेर्भेदात्सुवर्णसलिलमिव वागादि पञ्च श्रवणादि पञ्च प्राणादि पञ्चाभ्रमुखानि पञ्च । बुद्ध्याद्यविद्यापि च कामकर्मणी पुर्यष्टकं सूक्ष्मशरीरमाहुः
verses.transliteration: vikṛterbhedātsuvarṇasalilamiva vāgādi pañca śravaṇādi pañca prāṇādi pañcābhramukhāni pañca | buddhyādyavidyāpi ca kāmakarmaṇī puryaṣṭakaṃ sūkṣmaśarīramāhuḥ
verses.translation: "The five organs of speech and the rest, the five organs of hearing and the rest, the five breaths, the five elements beginning with space, intellect and the rest, ignorance, desire and action — these eight (groups) they call the subtle body."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The five organs of speech and the rest, the five organs of hearing and the rest, the five breaths, the five elements beginning with space, intellect and the rest, अविद्या/अज्ञान, desire and action — these eight (groups) they call the subtle body.।

verses.sanskrit: इदं शरीरं शृणु सूक्ष्मसंज्ञितं लिङ्गं त्वपञ्चीकृतभूतसम्भवम् । सवासनं कर्मफलानुभावकं स्वाज्ञानतोऽनादिरुपाधिरात्मनः
verses.transliteration: idaṃ śarīraṃ śṛṇu sūkṣmasaṃjñitaṃ liṅgaṃ tvapañcīkṛtabhūtasambhavam | savāsanaṃ karmaphalānubhāvakaṃ svājñānato'nādirupādhirātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "Hear now the body called subtle, the linga, produced from the unmixed elements, bearing its impressions, experiencing the fruit of actions — the beginningless, ignorance-caused limiting adjunct of the Self."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Hear now शरीर/देह called subtle, the linga, produced from the unmixed elements, bearing its impressions, experiencing the fruit of actions — the beginningless, अविद्या/अज्ञान-caused limiting adjunct of आत्मा.।

verses.sanskrit: स्वप्नो भवत्यस्य विभक्त्यवस्था स्वमात्रशेषेण विभाति यत्र । स्वप्ने तु बुद्धिः स्वयमेव जाग्रत् कालीननानाविधवासनाभिः
verses.transliteration: svapno bhavatyasya vibhaktyavasthā svamātraśeṣeṇa vibhāti yatra | svapne tu buddhiḥ svayameva jāgrat kālīnanānāvidhavāsanābhiḥ
verses.translation: "The dream is this (subtle body's) distinct state, in which it shines with only itself as remainder; in dream the intellect itself, in the waking manner, through the impressions of many kinds of times,"
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The dream is this (subtle body's) distinct state, in which it shines with only itself as remainder; in dream बुद्धि itself, in the waking manner, through the impressions of many kinds of times,।

verses.sanskrit: कर्त्रादिभावं प्रतिपद्य राजते यत्र स्वयं भाति ह्ययं परात्मा । स्वयञ्ज्योतिरयं धीमात्रकोपाधिरशेषसाक्षी न लिप्यते तत्कृतकर्मलेशैः । कर्मलेपैः यस्मादसङ्गस्तत एव कर्मभिः न लिप्यते किञ्चिदुपाधिना कृतैः
verses.transliteration: kartrādibhāvaṃ pratipadya rājate yatra svayaṃ bhāti hyayaṃ parātmā | svayañjyotirayaṃ dhīmātrakopādhiraśeṣasākṣī na lipyate tatkṛtakarmaleśaiḥ | karmalepaiḥ yasmādasaṅgastata eva karmabhiḥ na lipyate kiñcidupādhinā kṛtaiḥ
verses.translation: "appears as agent and the rest, and shines; there the Supreme Self shines by itself — self-luminous, having the intellect alone as its limiting adjunct, the witness of all, untouched by the faint traces of actions done by it — unattached, therefore untouched by any action done through the adjunct."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: appears as agent and the rest, and shines; there परमात्मा shines by itself — self-luminous, having बुद्धि alone as its limiting adjunct, the witness of all, untouched by the faint traces of actions done by it — unattached, therefore untouched by any action done through the adjunct.।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वव्यापृतिकरणं लिङ्गमिदं स्याच्चिदात्मनः पुंसः । वास्यादिकमिव तक्ष्णस्तेनैवात्मा भवत्यसङ्गोऽयम्
verses.transliteration: sarvavyāpṛtikaraṇaṃ liṅgamidaṃ syāccidātmanaḥ puṃsaḥ | vāsyādikamiva takṣṇastenaivātmā bhavatyasaṅgo'yam
verses.translation: "This subtle body is the instrument of all activity of the Self, the Person of consciousness, like the carpenter's adze and the like; by it, the Self remains unattached."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: This subtle body is the instrument of all activity of आत्मा, the Person of चैतन्य, like the carpenter's adze and the like; by it, आत्मा remains unattached.।

verses.sanskrit: अन्धत्वमन्दत्वपटुत्वधर्माः सौगुण्यवैगुण्यवशाद्धि चक्षुषः । बाधिर्यमूकत्वमुखास्तथैव श्रोत्रादिधर्मा न तु वेत्तुरात्मनः
verses.transliteration: andhatvamandatvapaṭutvadharmāḥ sauguṇyavaiguṇyavaśāddhi cakṣuṣaḥ | bādhiryamūkatvamukhāstathaiva śrotrādidharmā na tu vetturātmanaḥ
verses.translation: Blindness, dullness and sharpness are properties of the eye, according to its good or bad condition; so too deafness, dumbness and the like are properties of the ear and the other organs — not of the knower, the Self.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Blindness, dullness and sharpness are properties of the eye, according to its good or bad condition; so too deafness, dumbness and the like are properties of the ear and the other organs — not of the knower, आत्मा.।

verses.sanskrit: उच्छ्वासनिःश्वासविजृम्भणक्षुत्प्रस्यन्दनाद्युत्क्रमणादिकाः क्रियाः । प्रस्पन्दनाद्य् प्राणादिकर्माणि वदन्ति तज्ञाः प्राणस्य धर्मावशनापिपासे
verses.transliteration: ucchvāsaniḥśvāsavijṛmbhaṇakṣutprasyandanādyutkramaṇādikāḥ kriyāḥ | praspandanādy prāṇādikarmāṇi vadanti tajñāḥ prāṇasya dharmāvaśanāpipāse
verses.translation: Inhaling, exhaling, yawning, sneezing, secretion, departure and the like are the functions of the breath, say those who know; hunger and thirst are properties of the breath.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Inhaling, exhaling, yawning, sneezing, secretion, departure and the like are the functions of the breath, say those who know; hunger and thirst are properties of the breath.।

verses.sanskrit: अन्तःकरणमेतेषु चक्षुरादिषु वर्ष्मणि । अहमित्यभिमानेन तिष्ठत्याभासतेजसा
verses.transliteration: antaḥkaraṇameteṣu cakṣurādiṣu varṣmaṇi | ahamityabhimānena tiṣṭhatyābhāsatejasā
verses.translation: The inner organ abides in these — the eye and the rest, and in the body — through the identification "I", with the light of reflected consciousness.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The inner organ abides in these — the eye and the rest, and in शरीर/देह — through the identification "I", with the light of reflected चैतन्य.।

verses.sanskrit: अहङ्कारः स विज्ञेयः कर्ता भोक्ताभिमान्ययम् । सत्त्वादिगुणयोगेन चावस्थात्रयमश्नुते
verses.transliteration: ahaṅkāraḥ sa vijñeyaḥ kartā bhoktābhimānyayam | sattvādiguṇayogena cāvasthātrayamaśnute
verses.translation: That is to be known as ego, the agent and enjoyer with self-conceit; by its association with the qualities beginning with sattva, it goes through the three states.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: That is to be known as ego, the agent and enjoyer with self-conceit; by its association with the qualities beginning with sattva, it goes through the three states.।

verses.sanskrit: योगेनावस्थात्रितयम्श्नुते विषयाणामानुकूल्ये सुखी दुःखी विपर्यये । सुखं दुःखं च तद्धर्मः सदानन्दस्य नात्मनः
verses.transliteration: yogenāvasthātritayamśnute viṣayāṇāmānukūlye sukhī duḥkhī viparyaye | sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca taddharmaḥ sadānandasya nātmanaḥ
verses.translation: When objects are favourable it is happy, when adverse it is unhappy; pleasure and pain are its properties, not of the Self, whose nature is ever bliss.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: When objects are favourable it is happy, when adverse it is unhappy; pleasure and pain are its properties, not of आत्मा, whose nature is ever आनंद.।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मार्थत्वेन हि प्रेयान्विषयो न स्वतः प्रियः । स्वत एव हि सर्वेषामात्मा प्रियतमो यतः । तत आत्मा सदानन्दो नास्य दुःखं कदाचन
verses.transliteration: ātmārthatvena hi preyānviṣayo na svataḥ priyaḥ | svata eva hi sarveṣāmātmā priyatamo yataḥ | tata ātmā sadānando nāsya duḥkhaṃ kadācana
verses.translation: An object is dear only for the sake of the Self; it is not dear in itself. Since the Self is by itself dearest to all, therefore the Self is ever bliss and has no pain at any time.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: An object is dear only for the sake of आत्मा; it is not dear in itself. Since आत्मा is by itself dearest to all, therefore आत्मा is ever आनंद and has no pain at any time.।

verses.sanskrit: यत्सुषुप्तौ निर्विषय आत्मानन्दोऽनुभूयते । श्रुतिः प्रत्यक्षमैतिह्यमनुमानं च जाग्रति
verses.transliteration: yatsuṣuptau nirviṣaya ātmānando'nubhūyate | śrutiḥ pratyakṣamaitihyamanumānaṃ ca jāgrati
verses.translation: The bliss of the Self is experienced in deep sleep when there is no object; in the waking state scripture, direct perception, tradition and inference (confirm it).
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The आनंद of आत्मा is experienced in deep sleep when there is no object; in the waking state scripture, direct perception, tradition and inference (confirm it).।

verses.sanskrit: अव्यक्तनाम्नी परमेशशक्तिः अनाद्यविद्या त्रिगुणात्मिका परा । कार्यानुमेया सुधियैव माया यया जगत्सर्वमिदं प्रसूयते
verses.transliteration: avyaktanāmnī parameśaśaktiḥ anādyavidyā triguṇātmikā parā | kāryānumeyā sudhiyaiva māyā yayā jagatsarvamidaṃ prasūyate
verses.translation: The supreme power of the Lord, called the Unmanifest, beginningless ignorance, made of the three qualities, is Maya — to be inferred by the wise from its effects — by which this whole world is brought forth.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: परमेश्वर power of the Lord, called the Unmanifest, beginningless अविद्या/अज्ञान, made of the three qualities, is Maya — to be inferred by the wise from its effects — by which this whole world is brought forth.।

verses.sanskrit: सन्नाप्यसन्नाप्युभयात्मिका नो भिन्नाप्यभिन्नाप्युभयात्मिका नो । साङ्गाप्यनङ्गा ह्युभयात्मिका नो महाद्भुताऽनिर्वचनीयरूपा
verses.transliteration: sannāpyasannāpyubhayātmikā no bhinnāpyabhinnāpyubhayātmikā no | sāṅgāpyanaṅgā hyubhayātmikā no mahādbhutā'nirvacanīyarūpā
verses.translation: It is neither existent nor non-existent nor both; neither different nor non-different nor both; neither with parts nor without parts nor both — wonderful, of an indescribable nature.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: It is neither existent nor non-existent nor both; neither different nor non-different nor both; neither with parts nor without parts nor both — wonderful, of an indescribable nature.।

verses.sanskrit: शुद्धाद्वयब्रह्मविबोधनाश्या सर्पभ्रमो रज्जुविवेकतो यथा । रजस्तमःसत्त्वमिति प्रसिद्धा गुणास्तदीयाः प्रथितैः स्वकार्यैः
verses.transliteration: śuddhādvayabrahmavibodhanāśyā sarpabhramo rajjuvivekato yathā | rajastamaḥsattvamiti prasiddhā guṇāstadīyāḥ prathitaiḥ svakāryaiḥ
verses.translation: It is destroyed by the knowledge of pure, non-dual Brahman, as the snake-delusion by discrimination of the rope. Its qualities, famous as rajas, tamas and sattva, are known by their own effects.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: It is destroyed by the ज्ञान of pure, अद्वैत परब्रह्म, as the snake-मोह/भ्रम by विवेक of the rope. Its qualities, famous as rajas, tamas and sattva, are known by their own effects.।

verses.sanskrit: विक्षेपशक्ती रजसः क्रियात्मिका यतः प्रवृत्तिः प्रसृता पुराणी । रागादयोऽस्याः प्रभवन्ति नित्यं दुःखादयो ये मनसो विकाराः
verses.transliteration: vikṣepaśaktī rajasaḥ kriyātmikā yataḥ pravṛttiḥ prasṛtā purāṇī | rāgādayo'syāḥ prabhavanti nityaṃ duḥkhādayo ye manaso vikārāḥ
verses.translation: The projecting power belongs to rajas, of the nature of activity; from it the ancient stream of activity has flowed out. From it always arise passion and the like, and the pains and other modifications of the mind.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The projecting power belongs to rajas, of the nature of activity; from it the ancient stream of activity has flowed out. From it always arise passion and the like, and the pains and other modifications of मन.।

verses.sanskrit: कामः क्रोधो लोभदम्भाद्यसूया अहङ्कारेर्ष्यामत्सराद्यास्तु घोराः । धर्मा एते राजसाः पुम्प्रवृत्तिर्यस्मादेषा तद्रजो बन्धहेतुः
verses.transliteration: kāmaḥ krodho lobhadambhādyasūyā ahaṅkārerṣyāmatsarādyāstu ghorāḥ | dharmā ete rājasāḥ pumpravṛttiryasmādeṣā tadrajo bandhahetuḥ
verses.translation: Desire, anger, greed, hypocrisy, envy, egoism, jealousy and the like are terrible; these are the properties of rajas, from which arises a person's activity; therefore rajas is the cause of bondage.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Desire, anger, greed, hypocrisy, envy, egoism, jealousy and the like are terrible; these are the properties of rajas, from which arises a person's activity; therefore rajas is the cause of bondage.।

verses.sanskrit: यस्मादेतत्तद्रजो एषाऽऽवृतिर्नाम तमोगुणस्य शक्तिर्मया वस्त्ववभासतेऽन्यथा । शक्तिर्यया सैषा निदानं पुरुषस्य संसृतेः विक्षेपशक्तेः प्रवणस्य हेतुः
verses.transliteration: yasmādetattadrajo eṣā''vṛtirnāma tamoguṇasya śaktirmayā vastvavabhāsate'nyathā | śaktiryayā saiṣā nidānaṃ puruṣasya saṃsṛteḥ vikṣepaśakteḥ pravaṇasya hetuḥ
verses.translation: The power called veiling belongs to the quality of tamas, by which a thing appears otherwise than it is; this is the origin of a person's worldly existence, and the cause of the further spread of the projecting power.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The power called veiling belongs to the quality of tamas, by which a thing appears otherwise than it is; this is the origin of a person's संसार, and the cause of the further spread of the projecting power.।

verses.sanskrit: प्रसरस्य प्रज्ञावानपि पण्डितोऽपि चतुरोऽप्यत्यन्तसूक्ष्मात्मदृग्व्यालीढस्तमसा न वेत्ति बहुधा सम्बोधितोऽपि स्फुटम् । भ्रान्त्यारोपितमेव साधु कलयत्यालम्बते तद्गुणान् हन्तासौ प्रबला दुरन्ततमसः शक्तिर्महत्यावृतिः
verses.transliteration: prasarasya prajñāvānapi paṇḍito'pi caturo'pyatyantasūkṣmātmadṛgvyālīḍhastamasā na vetti bahudhā sambodhito'pi sphuṭam | bhrāntyāropitameva sādhu kalayatyālambate tadguṇān hantāsau prabalā durantatamasaḥ śaktirmahatyāvṛtiḥ
verses.translation: Even a wise, learned and clever man, whose vision of the very subtle Self is licked by tamas, does not clearly understand though taught in many ways; he thinks what is imagined through delusion to be real and clings to its qualities. Alas, mighty is the great veiling power of the dreadful tamas!
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Even a wise, learned and clever man, whose vision of the very subtle Self is licked by tamas, does not clearly understand though taught in many ways; he thinks what is imagined through मोह/भ्रम to be सत्य and clings to its qualities. Alas, mighty is the great veiling power of the dreadful tamas!।

verses.sanskrit: अभावना वा विपरीतभावनाऽसम्भावना विप्रतिपत्तिरस्याः । संसर्गयुक्तं न विमुञ्चति ध्रुवं विक्षेपशक्तिः क्षपयत्यजस्रम्
verses.transliteration: abhāvanā vā viparītabhāvanā'sambhāvanā vipratipattirasyāḥ | saṃsargayuktaṃ na vimuñcati dhruvaṃ vikṣepaśaktiḥ kṣapayatyajasram
verses.translation: Non-conception, wrong conception, doubt and misapprehension are its (effects); the projecting power, joined with them, certainly does not let go and ceaselessly wears one out.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Non-conception, wrong conception, doubt and misapprehension are its (effects); the projecting power, joined with them, certainly does not let go and ceaselessly wears one out.।

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानमालस्यजडत्वनिद्राप्रमादमूढत्वमुखास्तमोगुणाः । एतैः प्रयुक्तो न हि वेत्ति किञ्चित् निद्रालुवत्स्तम्भवदेव तिष्ठति
verses.transliteration: ajñānamālasyajaḍatvanidrāpramādamūḍhatvamukhāstamoguṇāḥ | etaiḥ prayukto na hi vetti kiñcit nidrāluvatstambhavadeva tiṣṭhati
verses.translation: Ignorance, laziness, dullness, sleep, negligence, stupidity and the like are the properties of tamas; driven by them one knows nothing and remains like a sleeper or a post.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: अविद्या/अज्ञान, laziness, dullness, sleep, negligence, stupidity and the like are the properties of tamas; driven by them one knows nothing and remains like a sleeper or a post.।

verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं विशुद्धं जलवत्तथापि ताभ्यां मिलित्वा सरणाय कल्पते । यत्रात्मबिम्बः प्रतिबिम्बितः सन् प्रकाशयत्यर्क इवाखिलं जडम्
verses.transliteration: sattvaṃ viśuddhaṃ jalavattathāpi tābhyāṃ militvā saraṇāya kalpate | yatrātmabimbaḥ pratibimbitaḥ san prakāśayatyarka ivākhilaṃ jaḍam
verses.translation: Sattva is pure like water, yet when mixed with the two others it is fit to be a means of worldly movement; in it the reflection of the Self, shining, illumines the whole inert world like the sun.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Sattva is pure like water, yet when mixed with the two others it is fit to be a means of worldly movement; in it the reflection of आत्मा, shining, illumines the whole inert world like the sun.।

verses.sanskrit: मिश्रस्य सत्त्वस्य भवन्ति धर्माः त्वमानिताद्या नियमा यमाद्याः । श्रद्धा च भक्तिश्च मुमुक्षुता च दैवी च सम्पत्तिरसन्निवृत्तिः
verses.transliteration: miśrasya sattvasya bhavanti dharmāḥ tvamānitādyā niyamā yamādyāḥ | śraddhā ca bhaktiśca mumukṣutā ca daivī ca sampattirasannivṛttiḥ
verses.translation: The properties of mixed sattva are humility and the like, the restraints and observances, faith, devotion, longing for liberation, divine wealth, and turning away from the unreal.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The properties of mixed sattva are humility and the like, the restraints and observances, श्रद्धा, devotion, longing for मोक्ष, divine wealth, and turning away from the मिथ्या.।

verses.sanskrit: विशुद्धसत्त्वस्य गुणाः प्रसादः स्वात्मानुभूतिः परमा प्रशान्तिः । तृप्तिः प्रहर्षः परमात्मनिष्ठा यया सदानन्दरसं समृच्छति
verses.transliteration: viśuddhasattvasya guṇāḥ prasādaḥ svātmānubhūtiḥ paramā praśāntiḥ | tṛptiḥ praharṣaḥ paramātmaniṣṭhā yayā sadānandarasaṃ samṛcchati
verses.translation: The qualities of pure sattva are serenity, experience of one's own Self, supreme peace, contentment, great joy, and steadfastness in the Supreme Self, by which one attains the taste of ever-lasting bliss.
