verses.translation: The destruction of the ego, whose strength has risen, cannot be brought about suddenly even by the wise. For those who are not steady in the absorption called free of alternatives, there are habit-impressions of endless births in between.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The नाश अहंकार, whose strength has risen, cannot be brought about suddenly even by the wise. For those who are not steady in the absorption called free of alternatives, there are habit-impressions of endless births in between.।

verses.sanskrit: अहम्बुद्ध्यैव मोहिन्या योजयित्वाऽऽवृतेर्बलात् । विक्षेपशक्तिः पुरुषं विक्षेपयति तद्गुणैः
verses.transliteration: ahambuddhyaiva mohinyā yojayitvā''vṛterbalāt | vikṣepaśaktiḥ puruṣaṃ vikṣepayati tadguṇaiḥ
verses.translation: Joining the person with the deluding notion "I" by the force of veiling, the projecting power distracts him by its qualities.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Joining the person with the deluding notion "I" by the force of veiling, the projecting power distracts him by its qualities.।

verses.sanskrit: विक्षेपशक्तिविजयो विषमो विधातुं निःशेषमावरणशक्तिनिवृत्त्यभावे । दृग्दृश्ययोः स्फुटपयोजलवद्विभागे नश्येत्तदावरणमात्मनि च स्वभावात् । निःसंशयेन भवति प्रतिबन्धशून्यो विक्षेपणं न हि तदा यदि चेन्मृषार्थे
verses.transliteration: vikṣepaśaktivijayo viṣamo vidhātuṃ niḥśeṣamāvaraṇaśaktinivṛttyabhāve | dṛgdṛśyayoḥ sphuṭapayojalavadvibhāge naśyettadāvaraṇamātmani ca svabhāvāt | niḥsaṃśayena bhavati pratibandhaśūnyo vikṣepaṇaṃ na hi tadā yadi cenmṛṣārthe
verses.translation: The conquest of the projecting power is hard to achieve without complete cessation of the veiling power. When the seer and the seen are clearly separated, like milk and water, the veil on the Self is destroyed of itself; without doubt he becomes free of obstruction, and there is then no projection if it were of an unreal object.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The conquest of the projecting power is hard to achieve without complete cessation of the veiling power. When the seer and the seen are clearly separated, like milk and water, the veil on आत्मा is destroyed of itself; without doubt he becomes free of obstruction, and there is then no projection if it were of an मिथ्या object.।

verses.sanskrit: निक्षेपणं सम्यग्विवेकः स्फुटबोधजन्यो विभज्य दृग्दृश्यपदार्थतत्त्वम् । छिनत्ति मायाकृतमोहबन्धं यस्माद्विमुक्तस्तु पुनर्न संसृतिः
verses.transliteration: nikṣepaṇaṃ samyagvivekaḥ sphuṭabodhajanyo vibhajya dṛgdṛśyapadārthatattvam | chinatti māyākṛtamohabandhaṃ yasmādvimuktastu punarna saṃsṛtiḥ
verses.translation: Right discrimination, produced by clear knowledge, having analysed the truth of the seer and the seen, cuts the bond of delusion made by Maya; the one so freed does not return to worldly existence.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Right विवेक, produced by clear ज्ञान, having analysed the truth of the seer and the seen, cuts the bond of मोह/भ्रम made by Maya; the one so freed does not return to संसार.।

verses.sanskrit: विमुक्तस्य परावरैकत्वविवेकवह्निः दहत्यविद्यागहनं ह्यशेषम् । किं स्यात्पुनः संसरणस्य बीजं अद्वैतभावं समुपेयुषोऽस्य
verses.transliteration: vimuktasya parāvaraikatvavivekavahniḥ dahatyavidyāgahanaṃ hyaśeṣam | kiṃ syātpunaḥ saṃsaraṇasya bījaṃ advaitabhāvaṃ samupeyuṣo'sya
verses.translation: For the liberated one, the fire of discrimination of the oneness of the higher and lower burns up the whole thicket of ignorance; what seed of worldly existence could remain for one who has attained the non-dual state?
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: For the liberated one, the fire of विवेक of the oneness of the higher and lower burns up the whole thicket of अविद्या/अज्ञान; what seed of संसार could remain for one who has attained the अद्वैत state?।

verses.sanskrit: आवरणस्य निवृत्तिर्भवति हि सम्यक्पदार्थदर्शनतः । मिथ्याज्ञानविनाशस्तद्विक्षेपजनितदुःखनिवृत्तिः
verses.transliteration: āvaraṇasya nivṛttirbhavati hi samyakpadārthadarśanataḥ | mithyājñānavināśastadvikṣepajanitaduḥkhanivṛttiḥ
verses.translation: The removal of the veil comes from right perception of the thing; the destruction of false knowledge and the cessation of the pain produced by projection follow.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The removal of the veil comes from right perception of the thing; the नाश false ज्ञान and the cessation of the pain produced by projection follow.।

verses.sanskrit: एतत्त्रितयं दृष्टं सम्यग्रज्जुस्वरूपविज्ञानात् । तस्माद्वस्तुसतत्त्वं ज्ञातव्यं बन्धमुक्तये विदुषा
verses.transliteration: etattritayaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ samyagrajjusvarūpavijñānāt | tasmādvastusatattvaṃ jñātavyaṃ bandhamuktaye viduṣā
verses.translation: This triad is seen from right knowledge of the rope's true nature; therefore the true nature of the Real must be known by the wise for release from bondage.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: This triad is seen from right ज्ञान of the rope's true nature; therefore the true nature of the सत्य must be known by the wise for release from bondage.।

verses.sanskrit: अयोऽग्नियोगादिव सत्समन्वयान् मात्रादिरूपेण विजृम्भते धीः । तत्कार्यमेतद्द्वितयं यतो मृषा दृष्टं भ्रमस्वप्नमनोरथेषु
verses.transliteration: ayo'gniyogādiva satsamanvayān mātrādirūpeṇa vijṛmbhate dhīḥ | tatkāryametaddvitayaṃ yato mṛṣā dṛṣṭaṃ bhramasvapnamanoratheṣu
verses.translation: As iron in contact with fire, so the intellect, in connection with the Real, expands in the form of measure and the like; since this dual effect is seen to be false in delusion, dream and day-dream,
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: As iron in contact with fire, so बुद्धि, in connection with the सत्य, expands in the form of measure and the like; since this dual effect is seen to be false in मोह/भ्रम, dream and day-dream,।

verses.sanskrit: ततो विकाराः प्रकृतेरहम्मुखा देहावसाना विषयाश्च सर्वे । क्षणेऽन्यथाभावितया ह्यमीषामसत्त्वमात्मा तु कदापि नान्यथा
verses.transliteration: tato vikārāḥ prakṛterahammukhā dehāvasānā viṣayāśca sarve | kṣaṇe'nyathābhāvitayā hyamīṣāmasattvamātmā tu kadāpi nānyathā
verses.translation: therefore the modifications of Nature — the ego and the rest, and all objects down to the body — are unreal, since they change from moment to moment; but the Self never changes.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: therefore the modifications of Nature — अहंकार and the rest, and all objects down to शरीर/देह — are मिथ्या, since they change from moment to moment; but आत्मा never changes.।

verses.sanskrit: मसत्त्वमात्मा तु कदापि नित्याद्वयाखण्डचिदेकरूपो बुद्ध्यादिसाक्षी सदसद्विलक्षणः । अहम्पदप्रत्ययलक्षितार्थः प्रत्यक् सदानन्दघनः परात्मा
verses.transliteration: masattvamātmā tu kadāpi nityādvayākhaṇḍacidekarūpo buddhyādisākṣī sadasadvilakṣaṇaḥ | ahampadapratyayalakṣitārthaḥ pratyak sadānandaghanaḥ parātmā
verses.translation: The Self is eternal, non-dual, of one undivided form of consciousness, the witness of the intellect and the rest, distinct from being and non-being — the meaning indicated by the notion "I," the inner, a mass of ever-lasting bliss, the Supreme Self.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: आत्मा is नित्य, अद्वैत, of one undivided form of चैतन्य, the witness of बुद्धि and the rest, distinct from being and non-being — the meaning indicated by the notion "I," the inner, a mass of ever-lasting आनंद, परमात्मा.।

verses.sanskrit: इत्थं विपश्चित्सदसद्विभज्य निश्चित्य तत्त्वं निजबोधदृष्ट्या । ज्ञात्वा स्वमात्मानमखण्डबोधं तेभ्यो विमुक्तः स्वयमेव शाम्यति
verses.transliteration: itthaṃ vipaścitsadasadvibhajya niścitya tattvaṃ nijabodhadṛṣṭyā | jñātvā svamātmānamakhaṇḍabodhaṃ tebhyo vimuktaḥ svayameva śāmyati
verses.translation: Thus the wise man, having divided real from unreal and ascertained the truth by the vision of his own knowledge, and having known his Self as undivided knowledge, is freed from them and attains peace by himself.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Thus विद्वान्/ज्ञानी, having divided सत्य from मिथ्या and ascertained the truth by the vision of his own ज्ञान, and having known his Self as undivided ज्ञान, is freed from them and attains peace by himself.।

verses.sanskrit: अज्ञानहृदयग्रन्थेर्निःशेषविलयस्तदा । समाधिनाऽविकल्पेन यदाऽद्वैतात्मदर्शनम्
verses.transliteration: ajñānahṛdayagrantherniḥśeṣavilayastadā | samādhinā'vikalpena yadā'dvaitātmadarśanam
verses.translation: The complete dissolution of the knot of ignorance in the heart occurs when, through absorption free of alternatives, one sees the non-dual Self.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The complete dissolution of the knot of अविद्या/अज्ञान in the heart occurs when, through absorption free of alternatives, one sees the अद्वैत Self.।

verses.sanskrit: त्वमहमिदमितीयं कल्पना बुद्धिदोषात् प्रभवति परमात्मन्यद्वये निर्विशेषे । प्रविलसति समाधावस्य सर्वो विकल्पो विलयनमुपगच्छेद्वस्तुतत्त्वावधृत्या
verses.transliteration: tvamahamidamitīyaṃ kalpanā buddhidoṣāt prabhavati paramātmanyadvaye nirviśeṣe | pravilasati samādhāvasya sarvo vikalpo vilayanamupagacchedvastutattvāvadhṛtyā
verses.translation: This imagining "you, I, this" arises through a fault of the intellect in the non-dual, undifferentiated Supreme Self; in absorption, all alternatives dissolve on the ascertainment of the truth of the thing.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: This imagining "you, I, this" arises through a fault of बुद्धि in the अद्वैत, undifferentiated Supreme Self; in absorption, all alternatives dissolve on the ascertainment of the truth of the thing.।

verses.sanskrit: शान्तो दान्तः परमुपरतः क्षान्तियुक्तः समाधिं कुर्वन्नित्यं कलयति यतिः स्वस्य सर्वात्मभावम् । तेनाविद्यातिमिरजनितान्साधु दग्ध्वा विकल्पान् ब्रह्माकृत्या निवसति सुखं निष्क्रियो निर्विकल्पः
verses.transliteration: śānto dāntaḥ paramuparataḥ kṣāntiyuktaḥ samādhiṃ kurvannityaṃ kalayati yatiḥ svasya sarvātmabhāvam | tenāvidyātimirajanitānsādhu dagdhvā vikalpān brahmākṛtyā nivasati sukhaṃ niṣkriyo nirvikalpaḥ
verses.translation: The ascetic, calm, self-controlled, supremely withdrawn, patient, ever practising absorption, realises his state as the Self of all; thereby burning up completely the alternatives born of the darkness of ignorance, he lives happy, actionless and free of alternatives, in the form of Brahman.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The ascetic, calm, self-controlled, supremely withdrawn, patient, ever practising absorption, realises his state as आत्मा of all; thereby burning up completely the alternatives born of the darkness of अविद्या/अज्ञान, he lives happy, actionless and free of alternatives, in the form of परब्रह्म.।

verses.sanskrit: समाहिता ये प्रविलाप्य बाह्यं श्रोत्रादि चेतः स्वमहं चिदात्मनि । त एव मुक्ता भवपाशबन्धैः नान्ये तु पारोक्ष्यकथाभिधायिनः
verses.transliteration: samāhitā ye pravilāpya bāhyaṃ śrotrādi cetaḥ svamahaṃ cidātmani | ta eva muktā bhavapāśabandhaiḥ nānye tu pārokṣyakathābhidhāyinaḥ
verses.translation: Those who, collected, dissolve the external — ear and so on — and the mind and ego in the Self of consciousness, are alone freed from the bonds of worldly existence, and not others who merely talk about indirect knowledge.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Those who, collected, dissolve the external — ear and so on — and मन and ego in आत्मा of चैतन्य, are alone freed from the bonds of संसार, and not others who merely talk about indirect ज्ञान.।

verses.sanskrit: उपाधिभेदात्स्वयमेव भिद्यते चोपाध्यपोहे स्वयमेव केवलः । तस्मादुपाधेर्विलयाय विद्वान् वसेत्सदाऽकल्पसमाधिनिष्ठया
verses.transliteration: upādhibhedātsvayameva bhidyate copādhyapohe svayameva kevalaḥ | tasmādupādhervilayāya vidvān vasetsadā'kalpasamādhiniṣṭhayā
verses.translation: By difference of adjuncts it (the Self) appears divided; on the removal of adjuncts it is by itself alone. Therefore, for the dissolution of the adjunct, the wise man should always abide in the absorption free of alternatives.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: By difference of adjuncts it (आत्मा) appears divided; on the removal of adjuncts it is by itself alone. Therefore, for the dissolution of the adjunct, विद्वान्/ज्ञानी should always abide in the absorption free of alternatives.।

verses.sanskrit: सति सक्तो नरो याति सद्भावं ह्येकनिष्ठया । कीटको भ्रमरं ध्यायन् भ्रमरत्वाय कल्पते
verses.transliteration: sati sakto naro yāti sadbhāvaṃ hyekaniṣṭhayā | kīṭako bhramaraṃ dhyāyan bhramaratvāya kalpate
verses.translation: A man attached to the Real reaches the Real by single-minded devotion; the insect meditating on the bee becomes fit to be a bee.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: A man attached to the सत्य reaches the सत्य by single-minded devotion; the insect meditating on the bee becomes fit to be a bee.।

verses.sanskrit: क्रियान्तरासक्तिमपास्य कीटको ध्यायन्नलित्वं ह्यलिभावमृच्छति । ध्यायन्यथालिं तथैव योगी परमात्मतत्त्वं ध्यात्वा समायाति तदेकनिष्ठया
verses.transliteration: kriyāntarāsaktimapāsya kīṭako dhyāyannalitvaṃ hyalibhāvamṛcchati | dhyāyanyathāliṃ tathaiva yogī paramātmatattvaṃ dhyātvā samāyāti tadekaniṣṭhayā
verses.translation: The insect, giving up attachment to other actions and meditating on the bee, attains the state of a bee; so the yogi, meditating on the truth of the Supreme Self, attains it by steadfastness in that alone.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The insect, giving up attachment to other actions and meditating on the bee, attains the state of a bee; so the yogi, meditating on the truth of परमात्मा, attains it by steadfastness in that alone.।

verses.sanskrit: अतीव सूक्ष्मं परमात्मतत्त्वं न स्थूलदृष्ट्या प्रतिपत्तुमर्हति । समाधिनात्यन्तसुसूक्ष्मवृत्त्या ज्ञातव्यमार्यैरतिशुद्धबुद्धिभिः
verses.transliteration: atīva sūkṣmaṃ paramātmatattvaṃ na sthūladṛṣṭyā pratipattumarhati | samādhinātyantasusūkṣmavṛttyā jñātavyamāryairatiśuddhabuddhibhiḥ
verses.translation: The truth of the Supreme Self is exceedingly subtle and cannot be understood by gross vision; it is to be known by noble ones of very pure mind through absorption with a very subtle mental activity.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The truth of परमात्मा is exceedingly subtle and cannot be understood by gross vision; it is to be known by noble ones of very pure mind through absorption with a very subtle mental activity.।

verses.sanskrit: यथा सुवर्णं पुटपाकशोधितं त्यक्त्वा मलं स्वात्मगुणं समृच्छति । तथा मनः सत्त्वरजस्तमोमलं ध्यानेन सन्त्यज्य समेति तत्त्वम्
verses.transliteration: yathā suvarṇaṃ puṭapākaśodhitaṃ tyaktvā malaṃ svātmaguṇaṃ samṛcchati | tathā manaḥ sattvarajastamomalaṃ dhyānena santyajya sameti tattvam
verses.translation: As gold purified by heating in a crucible leaves its dross and regains its own quality, so the mind, giving up the impurities of sattva, rajas and tamas through meditation, attains the Truth.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: As gold purified by heating in a crucible leaves its dross and regains its own quality, so मन, giving up the impurities of sattva, rajas and tamas through meditation, attains the Truth.।

verses.sanskrit: निरन्तराभ्यासवशात्तदित्थं पक्वं मनो ब्रह्मणि लीयते यदा । तदा समाधिः सविकल्पवर्जितः स्वतोऽद्वयानन्दरसानुभावकः
verses.transliteration: nirantarābhyāsavaśāttaditthaṃ pakvaṃ mano brahmaṇi līyate yadā | tadā samādhiḥ savikalpavarjitaḥ svato'dvayānandarasānubhāvakaḥ
verses.translation: When, by force of constant practice, the mind thus ripened dissolves in Brahman, then the absorption free of alternatives arises, which of itself gives the experience of the taste of non-dual bliss.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: When, by force of constant practice, मन thus ripened dissolves in परब्रह्म, then the absorption free of alternatives arises, which of itself gives the experience of the taste of अद्वैत आनंद.।

verses.sanskrit: समाधिनाऽनेन समस्तवासनाग्रन्थेर्विनाशोऽखिलकर्मनाशः । अन्तर्बहिः सर्वत एव सर्वदा स्वरूपविस्फूर्तिरयत्नतः स्यात्
verses.transliteration: samādhinā'nena samastavāsanāgranthervināśo'khilakarmanāśaḥ | antarbahiḥ sarvata eva sarvadā svarūpavisphūrtirayatnataḥ syāt
verses.translation: By this absorption follow the destruction of the knot of all habit-impressions and the destruction of all works; the manifestation of one's own nature, within and without, everywhere and always, comes without effort.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: By this absorption follow the नाश the knot of all habit-impressions and the नाश all works; the manifestation of one's own nature, within and without, everywhere and always, comes without effort.।

verses.sanskrit: श्रुतेः शतगुणं विद्यान्मननं मननादपि । निदिध्यासं लक्षगुणमनन्तं निर्विकल्पकम्
verses.transliteration: śruteḥ śataguṇaṃ vidyānmananaṃ mananādapi | nididhyāsaṃ lakṣaguṇamanantaṃ nirvikalpakam
verses.translation: Know reflection to be a hundred times better than hearing, and meditation a lakh of times better than reflection; and the absorption free of alternatives is infinitely so.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Know reflection to be a hundred times better than hearing, and meditation a lakh of times better than reflection; and the absorption free of alternatives is infinitely so.।

verses.sanskrit: निर्विकल्पकसमाधिना स्फुटं ब्रह्मतत्त्वमवगम्यते ध्रुवम् । नान्यथा चलतया मनोगतेः प्रत्ययान्तरविमिश्रितं भवेत्
verses.transliteration: nirvikalpakasamādhinā sphuṭaṃ brahmatattvamavagamyate dhruvam | nānyathā calatayā manogateḥ pratyayāntaravimiśritaṃ bhavet
verses.translation: By the absorption free of alternatives the truth of Brahman is clearly and firmly known, not otherwise, since the movement of the mind, being unsteady, is mixed with other notions.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: By the absorption free of alternatives the truth of परब्रह्म is clearly and firmly known, not otherwise, since the movement of मन, being unsteady, is mixed with other notions.।

verses.sanskrit: अतः समाधत्स्व यतेन्द्रियः सन् निरन्तरं शान्तमनाः प्रतीचि । विध्वंसय ध्वान्तमनाद्यविद्यया कृतं सदेकत्वविलोकनेन
verses.transliteration: ataḥ samādhatsva yatendriyaḥ san nirantaraṃ śāntamanāḥ pratīci | vidhvaṃsaya dhvāntamanādyavidyayā kṛtaṃ sadekatvavilokanena
verses.translation: Therefore, with controlled senses and a calm mind, practise absorption constantly in the inner Self; destroy the darkness made by beginningless ignorance by seeing oneness with the Real.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Therefore, with controlled senses and a calm mind, practise absorption constantly in the inner Self; destroy the darkness made by beginningless अविद्या/अज्ञान by seeing oneness with the सत्य.।

verses.sanskrit: योगस्य प्रथमद्वारं वाङ्निरोधोऽपरिग्रहः । प्रथमं द्वारं निराशा च निरीहा च नित्यमेकान्तशीलता
verses.transliteration: yogasya prathamadvāraṃ vāṅnirodho'parigrahaḥ | prathamaṃ dvāraṃ nirāśā ca nirīhā ca nityamekāntaśīlatā
verses.translation: The first door to yoga is the restraint of speech, non-possession, freedom from hope, freedom from desire, and always a love of solitude.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The first door to yoga is the restraint of speech, non-possession, freedom from hope, freedom from desire, and always a love of solitude.।

verses.sanskrit: एकान्तस्थितिरिन्द्रियोपरमणे हेतुर्दमश्चेतसः संरोधे करणं शमेन विलयं यायादहंवासना । तेनानन्दरसानुभूतिरचला ब्राह्मी सदा योगिनः तस्माच्चित्तनिरोध एव सततं कार्यः प्रयत्नो मुनेः
verses.transliteration: ekāntasthitirindriyoparamaṇe heturdamaścetasaḥ saṃrodhe karaṇaṃ śamena vilayaṃ yāyādahaṃvāsanā | tenānandarasānubhūtiracalā brāhmī sadā yoginaḥ tasmāccittanirodha eva satataṃ kāryaḥ prayatno muneḥ
verses.translation: Dwelling in solitude is the cause of the withdrawal of the senses; self-control is the means of restraining the mind; through calmness the habit-impression of ego dissolves; by that the yogi always has the steady experience of the bliss of Brahman. Therefore the sage must always strive for restraint of the mind.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Dwelling in solitude is the cause of the withdrawal of इन्द्रियाँ; दम is the means of restraining मन; through शम the habit-impression of ego dissolves; by that the yogi always has the steady experience of the आनंद of परब्रह्म. Therefore the sage must always strive for restraint of मन.।

verses.sanskrit: प्रयत्नान्मुनेः वाचं नियच्छात्मनि तं नियच्छ बुद्धौ धियं यच्छ च बुद्धिसाक्षिणि । तं चापि पूर्णात्मनि निर्विकल्पे विलाप्य शान्तिं परमां भजस्व
verses.transliteration: prayatnānmuneḥ vācaṃ niyacchātmani taṃ niyaccha buddhau dhiyaṃ yaccha ca buddhisākṣiṇi | taṃ cāpi pūrṇātmani nirvikalpe vilāpya śāntiṃ paramāṃ bhajasva
verses.translation: Restrain speech in the mind, restrain that in the intellect, restrain the intellect in the witness of the intellect, and dissolve that too in the full Self, free of alternatives, and attain supreme peace.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Restrain speech in मन, restrain that in बुद्धि, restrain बुद्धि in the witness of बुद्धि, and dissolve that too in the full Self, free of alternatives, and attain supreme peace.।

verses.sanskrit: देहप्राणेन्द्रियमनोबुद्ध्यादिभिरुपाधिभिः । यैर्यैर्वृत्तेःसमायोगस्तत्तद्भावोऽस्य योगिनः
verses.transliteration: dehaprāṇendriyamanobuddhyādibhirupādhibhiḥ | yairyairvṛtteḥsamāyogastattadbhāvo'sya yoginaḥ
verses.translation: With whatever adjuncts — body, breath, senses, mind, intellect and the rest — the mind's activity is joined, that state becomes that of the yogi.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: With whatever adjuncts — body, breath, senses, mind, intellect and the rest — मन's activity is joined, that state becomes that of the yogi.।

verses.sanskrit: तन्निवृत्त्या मुनेः सम्यक् सर्वोपरमणं सुखम् । सन्दृश्यते सदानन्दरसानुभवविप्लवः
verses.transliteration: tannivṛttyā muneḥ samyak sarvoparamaṇaṃ sukham | sandṛśyate sadānandarasānubhavaviplavaḥ
verses.translation: By the cessation of those, the sage has right and complete withdrawal from everything, which is bliss; one sees the overflow of the experience of ever-lasting bliss.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: By the cessation of those, the sage has right and complete withdrawal from everything, which is आनंद; one sees the overflow of the experience of ever-lasting आनंद.।

verses.sanskrit: अन्तस्त्यागो बहिस्त्यागो विरक्तस्यैव युज्यते । त्यजत्यन्तर्बहिःसङ्गं विरक्तस्तु मुमुक्षया
verses.transliteration: antastyāgo bahistyāgo viraktasyaiva yujyate | tyajatyantarbahiḥsaṅgaṃ viraktastu mumukṣayā
verses.translation: Renunciation within and renunciation without are fit only for the dispassionate; the dispassionate person gives up attachment within and without, out of longing for liberation.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Renunciation within and renunciation without are fit only for the dispassionate; the dispassionate person gives up attachment within and without, out of longing for मोक्ष.।

verses.sanskrit: बहिस्तु विषयैः सङ्गं तथान्तरहमादिभिः । सङ्गः विरक्त एव शक्नोति त्यक्तुं ब्रह्मणि निष्ठितः
verses.transliteration: bahistu viṣayaiḥ saṅgaṃ tathāntarahamādibhiḥ | saṅgaḥ virakta eva śaknoti tyaktuṃ brahmaṇi niṣṭhitaḥ
verses.translation: Attachment to external objects and, within, to the ego and the rest — only the dispassionate one steadfast in Brahman is able to give these up.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Attachment to external objects and, within, to अहंकार and the rest — only the dispassionate one steadfast in परब्रह्म is able to give these up.।

verses.sanskrit: वैराग्यबोधौ पुरुषस्य पक्षिवत् पक्षौ विजानीहि विचक्षण त्वम् । विमुक्तिसौधाग्रलताधिरोहणं ताभ्यां विना नान्यतरेण सिध्यति
verses.transliteration: vairāgyabodhau puruṣasya pakṣivat pakṣau vijānīhi vicakṣaṇa tvam | vimuktisaudhāgralatādhirohaṇaṃ tābhyāṃ vinā nānyatareṇa sidhyati
verses.translation: Know, O wise one, that dispassion and knowledge are the two wings of a person, like a bird's; without both, climbing the creeper to the top of the mansion of liberation is not possible with either alone.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Know, O wise one, that वैराग्य and ज्ञान are the two wings of a person, like a bird's; without both, climbing the creeper to the top of the mansion of मोक्ष is not possible with either alone.।

verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्तवैराग्यवतः समाधिः समाहितस्यैव दृढप्रबोधः । प्रबुद्धतत्त्वस्य हि बन्धमुक्तिः मुक्तात्मनो नित्यसुखानुभूतिः
verses.transliteration: atyantavairāgyavataḥ samādhiḥ samāhitasyaiva dṛḍhaprabodhaḥ | prabuddhatattvasya hi bandhamuktiḥ muktātmano nityasukhānubhūtiḥ
verses.translation: For the one of extreme dispassion comes absorption; for the collected one, firm knowledge; for the one whose truth is awakened, release from bondage; for the liberated soul, the experience of everlasting happiness.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: For the one of extreme वैराग्य comes absorption; for the collected one, firm ज्ञान; for the one whose truth is awakened, release from bondage; for the liberated soul, the experience of everlasting happiness.।

verses.sanskrit: वैराग्यान्न परं सुखस्य जनकं पश्यामि वश्यात्मनः तच्चेच्छुद्धतरात्मबोधसहितं स्वाराज्यसाम्राज्यधुक् । एतद्द्वारमजस्रमुक्तियुवतेर्यस्मात्त्वमस्मात्परं सर्वत्रास्पृहया सदात्मनि सदा प्रज्ञां कुरु श्रेयसे
verses.transliteration: vairāgyānna paraṃ sukhasya janakaṃ paśyāmi vaśyātmanaḥ taccecchuddhatarātmabodhasahitaṃ svārājyasāmrājyadhuk | etaddvāramajasramuktiyuvateryasmāttvamasmātparaṃ sarvatrāspṛhayā sadātmani sadā prajñāṃ kuru śreyase
verses.translation: I see nothing greater than dispassion as a source of happiness for the one who has mastered himself; and if it is joined with knowledge of the very pure Self, it yields the empire of self-rule. This is the door to the young maiden of liberation, ever open; therefore, for your good, always fix your mind on the real Self, free of desire for everything.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: I see nothing greater than वैराग्य as a source of happiness for the one who has mastered himself; and if it is joined with ज्ञान of the very pure Self, it yields the empire of self-rule. This is the door to the young maiden of मोक्ष, ever open; therefore, for your good, always fix your mind on the सत्य Self, free of desire for everything.।

verses.sanskrit: आशां छिन्द्धि विषोपमेषु विषयेष्वेषैव मृत्योः कृतिस्त्यक्त्वा जातिकुलाश्रमेष्वभिमतिं मुञ्चातिदूरात्क्रियाः । देहादावसति त्यजात्मधिषणां प्रज्ञां कुरुष्वात्मनि त्वं द्रष्टास्यमनोऽसि निर्द्वयपरं ब्रह्मासि यद्वस्तुतः
verses.transliteration: āśāṃ chinddhi viṣopameṣu viṣayeṣveṣaiva mṛtyoḥ kṛtistyaktvā jātikulāśrameṣvabhimatiṃ muñcātidūrātkriyāḥ | dehādāvasati tyajātmadhiṣaṇāṃ prajñāṃ kuruṣvātmani tvaṃ draṣṭāsyamano'si nirdvayaparaṃ brahmāsi yadvastutaḥ
verses.translation: Cut off hope in objects that are like poison — this is the very work of death; abandon pride in caste, family and stages of life, and avoid actions from afar; give up the sense of Self in the unreal body and the like; fix your understanding in the Self. You are the seer, mindless, non-dual, the supreme Brahman in truth.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Cut off hope in objects that are like poison — this is the very work of death; abandon pride in caste, family and stages of life, and avoid actions from afar; give up the sense of Self in the मिथ्या body and the like; fix your understanding in आत्मा. You are the seer, mindless, अद्वैत, परमेश्वर परब्रह्म in truth.।

verses.sanskrit: द्रष्टास्यमलो लक्ष्ये ब्रह्मणि मानसं दृढतरं संस्थाप्य बाह्येन्द्रियं स्वस्थाने विनिवेश्य निश्चलतनुश्चोपेक्ष्य देहस्थितिम् । ब्रह्मात्मैक्यमुपेत्य तन्मयतया चाखण्डवृत्त्याऽनिशं ब्रह्मानन्दरसं पिबात्मनि मुदा शून्यैः किमन्यैर्भृशम्
verses.transliteration: draṣṭāsyamalo lakṣye brahmaṇi mānasaṃ dṛḍhataraṃ saṃsthāpya bāhyendriyaṃ svasthāne viniveśya niścalatanuścopekṣya dehasthitim | brahmātmaikyamupetya tanmayatayā cākhaṇḍavṛttyā'niśaṃ brahmānandarasaṃ pibātmani mudā śūnyaiḥ kimanyairbhṛśam
verses.translation: Fixing the mind firmly on Brahman, the goal, setting the outer senses in their own seats, the body steady, disregarding the maintenance of the body, attaining oneness of Brahman and the Self, and becoming identified with it by unbroken activity of the mind, drink day and night in the Self the taste of the bliss of Brahman; what use are other empty things?
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Fixing मन firmly on परब्रह्म, the goal, setting the outer senses in their own seats, शरीर/देह steady, disregarding the maintenance of शरीर/देह, attaining oneness of परब्रह्म and आत्मा, and becoming identified with it by unbroken activity of मन, drink day and night in आत्मा the taste of the आनंद of परब्रह्म; what use are other empty things?।

verses.sanskrit: किमन्यैर्भ्रमैः अनात्मचिन्तनं त्यक्त्वा कश्मलं दुःखकारणम् । चिन्तयात्मानमानन्दरूपं यन्मुक्तिकारणम्
verses.transliteration: kimanyairbhramaiḥ anātmacintanaṃ tyaktvā kaśmalaṃ duḥkhakāraṇam | cintayātmānamānandarūpaṃ yanmuktikāraṇam
verses.translation: Giving up thought on the not-Self, which is impure and the cause of pain, meditate on the Self, whose form is bliss, the cause of liberation.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Giving up thought on अनात्मा, which is impure and the cause of pain, meditate on आत्मा, whose form is आनंद, the cause of मोक्ष.।

verses.sanskrit: एष स्वयञ्ज्योतिरशेषसाक्षी विज्ञानकोशो विलसत्यजस्रम् । विज्ञानकोशे लक्ष्यं विधायैनमसद्विलक्षणमखण्डवृत्त्याऽऽत्मतयाऽनुभावय
verses.transliteration: eṣa svayañjyotiraśeṣasākṣī vijñānakośo vilasatyajasram | vijñānakośe lakṣyaṃ vidhāyainamasadvilakṣaṇamakhaṇḍavṛttyā''tmatayā'nubhāvaya
verses.translation: This self-luminous, witness of all, the knowledge-sheath, shines forever; making it the target within the knowledge-sheath, distinct from the unreal, experience it as the Self by unbroken activity of the mind.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: This self-luminous, witness of all, the ज्ञान-sheath, shines forever; making it the target within the ज्ञान-sheath, distinct from the मिथ्या, experience it as आत्मा by unbroken activity of मन.।

verses.sanskrit: एतमच्छिन्नया वृत्त्या प्रत्ययान्तरशून्यया । उल्लेखयन्विजानीयात्स्वस्वरूपतया स्फुटम्
verses.transliteration: etamacchinnayā vṛttyā pratyayāntaraśūnyayā | ullekhayanvijānīyātsvasvarūpatayā sphuṭam
verses.translation: Bringing it out by an unbroken activity free of other notions, let him know it clearly as his own nature.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Bringing it out by an unbroken activity free of other notions, let him know it clearly as his own nature.।

verses.sanskrit: अत्रात्मत्वं दृढीकुर्वन्नहमादिषु सन्त्यजन् । उदासीनतया तेषु तिष्ठेत्स्फुटघटादिवत्
verses.transliteration: atrātmatvaṃ dṛḍhīkurvannahamādiṣu santyajan | udāsīnatayā teṣu tiṣṭhetsphuṭaghaṭādivat
verses.translation: Here, strengthening the sense of Self and giving up the "I" and the rest, let him remain indifferent to them, like a pot and the like seen clearly.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Here, strengthening the sense of Self and giving up the "I" and the rest, let him remain indifferent to them, like a pot and the like seen clearly.।

verses.sanskrit: तिष्ठेद्घटपटादिवत् विशुद्धमन्तःकरणं स्वरूपे निवेश्य साक्षिण्यवबोधमात्रे । शनैः शनैर्निश्चलतामुपानयन् पूर्णं स्वमेवानुविलोकयेत्ततः
verses.transliteration: tiṣṭhedghaṭapaṭādivat viśuddhamantaḥkaraṇaṃ svarūpe niveśya sākṣiṇyavabodhamātre | śanaiḥ śanairniścalatāmupānayan pūrṇaṃ svamevānuvilokayettataḥ
verses.translation: Setting the purified inner organ in one's own nature, the witness, mere awareness, and leading it gradually to steadiness, let him then behold himself alone as full.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Setting the purified inner organ in one's own nature, the witness, mere awareness, and leading it gradually to steadiness, let him then behold himself alone as full.।

verses.sanskrit: पूर्णत्वमेवानु देहेन्द्रियप्राणमनोऽहमादिभिः स्वाज्ञानक्लृप्तैरखिलैरुपाधिभिः । विमुक्तमात्मानमखण्डरूपं पूर्णं महाकाशमिवावलोकयेत्
verses.transliteration: pūrṇatvamevānu dehendriyaprāṇamano'hamādibhiḥ svājñānaklṛptairakhilairupādhibhiḥ | vimuktamātmānamakhaṇḍarūpaṃ pūrṇaṃ mahākāśamivāvalokayet
verses.translation: Let him behold the Self freed from all adjuncts imagined by ignorance — body, breath, senses, mind, ego and the rest — as undivided in form, full, like the great space.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Let him behold आत्मा freed from all adjuncts imagined by अविद्या/अज्ञान — body, breath, senses, mind, ego and the rest — as undivided in form, full, like the great space.।

verses.sanskrit: घटकलशकुसूलसूचिमुख्यैः गगनमुपाधिशतैर्विमुक्तमेकम् । भवति न विविधं तथैव शुद्धं परमहमादिविमुक्तमेकमेव
verses.transliteration: ghaṭakalaśakusūlasūcimukhyaiḥ gaganamupādhiśatairvimuktamekam | bhavati na vividhaṃ tathaiva śuddhaṃ paramahamādivimuktamekameva
verses.translation: As space is one, free from hundreds of adjuncts like pot, jar, granary and needle, and does not become manifold, so the pure Supreme, free from ego and the rest, is only one.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: As space is one, से रहित hundreds of adjuncts like pot, jar, granary and needle, and does not become manifold, so the pure Supreme, से रहित ego and the rest, is only one.।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मादिस्तम्बपर्यन्ता मृषामात्रा उपाधयः । ब्रह्माद्याः स्तम्ब ततः पूर्णं स्वमात्मानं पश्येदेकात्मना स्थितम्
verses.transliteration: brahmādistambaparyantā mṛṣāmātrā upādhayaḥ | brahmādyāḥ stamba tataḥ pūrṇaṃ svamātmānaṃ paśyedekātmanā sthitam
verses.translation: From Brahma down to a blade of grass, the adjuncts are mere falsehood; therefore let him see his own full Self standing as the Self alone.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: From Brahma down to a blade of grass, the adjuncts are mere falsehood; therefore let him see his own full Self standing as आत्मा alone.।

verses.sanskrit: यत्र भ्रान्त्या कल्पितं तद्विवेके तत्तन्मात्रं नैव तस्माद्विभिन्नम् । भ्रान्तेर्नाशे भाति दृष्टाहितत्त्वं रज्जुस्तद्वद्विश्वमात्मस्वरूपम्
verses.transliteration: yatra bhrāntyā kalpitaṃ tadviveke tattanmātraṃ naiva tasmādvibhinnam | bhrānternāśe bhāti dṛṣṭāhitattvaṃ rajjustadvadviśvamātmasvarūpam
verses.translation: What is imagined through delusion is, on discrimination, only that (substratum) and not different from it. On the destruction of delusion, the rope is seen as what it truly is; so is the universe the nature of the Self.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: What is imagined through मोह/भ्रम is, on विवेक, only that (substratum) and not different from it. On the नाश मोह/भ्रम, the rope is seen as what it truly is; so is the universe the nature of आत्मा.।

verses.sanskrit: स्वयं ब्रह्मा स्वयं विष्णुः स्वयमिन्द्रः स्वयं शिवः । स्वयं विश्वमिदं सर्वं स्वस्मादन्यन्न किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ brahmā svayaṃ viṣṇuḥ svayamindraḥ svayaṃ śivaḥ | svayaṃ viśvamidaṃ sarvaṃ svasmādanyanna kiñcana
verses.translation: You yourself are Brahma, you yourself are Vishnu, you yourself are Indra, you yourself are Shiva; you yourself are all this universe; there is nothing whatever other than yourself.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: You yourself are Brahma, you yourself are Vishnu, you yourself are Indra, you yourself are Shiva; you yourself are all this universe; there is nothing whatever other than yourself.।

verses.sanskrit: अन्तः स्वयं चापि बहिः स्वयं च स्वयं पुरस्तात् स्वयमेव पश्चात् । स्वयं ह्यावाच्यां स्वयमप्युदीच्यां तथोपरिष्टात्स्वयमप्यधस्तात्
verses.transliteration: antaḥ svayaṃ cāpi bahiḥ svayaṃ ca svayaṃ purastāt svayameva paścāt | svayaṃ hyāvācyāṃ svayamapyudīcyāṃ tathopariṣṭātsvayamapyadhastāt
verses.translation: You are within, you are without; you are in front, you are behind; you are to the south, you are to the north; you are above, and you are below.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: You are within, you are without; you are in front, you are behind; you are to the south, you are to the north; you are above, and you are below.।

verses.sanskrit: तरङ्गफेनभ्रमबुद्बुदादि सर्वं स्वरूपेण जलं यथा तथा । चिदेव देहाद्यहमन्तमेतत् सर्वं चिदेवैकरसं विशुद्धम्
verses.transliteration: taraṅgaphenabhramabudbudādi sarvaṃ svarūpeṇa jalaṃ yathā tathā | cideva dehādyahamantametat sarvaṃ cidevaikarasaṃ viśuddham
verses.translation: As waves, foam, eddies and bubbles are in their nature water, so all this from the body to the ego is only consciousness; all this is consciousness alone, of one taste, pure.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: As waves, foam, eddies and bubbles are in their nature water, so all this from शरीर/देह to अहंकार is only चैतन्य; all this is चैतन्य alone, of one taste, pure.।

verses.sanskrit: सदेवेदं सर्वं जगदवगतं वाङ्मनसयोः सतोऽन्यन्नास्त्येव प्रकृतिपरसीम्नि स्थितवतः । पृथक् किं मृत्स्नायाः कलशघटकुम्भाद्यवगतं वदत्येष भ्रान्तस्त्वमहमिति मायामदिरया
verses.transliteration: sadevedaṃ sarvaṃ jagadavagataṃ vāṅmanasayoḥ sato'nyannāstyeva prakṛtiparasīmni sthitavataḥ | pṛthak kiṃ mṛtsnāyāḥ kalaśaghaṭakumbhādyavagataṃ vadatyeṣa bhrāntastvamahamiti māyāmadirayā
verses.translation: All this universe, known through speech and mind, is only the Real; there is nothing whatever other than the Real for one who stands at the farthest limit of Nature. Does anyone say that the pot, jar and the like are known as different from the clay? The deluded one says "you" and "I" through the wine of Maya.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: All this universe, known through speech and mind, is only the सत्य; there is nothing whatever other than the सत्य for one who stands at the farthest limit of Nature. Does anyone say that the pot, jar and the like are known as different from the clay? The deluded one says "you" and "I" through the wine of Maya.।

verses.sanskrit: क्रियासमभिहारेण यत्र नान्यदिति श्रुतिः । ब्रवीति द्वैतराहित्यं मिथ्याध्यासनिवृत्तये
verses.transliteration: kriyāsamabhihāreṇa yatra nānyaditi śrutiḥ | bravīti dvaitarāhityaṃ mithyādhyāsanivṛttaye
verses.translation: "Where there is nothing else" — scripture, by repeated statements, teaches the absence of duality, to remove false superimposition.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Where there is nothing else" — scripture, by repeated statements, teaches the absence of duality, to remove false अध्यारोप.।

verses.sanskrit: आकाशवन्निर्मलनिर्विकल्पं निःसीमनिःस्पन्दननिर्विकारम् । अन्तर्बहिःशून्यमनन्यमद्वयं स्वयं परं ब्रह्म किमस्ति बोध्यम्
verses.transliteration: ākāśavannirmalanirvikalpaṃ niḥsīmaniḥspandananirvikāram | antarbahiḥśūnyamananyamadvayaṃ svayaṃ paraṃ brahma kimasti bodhyam
verses.translation: Like space, stainless, free of alternatives, limitless, motionless, unchanging, empty within and without, non-different, non-dual — what is there to be known of the supreme Brahman itself?
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Like space, stainless, free of alternatives, limitless, motionless, unchanging, empty within and without, non-different, अद्वैत — what is there to be known of परमेश्वर परब्रह्म itself?।

verses.sanskrit: वक्तव्यं किमु विद्यतेऽत्र बहुधा ब्रह्मैव जीवः स्वयं ब्रह्मैतज्जगदाततं नु सकलं ब्रह्माद्वितीयं श्रुतिः । जगदापराणु सकलं ब्रह्मैवाहमिति प्रबुद्धमतयः सन्त्यक्तबाह्याः स्फुटं ब्रह्मीभूय वसन्ति सन्ततचिदानन्दात्मनैतद्ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: vaktavyaṃ kimu vidyate'tra bahudhā brahmaiva jīvaḥ svayaṃ brahmaitajjagadātataṃ nu sakalaṃ brahmādvitīyaṃ śrutiḥ | jagadāparāṇu sakalaṃ brahmaivāhamiti prabuddhamatayaḥ santyaktabāhyāḥ sphuṭaṃ brahmībhūya vasanti santatacidānandātmanaitaddhruvam
verses.translation: What more is there to say here, in many ways? The individual is Brahman itself; this entire world is Brahman; scripture says "Brahman is non-dual." Those of awakened mind, "All is Brahman, I am Brahman," having clearly given up the outer, live having become Brahman, as ever-lasting consciousness and bliss — this is certain.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: What more is there to say here, in many ways? The individual is परब्रह्म itself; this entire world is परब्रह्म; scripture says "परब्रह्म is अद्वैत." Those of awakened mind, "All is परब्रह्म, I am परब्रह्म," having clearly given up the outer, live having become परब्रह्म, as ever-lasting चैतन्य and आनंद — this is certain.।

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दात्मनैव ध्रुवम् जहि मलमयकोशेऽहन्धियोत्थापिताशां प्रसभमनिलकल्पे लिङ्गदेहेऽपि पश्चात् । निगमगदितकीर्तिं नित्यमानन्दमूर्तिं स्वयमिति परिचीय ब्रह्मरूपेण तिष्ठ
verses.transliteration: ānandātmanaiva dhruvam jahi malamayakośe'handhiyotthāpitāśāṃ prasabhamanilakalpe liṅgadehe'pi paścāt | nigamagaditakīrtiṃ nityamānandamūrtiṃ svayamiti paricīya brahmarūpeṇa tiṣṭha
verses.translation: Destroy the hope raised by the sense of "I" in the body of impurity and, later, in the subtle body, which is like the wind; having thus known oneself as the everlasting embodiment of bliss whose glory is proclaimed by the Vedas, abide as Brahman.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Destroy the hope raised by the sense of "I" in शरीर/देह of impurity and, later, in the subtle body, which is like the wind; having thus known oneself as the everlasting embodiment of आनंद whose glory is proclaimed by the Vedas, abide as परब्रह्म.।

verses.sanskrit: शवाकारं यावद्भजति मनुजस्तावदशुचिः परेभ्यः स्यात्क्लेशो जननमरणव्याधिनिलयः । व्याधिनिरयाः यदात्मानं शुद्धं कलयति शिवाकारमचलम् तदा तेभ्यो मुक्तो भवति हि तदाह श्रुतिरपि
verses.transliteration: śavākāraṃ yāvadbhajati manujastāvadaśuciḥ parebhyaḥ syātkleśo jananamaraṇavyādhinilayaḥ | vyādhinirayāḥ yadātmānaṃ śuddhaṃ kalayati śivākāramacalam tadā tebhyo mukto bhavati hi tadāha śrutirapi
verses.translation: As long as a man clings to this corpse-like form, so long he is impure and suffers from others, the abode of birth, death and disease; but when he sees the Self as pure, of the form of Shiva, unmoving, then he is freed from those; so scripture also says.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: As long as a man clings to this corpse-like form, so long he is impure and suffers from others, the abode of birth, death and disease; but when he sees आत्मा as pure, of the form of Shiva, unmoving, then he is freed from those; so scripture also says.।

verses.sanskrit: स्वात्मन्यारोपिताशेषाभासवस्तुनिरासतः । स्वयमेव परं ब्रह्म पूर्णमद्वयमक्रियम्
verses.transliteration: svātmanyāropitāśeṣābhāsavastunirāsataḥ | svayameva paraṃ brahma pūrṇamadvayamakriyam
verses.translation: By the rejection of all the apparent things superimposed on the Self, it is itself the Supreme Brahman, full, non-dual, actionless.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: By the rejection of all the apparent things superimposed on आत्मा, it is itself परमेश्वर परब्रह्म, full, अद्वैत, actionless.।

verses.sanskrit: समाहितायां सति चित्तवृत्तौ परात्मनि ब्रह्मणि निर्विकल्पे । न दृश्यते कश्चिदयं विकल्पः प्रजल्पमात्रः परिशिष्यते यतः
verses.transliteration: samāhitāyāṃ sati cittavṛttau parātmani brahmaṇi nirvikalpe | na dṛśyate kaścidayaṃ vikalpaḥ prajalpamātraḥ pariśiṣyate yataḥ
verses.translation: When the activity of the mind is absorbed in the Supreme Self, Brahman, free of alternatives, no such alternative is seen; whatever else there is remains mere talk.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: When the activity of मन is absorbed in परमात्मा, परब्रह्म, free of alternatives, no such alternative is seen; whatever else there is remains mere talk.।

verses.sanskrit: ततः असत्कल्पो विकल्पोऽयं विश्वमित्येकवस्तुनि । निर्विकारे निराकारे निर्विशेषे भिदा कुतः
verses.transliteration: tataḥ asatkalpo vikalpo'yaṃ viśvamityekavastuni | nirvikāre nirākāre nirviśeṣe bhidā kutaḥ
verses.translation: This alternative called "the universe" is like an unreal imagining in the one Reality; in what is unchanging, formless and without distinctions, how can there be difference?
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: This alternative called "the universe" is like an मिथ्या imagining in the one Reality; in what is unchanging, formless and without distinctions, how can there be difference?।

verses.sanskrit: द्रष्टुदर्शनदृश्यादिभावशून्यैकवस्तुनि । द्रष्टृदर्शन निर्विकारे निराकारे निर्विशेषे भिदा कुतः
verses.transliteration: draṣṭudarśanadṛśyādibhāvaśūnyaikavastuni | draṣṭṛdarśana nirvikāre nirākāre nirviśeṣe bhidā kutaḥ
verses.translation: In the one Reality, empty of seer, seeing and seen and the like, unchanging, formless and without distinctions, how can there be difference?
verses.hindi: समाधि में बुद्धि को शुद्ध ब्रह्म में स्थिर करके, बाह्य और आंतरिक समस्त द्वैत को भूलकर, केवल अद्वैत अखंड आनंद में स्थित हो जाओ।

verses.sanskrit: कल्पार्णव इवात्यन्तपरिपूर्णैकवस्तुनि । निर्विकारे निराकारे निर्विशेषे भिदा कुतः
verses.transliteration: kalpārṇava ivātyantaparipūrṇaikavastuni | nirvikāre nirākāre nirviśeṣe bhidā kutaḥ
verses.translation: In the one Reality, utterly full like the ocean at the end of an age, unchanging, formless and without distinctions, how can there be difference?
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: In the one Reality, utterly full like the ocean at the end of an age, unchanging, formless and without distinctions, how can there be difference?।

verses.sanskrit: तेजसीव तमो यत्र प्रलीनं भ्रान्तिकारणम् । यत्र विलीनं अद्वितीये परे तत्त्वे निर्विशेषे भिदा कुतः
verses.transliteration: tejasīva tamo yatra pralīnaṃ bhrāntikāraṇam | yatra vilīnaṃ advitīye pare tattve nirviśeṣe bhidā kutaḥ
verses.translation: In which the darkness, the cause of delusion, has dissolved like darkness in light — in the non-dual supreme truth, without distinctions, how can there be difference?
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: In which the darkness, the cause of मोह/भ्रम, has dissolved like darkness in light — in the अद्वैत supreme truth, without distinctions, how can there be difference?।

verses.sanskrit: एकात्मके परे तत्त्वे भेदवार्ता कथं वसेत् । कथं भवेत् सुषुप्तौ सुखमात्रायां भेदः केनावलोकितः
verses.transliteration: ekātmake pare tattve bhedavārtā kathaṃ vaset | kathaṃ bhavet suṣuptau sukhamātrāyāṃ bhedaḥ kenāvalokitaḥ
verses.translation: In the supreme truth, of one nature, how can talk of difference dwell? In deep sleep, which is mere happiness, by whom is difference seen?
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: In परमेश्वर truth, of one nature, how can talk of difference dwell? In deep sleep, which is mere happiness, by whom is difference seen?।

verses.sanskrit: न ह्यस्ति विश्वं परतत्त्वबोधात् सदात्मनि ब्रह्मणि निर्विकल्पे । कालत्रये नाप्यहिरीक्षितो गुणे न ह्यम्बुबिन्दुर्मृगतृष्णिकायाम्
verses.transliteration: na hyasti viśvaṃ paratattvabodhāt sadātmani brahmaṇi nirvikalpe | kālatraye nāpyahirīkṣito guṇe na hyambubindurmṛgatṛṣṇikāyām
verses.translation: By the knowledge of the supreme truth there is no universe in Brahman, the real Self, free of alternatives; in the three times a snake has not been seen in a rope, nor a drop of water in a mirage.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: By the ज्ञान of परमेश्वर truth there is no universe in परब्रह्म, the सत्य Self, free of alternatives; in the three times a snake has not been seen in a rope, nor a drop of water in a mirage.।

verses.sanskrit: मायामात्रमिदं द्वैतमद्वैतं परमार्थतः । इति ब्रूते श्रुतिः साक्षात्सुषुप्तावनुभूयते
verses.transliteration: māyāmātramidaṃ dvaitamadvaitaṃ paramārthataḥ | iti brūte śrutiḥ sākṣātsuṣuptāvanubhūyate
verses.translation: This duality is only Maya; in ultimate truth there is non-duality — so scripture says directly, and it is experienced in deep sleep.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: This duality is only Maya; in ultimate truth there is non-duality — so scripture says directly, and it is experienced in deep sleep.।

verses.sanskrit: अनन्यत्वमधिष्ठानादारोप्यस्य निरीक्षितम् । पण्डितै रज्जुसर्पादौ विकल्पो भ्रान्तिजीवनः
verses.transliteration: ananyatvamadhiṣṭhānādāropyasya nirīkṣitam | paṇḍitai rajjusarpādau vikalpo bhrāntijīvanaḥ
verses.translation: The non-difference of what is superimposed from its substratum is seen by the wise in the rope-snake and the like; alternatives live by delusion.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The non-difference of what is superimposed from its substratum is seen by the wise in the rope-snake and the like; alternatives live by मोह/भ्रम.।

verses.sanskrit: चित्तमूलो विकल्पोऽयं चित्ताभावे न कश्चन । अतश्चित्तं समाधेहि प्रत्यग्रूपे परात्मनि
verses.transliteration: cittamūlo vikalpo'yaṃ cittābhāve na kaścana | ataścittaṃ samādhehi pratyagrūpe parātmani
verses.translation: This alternative is rooted in the mind; when the mind is absent, there is none. Therefore concentrate the mind on the Supreme Self, the inner reality.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: This alternative is rooted in मन; when मन is absent, there is none. Therefore concentrate मन on परमात्मा, the inner reality.।

verses.sanskrit: किमपि सततबोधं केवलानन्दरूपं निरुपममतिवेलं नित्यमुक्तं निरीहम् । निरवधिगगनाभं निष्कलं निर्विकल्पं हृदि कलयति विद्वान् ब्रह्म पूर्णं समाधौ
verses.transliteration: kimapi satatabodhaṃ kevalānandarūpaṃ nirupamamativelaṃ nityamuktaṃ nirīham | niravadhigaganābhaṃ niṣkalaṃ nirvikalpaṃ hṛdi kalayati vidvān brahma pūrṇaṃ samādhau
verses.translation: The wise man in absorption realises in his heart Brahman, the full — something of constant awareness, of pure bliss, incomparable, exceeding all bounds, ever free, desireless, boundless like the sky, without parts and free of alternatives.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: विद्वान्/ज्ञानी in absorption realises in his heart परब्रह्म, the full — something of constant awareness, of pure आनंद, incomparable, exceeding all bounds, ever free, desireless, boundless like the sky, without parts and free of alternatives.।

verses.sanskrit: प्रकृतिविकृतिशून्यं भावनातीतभावं समरसमसमानं मानसम्बन्धदूरम् । निगमवचनसिद्धं नित्यमस्मत्प्रसिद्धं हृदि कलयति विद्वान् ब्रह्म पूर्णं समाधौ
verses.transliteration: prakṛtivikṛtiśūnyaṃ bhāvanātītabhāvaṃ samarasamasamānaṃ mānasambandhadūram | nigamavacanasiddhaṃ nityamasmatprasiddhaṃ hṛdi kalayati vidvān brahma pūrṇaṃ samādhau
verses.translation: The wise man in absorption realises in his heart Brahman, the full — free of Nature and its modifications, a being beyond imagining, of one uniform taste, without equal, far from any means of knowledge, established by the words of the Vedas, ever well known as "I."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: विद्वान्/ज्ञानी in absorption realises in his heart परब्रह्म, the full — free of Nature and its modifications, a being beyond imagining, of one uniform taste, without equal, far from any means of ज्ञान, established by the words of the Vedas, ever well known as "I.।

verses.sanskrit: अजरममरमस्ताभाववस्तुस्वरूपं स्तिमितसलिलराशिप्रख्यमाख्याविहीनम् । शमितगुणविकारं शाश्वतं शान्तमेकं हृदि कलयति विद्वान् ब्रह्म पूर्णं समाधौ
verses.transliteration: ajaramamaramastābhāvavastusvarūpaṃ stimitasalilarāśiprakhyamākhyāvihīnam | śamitaguṇavikāraṃ śāśvataṃ śāntamekaṃ hṛdi kalayati vidvān brahma pūrṇaṃ samādhau
verses.translation: The wise man in absorption realises in his heart Brahman, the full — ageless, deathless, of the nature of the reality that has no non-being, like a calm ocean, without name, free of the modifications of qualities, eternal, tranquil, one.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: विद्वान्/ज्ञानी in absorption realises in his heart परब्रह्म, the full — ageless, deathless, of the nature of परमतत्त्व that has no non-being, like a calm ocean, without name, free of the modifications of qualities, नित्य, tranquil, one.।

verses.sanskrit: समाहितान्तःकरणः स्वरूपे विलोकयात्मानमखण्डवैभवम् । विच्छिन्द्धि बन्धं भवगन्धगन्धितं यत्नेन पुंस्त्वं सफलीकुरुष्व ॥ ४११- सर्वोपाधिविनिर्मुक्तं सच्चिदानन्दमद्वयम् । भावयात्मानमात्मस्थं न भूयः कल्पसेऽध्वने
verses.transliteration: samāhitāntaḥkaraṇaḥ svarūpe vilokayātmānamakhaṇḍavaibhavam | vicchinddhi bandhaṃ bhavagandhagandhitaṃ yatnena puṃstvaṃ saphalīkuruṣva || 411- sarvopādhivinirmuktaṃ saccidānandamadvayam | bhāvayātmānamātmasthaṃ na bhūyaḥ kalpase'dhvane
verses.translation: With a collected mind, behold the Self of undivided glory in its own nature; with effort cut the bond that smells of worldly existence, and make your manhood fruitful. (Contemplate the Self, free of all adjuncts, being-consciousness-bliss, non-dual, abiding in the Self; you will not have to go on the road again.)
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: With a collected mind, behold आत्मा of undivided glory in its own nature; with effort cut the bond that smells of संसार, and make your manhood fruitful. (Contemplate आत्मा, free of all adjuncts, being-चैतन्य-आनंद, अद्वैत, abiding in आत्मा; you will not have to go on the road again.)।

verses.sanskrit: छायेव पुंसः परिदृश्यमानमाभासरूपेण फलानुभूत्या । शरीरमाराच्छववन्निरस्तं पुनर्न सन्धत्त इदं महात्मा
verses.transliteration: chāyeva puṃsaḥ paridṛśyamānamābhāsarūpeṇa phalānubhūtyā | śarīramārācchavavannirastaṃ punarna sandhatta idaṃ mahātmā
verses.translation: Like a person's shadow, which is seen in the form of a mere appearance, this body, experienced through the fruit of karma, the great soul casts aside like a corpse, and does not take it up again.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Like a person's shadow, which is seen in the form of a mere appearance, this body, experienced through the fruit of karma, the great soul casts aside like a corpse, and does not take it up again.।

verses.sanskrit: सततविमलबोधानन्दरूपं समेत्य त्यज जडमलरूपोपाधिमेतं सुदूरे । अथ पुनरपि नैष स्मर्यतां वान्तवस्तु स्मरणविषयभूतं कल्पते कुत्सनाय
verses.transliteration: satatavimalabodhānandarūpaṃ sametya tyaja jaḍamalarūpopādhimetaṃ sudūre | atha punarapi naiṣa smaryatāṃ vāntavastu smaraṇaviṣayabhūtaṃ kalpate kutsanāya
verses.translation: Having reached the Self, of the nature of ever-pure knowledge and bliss, cast far away this adjunct, of the nature of inert filth. And never again remember it: a thing that has been vomited, if made the object of memory, only disgusts.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Having reached आत्मा, of the nature of ever-pure ज्ञान and आनंद, cast far away this adjunct, of the nature of inert filth. And never again remember it: a thing that has been vomited, if made the object of memory, only disgusts.।

verses.sanskrit: समूलमेतत्परिदाह्य वह्नौ सदात्मनि ब्रह्मणि निर्विकल्पे । ततः स्वयं नित्यविशुद्धबोधानन्दात्मना तिष्ठति विद्वरिष्ठः
verses.transliteration: samūlametatparidāhya vahnau sadātmani brahmaṇi nirvikalpe | tataḥ svayaṃ nityaviśuddhabodhānandātmanā tiṣṭhati vidvariṣṭhaḥ
verses.translation: Having burned this (world) with its root in the fire of the real Self, Brahman free of alternatives, the best of the wise then stands of himself as the eternal, pure Self of knowledge and bliss.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Having burned this (world) with its root in the fire of the सत्य Self, परब्रह्म free of alternatives, the best of the wise then stands of himself as the नित्य, pure Self of ज्ञान and आनंद.।

verses.sanskrit: प्रारब्धसूत्रग्रथितं शरीरं प्रयातु वा तिष्ठतु गोरिव स्रक् । न तत्पुनः पश्यति तत्त्ववेत्ताऽऽनन्दात्मनि ब्रह्मणि लीनवृत्तिः
verses.transliteration: prārabdhasūtragrathitaṃ śarīraṃ prayātu vā tiṣṭhatu goriva srak | na tatpunaḥ paśyati tattvavettā''nandātmani brahmaṇi līnavṛttiḥ
verses.translation: Let the body, strung on the thread of prarabdha, go or stay like a garland on a cow; the knower of truth, whose mental activity has merged in Brahman, the Self of bliss, does not look at it again.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Let शरीर/देह, strung on the thread of prarabdha, go or stay like a garland on a cow; the knower of truth, whose mental activity has merged in परब्रह्म, आत्मा of आनंद, does not look at it again.।

verses.sanskrit: अखण्डानन्दमात्मानं विज्ञाय स्वस्वरूपतः । किमिच्छन् कस्य वा हेतोर्देहं पुष्णाति तत्त्ववित्
verses.transliteration: akhaṇḍānandamātmānaṃ vijñāya svasvarūpataḥ | kimicchan kasya vā hetordehaṃ puṣṇāti tattvavit
verses.translation: Having known the Self as undivided bliss, as his own nature, what does the knower of truth desire, or for whose sake, that he should nourish the body?
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Having known आत्मा as undivided आनंद, as his own nature, what does the knower of truth desire, or for whose sake, that he should nourish शरीर/देह?।

verses.sanskrit: संसिद्धस्य फलं त्वेतज्जीवन्मुक्तस्य योगिनः । बहिरन्तः सदानन्दरसास्वादनमात्मनि
verses.transliteration: saṃsiddhasya phalaṃ tvetajjīvanmuktasya yoginaḥ | bahirantaḥ sadānandarasāsvādanamātmani
verses.translation: This is the fruit for the perfected yogi liberated while living: the tasting of the ever-blissful essence in the Self, within and without.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: This is the fruit for the perfected yogi liberated while living: the tasting of the ever-blissful essence in आत्मा, within and without.।

verses.sanskrit: वैराग्यस्य फलं बोधो बोधस्योपरतिः फलम् । स्वानन्दानुभवाच्छान्तिरेषैवोपरतेः फलम्
verses.transliteration: vairāgyasya phalaṃ bodho bodhasyoparatiḥ phalam | svānandānubhavācchāntireṣaivoparateḥ phalam
verses.translation: The fruit of dispassion is knowledge; the fruit of knowledge is withdrawal (from the world); the fruit of withdrawal is peace from the experience of the bliss of the Self.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The fruit of वैराग्य is ज्ञान; the fruit of ज्ञान is withdrawal (from the world); the fruit of withdrawal is peace from the experience of the आनंद of आत्मा.।

verses.sanskrit: यद्युत्तरोत्तराभावः पूर्वपूर्वन्तु निष्फलम् । निवृत्तिः परमा तृप्तिरानन्दोऽनुपमः स्वतः
verses.transliteration: yadyuttarottarābhāvaḥ pūrvapūrvantu niṣphalam | nivṛttiḥ paramā tṛptirānando'nupamaḥ svataḥ
verses.translation: If the latter is absent, the earlier is fruitless. Cessation (of activity) is supreme contentment, incomparable bliss arising of itself.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: If the latter is absent, the earlier is fruitless. Cessation (of activity) is supreme contentment, incomparable आनंद arising of itself.।

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टदुःखेष्वनुद्वेगो विद्यायाः प्रस्तुतं फलम् । यत्कृतं भ्रान्तिवेलायां नाना कर्म जुगुप्सितम् । पश्चान्नरो विवेकेन तत्कथं कर्तुमर्हति
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭaduḥkheṣvanudvego vidyāyāḥ prastutaṃ phalam | yatkṛtaṃ bhrāntivelāyāṃ nānā karma jugupsitam | paścānnaro vivekena tatkathaṃ kartumarhati
verses.translation: Freedom from agitation at visible sufferings is the fruit of knowledge that is presented (here). How could a man, having by discrimination come to loathe the manifold actions he did in the time of delusion, do them afterward?
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Freedom from agitation at visible sufferings is the fruit of ज्ञान that is presented (here). How could a man, having by विवेक come to loathe the manifold actions he did in the time of मोह/भ्रम, do them afterward?।

verses.sanskrit: विद्याफलं स्यादसतो निवृत्तिः प्रवृत्तिरज्ञानफलं तदीक्षितम् । तज्ज्ञाज्ञयोर्यन्मृगतृष्णिकादौ नोचेद्विदां दृष्टफलं किमस्मात्
verses.transliteration: vidyāphalaṃ syādasato nivṛttiḥ pravṛttirajñānaphalaṃ tadīkṣitam | tajjñājñayoryanmṛgatṛṣṇikādau nocedvidāṃ dṛṣṭaphalaṃ kimasmāt
verses.translation: The fruit of knowledge is cessation from the unreal, and the fruit of ignorance is seen to be engagement in it, as with a mirage and the like; otherwise what visible fruit would there be for the knowers?
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The fruit of ज्ञान is cessation from the मिथ्या, and the fruit of अविद्या/अज्ञान is seen to be engagement in it, as with a mirage and the like; otherwise what visible fruit would there be for the knowers?।

verses.sanskrit: नोचेद्विदो अज्ञानहृदयग्रन्थेर्विनाशो यद्यशेषतः । अनिच्छोर्विषयः किं नु प्रवृत्तेः कारणं स्वतः
verses.transliteration: nocedvido ajñānahṛdayagranthervināśo yadyaśeṣataḥ | anicchorviṣayaḥ kiṃ nu pravṛtteḥ kāraṇaṃ svataḥ
verses.translation: If the knot of ignorance in the heart is destroyed entirely, how can an object be the cause of engagement by itself for one who has no wish?
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: If the knot of अविद्या/अज्ञान in the heart is destroyed entirely, how can an object be the cause of engagement by itself for one who has no wish?।

verses.sanskrit: विदुषः किं वासनानुदयो भोग्ये वैराग्यस्य तदावधिः । अहम्भावोदयाभावो बोधस्य परमावधिः । लीनवृत्तैरनुत्पत्तिर्मर्यादोपरतेस्तु सा
verses.transliteration: viduṣaḥ kiṃ vāsanānudayo bhogye vairāgyasya tadāvadhiḥ | ahambhāvodayābhāvo bodhasya paramāvadhiḥ | līnavṛttairanutpattirmaryādoparatestu sā
verses.translation: The limit of dispassion is the non-arising of habit-impressions toward the enjoyable; the highest limit of knowledge is the non-arising of the sense of "I"; and the limit of withdrawal is the non-arising (of any mental activity) for those whose activity is merged.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The limit of वैराग्य is the non-arising of habit-impressions toward the enjoyable; the highest limit of ज्ञान is the non-arising of the sense of "I"; and the limit of withdrawal is the non-arising (of any mental activity) for those whose activity is merged.।

verses.sanskrit: वृत्तेर ब्रह्माकारतया सदा स्थिततया निर्मुक्तबाह्यार्थधीरन्यावेदितभोग्यभोगकलनो निद्रालुवद्बालवत् । स्वप्नालोकितलोकवज्जगदिदं पश्यन्क्वचिल्लब्धधीरास्ते कश्चिदनन्तपुण्यफलभुग्धन्यः स मान्यो भुवि
verses.transliteration: vṛttera brahmākāratayā sadā sthitatayā nirmuktabāhyārthadhīranyāveditabhogyabhogakalano nidrāluvadbālavat | svapnālokitalokavajjagadidaṃ paśyankvacillabdhadhīrāste kaścidanantapuṇyaphalabhugdhanyaḥ sa mānyo bhuvi
verses.translation: One whose mental activity always abides as Brahman, whose thought of external objects is gone, who takes in objects offered by others as a sleepy man or a child does, who sees this world like a world seen in a dream, and only occasionally regains awareness — such a person is rare on earth, blessed, revered: he enjoys the fruit of endless merit.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: One whose mental activity always abides as परब्रह्म, whose thought of external objects is gone, who takes in objects offered by others as a sleepy man or a child does, who sees this world like a world seen in a dream, and only occasionally regains awareness — such a person is rare on earth, blessed, revered: he enjoys the fruit of endless merit.।

verses.sanskrit: स्थितप्रज्ञो यतिरयं यः सदानन्दमश्नुते । ब्रह्मण्येव विलीनात्मा निर्विकारो विनिष्क्रियः
verses.transliteration: sthitaprajño yatirayaṃ yaḥ sadānandamaśnute | brahmaṇyeva vilīnātmā nirvikāro viniṣkriyaḥ
verses.translation: This ascetic of steady wisdom, who enjoys ever-lasting bliss, whose self is merged in Brahman alone, unchanging and actionless —
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: This ascetic of steady wisdom, who enjoys ever-lasting आनंद, whose self is merged in परब्रह्म alone, unchanging and actionless —।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मात्मनोः शोधितयोरेकभावावगाहिनी । निर्विकल्पा च चिन्मात्रा वृत्तिः प्रज्ञेति कथ्यते । सुस्थिताऽसौ भवेद्यस्य स्थितप्रज्ञः स उच्यते
verses.transliteration: brahmātmanoḥ śodhitayorekabhāvāvagāhinī | nirvikalpā ca cinmātrā vṛttiḥ prajñeti kathyate | susthitā'sau bhavedyasya sthitaprajñaḥ sa ucyate
verses.translation: The activity of the mind that plunges into the oneness of the purified Brahman and Self, free of alternatives and of mere consciousness, is called wisdom (prajna). One in whom it is well established is said to be of steady wisdom.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The activity of मन that plunges into the oneness of the purified परब्रह्म and Self, free of alternatives and of mere चैतन्य, कहलाता है wisdom (prajna). One in whom it is well established कहा जाता है of steady wisdom.।

verses.sanskrit: यस्य स्थिता भवेत्प्रज्ञा यस्यानन्दो निरन्तरः । प्रपञ्चो विस्मृतप्रायः स जीवन्मुक्त इष्यते
verses.transliteration: yasya sthitā bhavetprajñā yasyānando nirantaraḥ | prapañco vismṛtaprāyaḥ sa jīvanmukta iṣyate
verses.translation: He whose wisdom is steady, whose bliss is unbroken, and to whom the manifold world is almost forgotten, is held to be liberated while living.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: He whose wisdom is steady, whose आनंद is unbroken, and to whom the manifold world is almost forgotten, is held to be liberated while living.।

verses.sanskrit: लीनधीरपि जागर्ति जाग्रद्धर्मविवर्जितः । बोधो निर्वासनो यस्य स जीवन्मुक्त इष्यते
verses.transliteration: līnadhīrapi jāgarti jāgraddharmavivarjitaḥ | bodho nirvāsano yasya sa jīvanmukta iṣyate
verses.translation: Though his mind is merged, he is awake, free of the characteristics of waking; one whose knowledge is free of habit-impressions is held to be liberated while living.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Though his mind is merged, he is awake, free of the characteristics of waking; one whose ज्ञान is free of habit-impressions is held to be liberated while living.।

verses.sanskrit: शान्तसंसारकलनः कलावानपि निष्कलः । यस्य चित्तं विनिश्चिन्तं स जीवन्मुक्त इष्यते
verses.transliteration: śāntasaṃsārakalanaḥ kalāvānapi niṣkalaḥ | yasya cittaṃ viniścintaṃ sa jīvanmukta iṣyate
verses.translation: One for whom the play of worldly existence has ceased, who, though having parts, is without parts, whose mind is free of anxiety — he is held to be liberated while living.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: One for whom the play of संसार has ceased, who, though having parts, is without parts, whose mind is free of anxiety — he is held to be liberated while living.।

verses.sanskrit: यः सचित्तोऽपि निश्चित्तः वर्तमानेऽपि देहेऽस्मिञ्छायावदनुवर्तिनि । अहन्ताममताऽभावो जीवन्मुक्तस्य लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: yaḥ sacitto'pi niścittaḥ vartamāne'pi dehe'smiñchāyāvadanuvartini | ahantāmamatā'bhāvo jīvanmuktasya lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: One who, though having a mind, is mindless; who, though this body persists, following him like a shadow, has no "I" and no "mine" — this is the mark of one liberated while living.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: One who, though having a mind, is mindless; who, though this body persists, following him like a shadow, has no "I" and no "mine" — this is the mark of one liberated while living.।

verses.sanskrit: अतीताननुसन्धानं भविष्यदविचारणम् । औदासीन्यमपि प्राप्तं जीवन्मुक्तस्य लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: atītānanusandhānaṃ bhaviṣyadavicāraṇam | audāsīnyamapi prāptaṃ jīvanmuktasya lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Non-pursuit of the past, no brooding on the future, and even indifference to what comes — these are the marks of one liberated while living.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Non-pursuit of the past, no brooding on the future, and even indifference to what comes — these are the marks of one liberated while living.।

verses.sanskrit: प्राप्ते गुणदोषविशिष्टेऽस्मिन्स्वभावेन विलक्षणे । सर्वत्र समदर्शित्वं जीवन्मुक्तस्य लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: prāpte guṇadoṣaviśiṣṭe'sminsvabhāvena vilakṣaṇe | sarvatra samadarśitvaṃ jīvanmuktasya lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Looking on all alike, in this world of things marked by merits and faults and different by nature, is the mark of one liberated while living.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Looking on all alike, in this world of things marked by merits and faults and different by nature, is the mark of one liberated while living.।

verses.sanskrit: इष्टानिष्टार्थसम्प्राप्तौ समदर्शितयाऽऽत्मनि । उभयत्राविकारित्वं जीवन्मुक्तस्य लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: iṣṭāniṣṭārthasamprāptau samadarśitayā''tmani | ubhayatrāvikāritvaṃ jīvanmuktasya lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Equal vision in the Self on the coming of desired and undesired objects, and unchangedness in both, is the mark of one liberated while living.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Equal vision in आत्मा on the coming of desired and undesired objects, and unchangedness in both, is the mark of one liberated while living.।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मानन्दरसास्वादासक्तचित्ततया यतेः । अन्तर्बहिरविज्ञानं जीवन्मुक्तस्य लक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: brahmānandarasāsvādāsaktacittatayā yateḥ | antarbahiravijñānaṃ jīvanmuktasya lakṣaṇam
verses.translation: The ascetic's lack of awareness of within and without, because his mind is absorbed in tasting the bliss of Brahman, is the mark of one liberated while living.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The ascetic's lack of awareness of within and without, because his mind is absorbed in tasting the आनंद of परब्रह्म, is the mark of one liberated while living.।

verses.sanskrit: देहेन्द्रियादौ कर्तव्ये ममाहम्भाववर्जितः । औदासीन्येन यस्तिष्ठेत्स जीवन्मुक्तलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: dehendriyādau kartavye mamāhambhāvavarjitaḥ | audāsīnyena yastiṣṭhetsa jīvanmuktalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: One who, free of the feeling "mine" and "I" in body, senses and duties to be done, remains indifferent, has the mark of one liberated while living.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: One who, free of the feeling "mine" and "I" in body, senses and duties to be done, remains indifferent, has the mark of one liberated while living.।

verses.sanskrit: स जीवन्मुक्त इष्यते विज्ञात आत्मनो यस्य ब्रह्मभावः श्रुतेर्बलात् । भवबन्धविनिर्मुक्तः स जीवन्मुक्तलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: sa jīvanmukta iṣyate vijñāta ātmano yasya brahmabhāvaḥ śruterbalāt | bhavabandhavinirmuktaḥ sa jīvanmuktalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: He is held to be liberated while living who has known, by the power of scripture, his state as Brahman, and is free from the bonds of worldly existence.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: He is held to be liberated while living who has known, by the power of scripture, his state as परब्रह्म, and is से रहित the bonds of संसार.।

verses.sanskrit: स जीवन्मुक्त इष्यते देहेन्द्रियेष्वहम्भाव इदम्भावस्तदन्यके । यस्य नो भवतः क्वापि स जीवन्मुक्त इष्यते
verses.transliteration: sa jīvanmukta iṣyate dehendriyeṣvahambhāva idambhāvastadanyake | yasya no bhavataḥ kvāpi sa jīvanmukta iṣyate
verses.translation: He is held to be liberated while living in whom the feeling "I" in body and senses and the feeling "this" in what is other never arise anywhere.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: He is held to be liberated while living in whom the feeling "I" in body and senses and the feeling "this" in what is other never arise anywhere.।

verses.sanskrit: जीवेशोभयसंसाररूपदुर्वासनोज्झिता । सा सर्वदा भवेद्यस्य स जीवन्मुक्त इष्यते ॥ न प्रत्यग्ब्रह्मणोर्भेदं कदापि ब्रह्मसर्गयोः । प्रज्ञया यो विजानिति स जीवन्मुक्तलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: jīveśobhayasaṃsārarūpadurvāsanojjhitā | sā sarvadā bhavedyasya sa jīvanmukta iṣyate || na pratyagbrahmaṇorbhedaṃ kadāpi brahmasargayoḥ | prajñayā yo vijāniti sa jīvanmuktalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: He is held to be liberated while living who is always free of the evil habit-impressions of the soul, the Lord and the world; he who by wisdom never sees a difference between the inner Self and Brahman, or between Brahman and creation, has the mark of one liberated while living.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: He is held to be liberated while living who is always free of the evil habit-impressions of जीव, the Lord and the world; he who by wisdom never sees a difference between the inner Self and परब्रह्म, or between परब्रह्म and creation, has the mark of one liberated while living.।

verses.sanskrit: स जीवन्मुक्त इष्यते साधुभिः पूज्यमानेऽस्मिन्पीड्यमानेऽपि दुर्जनैः । समभावो भवेद्यस्य स जीवन्मुक्तलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: sa jīvanmukta iṣyate sādhubhiḥ pūjyamāne'sminpīḍyamāne'pi durjanaiḥ | samabhāvo bhavedyasya sa jīvanmuktalakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: He is held to be liberated while living who remains equal-minded when honoured by the good and tormented by the wicked.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: He is held to be liberated while living who remains equal-minded when honoured by the good and tormented by the wicked.।

verses.sanskrit: स जीवन्मुक्त इष्यते यत्र प्रविष्टा विषयाः परेरिता नदीप्रवाहा इव वारिराशौ । लिनन्ति सन्मात्रतया न विक्रियां उत्पादयन्त्येष यतिर्विमुक्तः
verses.transliteration: sa jīvanmukta iṣyate yatra praviṣṭā viṣayāḥ pareritā nadīpravāhā iva vārirāśau | linanti sanmātratayā na vikriyāṃ utpādayantyeṣa yatirvimuktaḥ
verses.translation: He is liberated — the ascetic in whom objects sent by others, having entered, dissolve as being alone, like river-streams in the ocean, and produce no change.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: He is liberated — the ascetic in whom objects sent by others, having entered, dissolve as being alone, like river-streams in the ocean, and produce no change.।

verses.sanskrit: विज्ञातब्रह्मतत्त्वस्य यथापूर्वं न संसृतिः । अस्ति चेन्न स विज्ञातब्रह्मभावो बहिर्मुखः
verses.transliteration: vijñātabrahmatattvasya yathāpūrvaṃ na saṃsṛtiḥ | asti cenna sa vijñātabrahmabhāvo bahirmukhaḥ
verses.translation: For one who has known the truth of Brahman there is no worldly existence as before; if there is, he has not known his state as Brahman, but is still turned outward.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: For one who has known the truth of परब्रह्म there is no संसार as before; if there is, he has not known his state as परब्रह्म, but is still turned outward.।

verses.sanskrit: प्राचीनवासनावेगादसौ संसरतीति चेत् । न सदेकत्वविज्ञानान्मन्दी भवति वासना
verses.transliteration: prācīnavāsanāvegādasau saṃsaratīti cet | na sadekatvavijñānānmandī bhavati vāsanā
verses.translation: If it be said that he still wanders because of the force of old habit-impressions — no, because of the knowledge of oneness with the Real, habit-impression grows weak.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: If it be said that he still wanders because of the force of old habit-impressions — no, because of the ज्ञान of oneness with the सत्य, habit-impression grows weak.।

verses.sanskrit: अत्यन्तकामुकस्यापि वृत्तिः कुण्ठति मातरि । तथैव ब्रह्मणि ज्ञाते पूर्णानन्दे मनीषिणः
verses.transliteration: atyantakāmukasyāpi vṛttiḥ kuṇṭhati mātari | tathaiva brahmaṇi jñāte pūrṇānande manīṣiṇaḥ
verses.translation: Even for the most lustful man, desire is checked toward his mother; so for the wise who has known Brahman, full bliss.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Even for the most lustful man, desire is checked toward his mother; so for the wise who has known परब्रह्म, full आनंद.।

verses.sanskrit: निदिध्यासनशीलस्य बाह्यप्रत्यय ईक्ष्यते । ब्रवीति श्रुतिरेतस्य प्रारब्धं फलदर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: nididhyāsanaśīlasya bāhyapratyaya īkṣyate | bravīti śrutiretasya prārabdhaṃ phaladarśanāt
verses.translation: In one devoted to meditation, outward perceptions are seen; scripture says these are his prarabdha, from seeing the fruit.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: In one devoted to meditation, outward perceptions are seen; scripture says these are his prarabdha, from seeing the fruit.।

verses.sanskrit: सुखाद्यनुभवो यावत्तावत्प्रारब्धमिष्यते । फलोदयः क्रियापूर्वो निष्क्रियो न हि कुत्रचित्
verses.transliteration: sukhādyanubhavo yāvattāvatprārabdhamiṣyate | phalodayaḥ kriyāpūrvo niṣkriyo na hi kutracit
verses.translation: As long as there is experience of pleasure and the like, so long prarabdha is held to exist; the arising of a fruit is preceded by action; without action, nowhere.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: As long as there is experience of pleasure and the like, so long prarabdha is held to exist; the arising of a fruit is preceded by action; without action, nowhere.।

verses.sanskrit: अहं ब्रह्मेति विज्ञानात्कल्पकोटिशतार्जितम् । सञ्चितं विलयं याति प्रबोधात्स्वप्नकर्मवत्
verses.transliteration: ahaṃ brahmeti vijñānātkalpakoṭiśatārjitam | sañcitaṃ vilayaṃ yāti prabodhātsvapnakarmavat
verses.translation: By the knowledge "I am Brahman," the accumulated (karma) gathered over hundreds of crores of ages dissolves, as the works of a dream on awakening.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: By the ज्ञान "I am परब्रह्म," the accumulated (karma) gathered over hundreds of crores of ages dissolves, as the works of a dream on awakening.।

verses.sanskrit: यत्कृतं स्वप्नवेलायां पुण्यं वा पापमुल्बणम् । सुप्तोत्थितस्य किन्तत्स्यात्स्वर्गाय नरकाय वा
verses.transliteration: yatkṛtaṃ svapnavelāyāṃ puṇyaṃ vā pāpamulbaṇam | suptotthitasya kintatsyātsvargāya narakāya vā
verses.translation: Whatever merit or terrible sin was done in a dream — what does it lead to for one who has risen from sleep: heaven or hell?
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Whatever merit or terrible sin was done in a dream — what does it lead to for one who has risen from sleep: heaven or hell?।

verses.sanskrit: स्वमसङ्गमुदासीनं परिज्ञाय नभो यथा । न श्लिष्यति च यत्किञ्चित्कदाचिद्भाविकर्मभिः
verses.transliteration: svamasaṅgamudāsīnaṃ parijñāya nabho yathā | na śliṣyati ca yatkiñcitkadācidbhāvikarmabhiḥ
verses.translation: Having known himself as unattached and indifferent like space, he is never touched by any karma that is to come.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Having known himself as unattached and indifferent like space, he is never touched by any karma that is to come.।

verses.sanskrit: श्लिष्यते यतिः किञ्चित् न नभो घटयोगेन सुरागन्धेन लिप्यते । तथात्मोपाधियोगेन तद्धर्मैर्नैव लिप्यते
verses.transliteration: śliṣyate yatiḥ kiñcit na nabho ghaṭayogena surāgandhena lipyate | tathātmopādhiyogena taddharmairnaiva lipyate
verses.translation: The ascetic is not touched at all; the sky is not smeared by the smell of liquor through contact with a pot; so the Self is not touched by the properties of its adjuncts through association with them.
verses.hindi: प्रारब्ध कर्म देह के लिए है, आत्मज्ञानी के लिए नहीं। जिसकी देह में आत्म-बुद्धि नहीं है, उसके लिए कोई प्रारब्ध नहीं बचता।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानोदयात्पुरारब्धं कर्मज्ञानान्न नश्यति । अदत्वा स्वफलं लक्ष्यमुद्दिश्योत्सृष्टबाणवत्
verses.transliteration: jñānodayātpurārabdhaṃ karmajñānānna naśyati | adatvā svaphalaṃ lakṣyamuddiśyotsṛṣṭabāṇavat
verses.translation: Prarabdha karma begun before the rise of knowledge is not destroyed by knowledge; it does not stop without giving its fruit, like an arrow shot at a target.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Prarabdha karma begun before the rise of ज्ञान is not destroyed by ज्ञान; it does not stop without giving its fruit, like an arrow shot at a target.।

verses.sanskrit: व्याघ्रबुद्ध्या विनिर्मुक्तो बाणः पश्चात्तु गोमतौ । न तिष्ठति छिनत्येव लक्ष्यं वेगेन निर्भरम्
verses.transliteration: vyāghrabuddhyā vinirmukto bāṇaḥ paścāttu gomatau | na tiṣṭhati chinatyeva lakṣyaṃ vegena nirbharam
verses.translation: An arrow loosed with the notion "tiger" — afterward, once it is seen to be a cow — does not stop; it pierces the target with full speed.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: An arrow loosed with the notion "tiger" — afterward, once it is seen to be a cow — does not stop; it pierces the target with full speed.।

verses.sanskrit: प्रारब्धं बलवत्तरं खलु विदां भोगेन तस्य क्षयः सम्यग्ज्ञानहुताशनेन विलयः प्राक्सञ्चितागामिनाम् । ब्रह्मात्मैक्यमवेक्ष्य तन्मयतया ये सर्वदा संस्थिताः तेषां तत्त्रितयं नहि क्वचिदपि ब्रह्मैव ते निर्गुणम्
verses.transliteration: prārabdhaṃ balavattaraṃ khalu vidāṃ bhogena tasya kṣayaḥ samyagjñānahutāśanena vilayaḥ prāksañcitāgāminām | brahmātmaikyamavekṣya tanmayatayā ye sarvadā saṃsthitāḥ teṣāṃ tattritayaṃ nahi kvacidapi brahmaiva te nirguṇam
verses.translation: Prarabdha is indeed stronger for the wise: it is exhausted by experience; accumulated and future works dissolve in the fire of right knowledge. For those who, seeing the oneness of Brahman and Self, are always established in identification with it, these three do not exist at all; they are Brahman itself, without qualities.
