verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Prarabdha is indeed stronger for the wise: it is exhausted by experience; accumulated and future works dissolve in the fire of right ज्ञान. For those who, seeing the oneness of परब्रह्म and Self, are always established in identification with it, these three do not exist at all; they are परब्रह्म itself, without qualities.।

verses.sanskrit: उपाधितादात्म्यविहीनकेवलब्रह्मात्मनैवात्मनि तिष्ठतो मुनेः । प्रारब्धसद्भावकथा न युक्ता स्वप्नार्थसम्बन्धकथेव जाग्रतः
verses.transliteration: upādhitādātmyavihīnakevalabrahmātmanaivātmani tiṣṭhato muneḥ | prārabdhasadbhāvakathā na yuktā svapnārthasambandhakatheva jāgrataḥ
verses.translation: For a sage who abides in the Self as Brahman alone, free of identification with adjuncts, talk of the presence of prarabdha is not proper, like talk of dream-objects for one awake.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: For a sage who abides in आत्मा as परब्रह्म alone, free of identification with adjuncts, talk of the presence of prarabdha is not proper, like talk of dream-objects for one awake.।

verses.sanskrit: न हि प्रबुद्धः प्रतिभासदेहे देहोपयोगिन्यपि च प्रपञ्चे । करोत्यहन्तां ममतामिदन्तां किन्तु स्वयं तिष्ठति जागरेण
verses.transliteration: na hi prabuddhaḥ pratibhāsadehe dehopayoginyapi ca prapañce | karotyahantāṃ mamatāmidantāṃ kintu svayaṃ tiṣṭhati jāgareṇa
verses.translation: An awakened person does not make "I," "mine" and "this" in an appearing body, or in the world which serves the body; rather he stays awake in himself.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: An awakened person does not make "I," "mine" and "this" in an appearing body, or in the world which serves शरीर/देह; rather he stays awake in himself.।

verses.sanskrit: न तस्य मिथ्यार्थसमर्थनेच्छा न सङ्ग्रहस्तज्जगतोऽपि दृष्टः । तत्रानुवृत्तिर्यदि चेन्मृषार्थे न निद्रया मुक्त इतीष्यते ध्रुवम्
verses.transliteration: na tasya mithyārthasamarthanecchā na saṅgrahastajjagato'pi dṛṣṭaḥ | tatrānuvṛttiryadi cenmṛṣārthe na nidrayā mukta itīṣyate dhruvam
verses.translation: He has no desire to justify false things, and no collecting of that world is seen; if he engaged in a false object, he would not be free of sleep.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: He has no desire to justify false things, and no collecting of that world is seen; if he engaged in a false object, he would not be free of sleep.।

verses.sanskrit: तद्वत्परे ब्रह्मणि वर्तमानः सदात्मना तिष्ठति नान्यदीक्षते । स्मृतिर्यथा स्वप्नविलोकितार्थे तथा विदः प्राशनमोचनादौ
verses.transliteration: tadvatpare brahmaṇi vartamānaḥ sadātmanā tiṣṭhati nānyadīkṣate | smṛtiryathā svapnavilokitārthe tathā vidaḥ prāśanamocanādau
verses.translation: Likewise, one who abides in the Supreme Brahman remains as the real Self and sees nothing else; his memory of eating, releasing and the like is like memory of things seen in a dream.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Likewise, one who abides in परमेश्वर परब्रह्म remains as the सत्य Self and sees nothing else; his memory of eating, releasing and the like is like memory of things seen in a dream.।

verses.sanskrit: कर्मणा निर्मितो देहः प्रारब्धं तस्य कल्प्यताम् । नानादेरात्मनो युक्तं नैवात्मा कर्मनिर्मितः
verses.transliteration: karmaṇā nirmito dehaḥ prārabdhaṃ tasya kalpyatām | nānāderātmano yuktaṃ naivātmā karmanirmitaḥ
verses.translation: The body is made by karma; let prarabdha be attributed to it. It is not proper for the beginningless Self; the Self is not made by karma.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: शरीर/देह is made by karma; let prarabdha be attributed to it. It is not proper for the beginningless Self; आत्मा is not made by karma.।

verses.sanskrit: अजो नित्यः शाश्वत इति ब्रूते श्रुतिरमोघवाक् । अजो नित्य इति ब्रूते श्रुतिरेषा त्वमोघवाक् तदात्मना तिष्ठतोऽस्य कुतः प्रारब्धकल्पना
verses.transliteration: ajo nityaḥ śāśvata iti brūte śrutiramoghavāk | ajo nitya iti brūte śrutireṣā tvamoghavāk tadātmanā tiṣṭhato'sya kutaḥ prārabdhakalpanā
verses.translation: "Unborn, eternal, everlasting" — so scripture, whose word never fails, says; for one who abides as that, where is the notion of prarabdha?
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Unborn, नित्य, everlasting" — so scripture, whose word never fails, says; for one who abides as that, where is the notion of prarabdha?।

verses.sanskrit: प्रारब्धं सिध्यति तदा यदा देहात्मना स्थितिः । देहात्मभावो नैवेष्टः प्रारब्धं त्यज्यतामतः
verses.transliteration: prārabdhaṃ sidhyati tadā yadā dehātmanā sthitiḥ | dehātmabhāvo naiveṣṭaḥ prārabdhaṃ tyajyatāmataḥ
verses.translation: Prarabdha holds when one stands as the body; but identification with the body is not accepted (by the wise); therefore give up prarabdha.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Prarabdha holds when one stands as शरीर/देह; but identification with शरीर/देह is not accepted (by the wise); therefore give up prarabdha.।

verses.sanskrit: शरीरस्यापि प्रारब्धकल्पना भ्रान्तिरेव हि । अध्यस्तस्य कुतः सत्त्वमसत्यस्य कुतो जनिः । सत्त्वमसत्त्वस्य अजातस्य कुतो नाशः प्रारब्धमसतः कुतः
verses.transliteration: śarīrasyāpi prārabdhakalpanā bhrāntireva hi | adhyastasya kutaḥ sattvamasatyasya kuto janiḥ | sattvamasattvasya ajātasya kuto nāśaḥ prārabdhamasataḥ kutaḥ
verses.translation: The attribution of prarabdha even to the body is only delusion; how can the superimposed exist? How can the unreal be born? How can the unborn be destroyed? How can prarabdha exist for the unreal?
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The attribution of prarabdha even to शरीर/देह is only मोह/भ्रम; how can the superimposed exist? How can the मिथ्या be born? How can the unborn be destroyed? How can prarabdha exist for the मिथ्या?।

verses.sanskrit: ज्ञानेनाज्ञानकार्यस्य समूलस्य लयो यदि । तिष्ठत्ययं कथं देह इति शङ्कावतो जडान्
verses.transliteration: jñānenājñānakāryasya samūlasya layo yadi | tiṣṭhatyayaṃ kathaṃ deha iti śaṅkāvato jaḍān
verses.translation: If by knowledge the effect of ignorance is destroyed with its root, "how does this body stand?" — this doubt troubles the dull.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: If by ज्ञान the effect of अविद्या/अज्ञान is destroyed with its root, "how does this body stand?" — this doubt troubles the dull.।

verses.sanskrit: समाधातुं बाह्यदृष्ट्या प्रारब्धं वदति श्रुतिः । न तु देहादिसत्यत्वबोधनाय विपश्चिताम् । यतः श्रुतेरभिप्रायः परमार्थैकगोचरः
verses.transliteration: samādhātuṃ bāhyadṛṣṭyā prārabdhaṃ vadati śrutiḥ | na tu dehādisatyatvabodhanāya vipaścitām | yataḥ śruterabhiprāyaḥ paramārthaikagocaraḥ
verses.translation: Scripture speaks of prarabdha to satisfy such people from the external point of view, and not to teach the wise the truth of the body and the like; for the meaning of scripture has for its object the ultimate reality alone.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Scripture speaks of prarabdha to satisfy such people from the external point of view, and not to teach the wise the truth of शरीर/देह and the like; for the meaning of scripture has for its object the ultimate reality alone.।

verses.sanskrit: extra परिपूर्णमनाद्यन्तमप्रमेयमविक्रियम् । एकमेवाद्वयं ब्रह्म नेह नानास्ति किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: extra paripūrṇamanādyantamaprameyamavikriyam | ekamevādvayaṃ brahma neha nānāsti kiñcana
verses.translation: Full, without beginning or end, immeasurable, unchanging — Brahman, one alone, non-dual; there is no multiplicity here at all.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Full, without beginning or end, immeasurable, unchanging — परब्रह्म, one alone, अद्वैत; there is no multiplicity here at all.।

verses.sanskrit: सद्घनं चिद्घनं नित्यमानन्दघनमक्रियम् । एकमेवाद्वयं ब्रह्म नेह नानास्ति किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: sadghanaṃ cidghanaṃ nityamānandaghanamakriyam | ekamevādvayaṃ brahma neha nānāsti kiñcana
verses.translation: A mass of being, a mass of consciousness, eternal, a mass of bliss, actionless — Brahman, one alone, non-dual; there is no multiplicity here at all.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: A mass of being, a mass of चैतन्य, नित्य, a mass of आनंद, actionless — परब्रह्म, one alone, अद्वैत; there is no multiplicity here at all.।

verses.sanskrit: प्रत्यगेकरसं पूर्णमनन्तं सर्वतोमुखम् । एकमेवाद्वयं ब्रह्म नेह नानास्ति किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: pratyagekarasaṃ pūrṇamanantaṃ sarvatomukham | ekamevādvayaṃ brahma neha nānāsti kiñcana
verses.translation: Inner, of one taste, full, infinite, facing all sides — Brahman, one alone, non-dual; there is no multiplicity here at all.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Inner, of one taste, full, infinite, facing all sides — परब्रह्म, one alone, अद्वैत; there is no multiplicity here at all.।

verses.sanskrit: अहेयमनुपादेयमनादेयमनाश्रयम् । मनाधेयमना एकमेवाद्वयं ब्रह्म नेह नानास्ति किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: aheyamanupādeyamanādeyamanāśrayam | manādheyamanā ekamevādvayaṃ brahma neha nānāsti kiñcana
verses.translation: Not to be given up, not to be taken up, not to be imposed, without support — Brahman, one alone, non-dual; there is no multiplicity here at all.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Not to be given up, not to be taken up, not to be imposed, without support — परब्रह्म, one alone, अद्वैत; there is no multiplicity here at all.।

verses.sanskrit: निर्गुणं निष्कलं सूक्ष्मं निर्विकल्पं निरञ्जनम् । एकमेवाद्वयं ब्रह्म नेह नानास्ति किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: nirguṇaṃ niṣkalaṃ sūkṣmaṃ nirvikalpaṃ nirañjanam | ekamevādvayaṃ brahma neha nānāsti kiñcana
verses.translation: Without qualities, without parts, subtle, free of alternatives, stainless — Brahman, one alone, non-dual; there is no multiplicity here at all.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Without qualities, without parts, subtle, free of alternatives, stainless — परब्रह्म, one alone, अद्वैत; there is no multiplicity here at all.।

verses.sanskrit: अनिरूप्य स्वरूपं यन्मनोवाचामगोचरम् । एकमेवाद्वयं ब्रह्म नेह नानास्ति किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: anirūpya svarūpaṃ yanmanovācāmagocaram | ekamevādvayaṃ brahma neha nānāsti kiñcana
verses.translation: Whose nature cannot be pointed out, beyond the reach of mind and speech — Brahman, one alone, non-dual; there is no multiplicity here at all.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Whose nature cannot be pointed out, beyond the reach of mind and speech — परब्रह्म, one alone, अद्वैत; there is no multiplicity here at all.।

verses.sanskrit: सत्समृद्धं स्वतःसिद्धं शुद्धं बुद्धमनीदृशम् । एकमेवाद्वयं ब्रह्म नेह नानास्ति किञ्चन
verses.transliteration: satsamṛddhaṃ svataḥsiddhaṃ śuddhaṃ buddhamanīdṛśam | ekamevādvayaṃ brahma neha nānāsti kiñcana
verses.translation: Rich in being, self-established, pure, awake, incomparable — Brahman, one alone, non-dual; there is no multiplicity here at all.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Rich in being, self-established, pure, awake, incomparable — परब्रह्म, one alone, अद्वैत; there is no multiplicity here at all.।

verses.sanskrit: निरस्तरागा विनिरस्तभोगाः शान्ताः सुदान्ता यतयो महान्तः । विज्ञाय तत्त्वं परमेतदन्ते प्राप्ताः परां निर्वृतिमात्मयोगात्
verses.transliteration: nirastarāgā vinirastabhogāḥ śāntāḥ sudāntā yatayo mahāntaḥ | vijñāya tattvaṃ parametadante prāptāḥ parāṃ nirvṛtimātmayogāt
verses.translation: Great ascetics, free from attachment, having given up enjoyments, tranquil, well self-controlled, having known this supreme truth, attain at the end the highest peace through union with the Self.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Great ascetics, से रहित attachment, having given up enjoyments, tranquil, well self-controlled, having known this supreme truth, attain at the end the highest peace through union with आत्मा.।

verses.sanskrit: भवानपीदं परतत्त्वमात्मनः स्वरूपमानन्दघनं विचार्य । निचाय्य विधूय मोहं स्वमनःप्रकल्पितं मुक्तः कृतार्थो भवतु प्रबुद्धः
verses.transliteration: bhavānapīdaṃ paratattvamātmanaḥ svarūpamānandaghanaṃ vicārya | nicāyya vidhūya mohaṃ svamanaḥprakalpitaṃ muktaḥ kṛtārtho bhavatu prabuddhaḥ
verses.translation: You too, having reflected on this supreme truth, the Self's own nature, a mass of bliss, and having shaken off the delusion imagined by your own mind, be liberated, fulfilled and awakened.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: You too, having reflected on this supreme truth, आत्मा's own nature, a mass of आनंद, and having shaken off the मोह/भ्रम imagined by your own mind, be liberated, fulfilled and awakened.।

verses.sanskrit: समाधिना साधुविनिश्चलात्मना पश्यात्मतत्त्वं स्फुटबोधचक्षुषा । निःसंशयं सम्यगवेक्षितश्चेच्छ्रुतः पदार्थो न पुनर्विकल्प्यते
verses.transliteration: samādhinā sādhuviniścalātmanā paśyātmatattvaṃ sphuṭabodhacakṣuṣā | niḥsaṃśayaṃ samyagavekṣitaścecchrutaḥ padārtho na punarvikalpyate
verses.translation: By absorption, with a well-steadied mind, behold the truth of the Self with the eye of clear knowledge; if what has been heard is examined without doubt and rightly, it is not questioned again.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: By absorption, with a well-steadied mind, behold the truth of आत्मा with the eye of clear ज्ञान; if what has been heard is examined without doubt and rightly, it is not questioned again.।

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्विकल्पते स्वस्याविद्याबन्धसम्बन्धमोक्षात्सत्यज्ञानानन्दरूपात्मलब्धौ । शास्त्रं युक्तिर्देशिकोक्तिः प्रमाणं चान्तःसिद्धा स्वानुभूतिः प्रमाणम्
verses.transliteration: punarvikalpate svasyāvidyābandhasambandhamokṣātsatyajñānānandarūpātmalabdhau | śāstraṃ yuktirdeśikoktiḥ pramāṇaṃ cāntaḥsiddhā svānubhūtiḥ pramāṇam
verses.translation: In gaining the Self, whose nature is truth, knowledge and bliss, and in release from the bond of ignorance, scripture, reasoning and the teacher's words are authority, and the inwardly established experience of one's own Self is the (final) authority.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: In gaining आत्मा, whose nature is truth, ज्ञान and आनंद, and in release from the bond of अविद्या/अज्ञान, scripture, reasoning and सद्गुरु's words are authority, and the inwardly established experience of one's own Self is the (final) authority.।

verses.sanskrit: बन्धो मोक्षश्च तृप्तिश्च चिन्ताऽऽरोग्यक्षुधादयः । स्वेनैव वेद्या यज्ज्ञानं परेषामानुमानिकम्
verses.transliteration: bandho mokṣaśca tṛptiśca cintā''rogyakṣudhādayaḥ | svenaiva vedyā yajjñānaṃ pareṣāmānumānikam
verses.translation: Bondage, liberation, contentment, worry, health, hunger and the like are known by oneself alone; the knowledge of others is only inference.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Bondage, मोक्ष, contentment, worry, health, hunger and the like are known by oneself alone; the ज्ञान of others is only inference.।

verses.sanskrit: तटस्थिता बोधयन्ति गुरवः श्रुतयो यथा । प्रज्ञयैव तरेद्विद्वानीश्वरानुगृहीतया
verses.transliteration: taṭasthitā bodhayanti guravaḥ śrutayo yathā | prajñayaiva taredvidvānīśvarānugṛhītayā
verses.translation: Teachers and scriptures instruct as bystanders; the wise man crosses only by wisdom, by the grace of the Lord.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Teachers and scriptures instruct as bystanders; विद्वान्/ज्ञानी crosses only by wisdom, by the grace of the Lord.।

verses.sanskrit: स्वानुभूत्या स्वयं ज्ञात्वा स्वमात्मानमखण्डितम् । संसिद्धः सम्मुखं तिष्ठेन्निर्विकल्पात्मनाऽऽत्मनि
verses.transliteration: svānubhūtyā svayaṃ jñātvā svamātmānamakhaṇḍitam | saṃsiddhaḥ sammukhaṃ tiṣṭhennirvikalpātmanā''tmani
verses.translation: Having himself known by his own experience his undivided Self, the perfected one should stand facing it, in the Self by the Self, free of alternatives.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Having himself known by his own experience his undivided Self, the perfected one should stand facing it, in आत्मा by आत्मा, free of alternatives.।

verses.sanskrit: सुसुखं तिष्ठेन् वेदान्तसिद्धान्तनिरुक्तिरेषा ब्रह्मैव जीवः सकलं जगच्च । अखण्डरूपस्थितिरेव मोक्षो ब्रह्माद्वितीये श्रुतयः प्रमाणम्
verses.transliteration: susukhaṃ tiṣṭhen vedāntasiddhāntaniruktireṣā brahmaiva jīvaḥ sakalaṃ jagacca | akhaṇḍarūpasthitireva mokṣo brahmādvitīye śrutayaḥ pramāṇam
verses.translation: This is the exposition of the conclusions of the Vedanta: Brahman alone is the individual, and the whole world; liberation is abiding in the undivided form; scripture is the authority for Brahman being without a second.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: This is the exposition of the conclusions of the Vedanta: परब्रह्म alone is the individual, and the whole world; मोक्ष is abiding in the undivided form; scripture is the authority for परब्रह्म being without a second.।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्माद्वितीयं इति गुरुवचनाच्छ्रुतिप्रमाणात् परमवगम्य सतत्त्वमात्मयुक्त्या । प्रशमितकरणः समाहितात्मा क्वचिदचलाकृतिरात्मनिष्ठतोऽभूत्
verses.transliteration: brahmādvitīyaṃ iti guruvacanācchrutipramāṇāt paramavagamya satattvamātmayuktyā | praśamitakaraṇaḥ samāhitātmā kvacidacalākṛtirātmaniṣṭhato'bhūt
verses.translation: Having known the supreme Truth — "Brahman is non-dual" — by the words of the teacher, by the authority of scripture and by his own reasoning, with senses stilled and self collected, he became established in the Self, with an unmoving form.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Having known परमेश्वर Truth — "परब्रह्म is अद्वैत" — by the words of सद्गुरु, by the authority of scripture and by his own reasoning, with senses stilled and self collected, he became established in आत्मा, with an unmoving form.।

verses.sanskrit: आत्मनिष्ठितो किञ्चित्कालं समाधाय परे ब्रह्मणि मानसम् । कञ्चित्कालं उत्थाय परमानन्दादिदं वचनमब्रवीत्
verses.transliteration: ātmaniṣṭhito kiñcitkālaṃ samādhāya pare brahmaṇi mānasam | kañcitkālaṃ utthāya paramānandādidaṃ vacanamabravīt
verses.translation: Having concentrated the mind for some time on the Supreme Brahman, established in the Self, and having risen after a while from supreme bliss, he spoke these words.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Having concentrated मन for some time on परमेश्वर परब्रह्म, established in आत्मा, and having risen after a while from supreme आनंद, he spoke these words.।

verses.sanskrit: व्युत्थाय बुद्धिर्विनष्टा गलिता प्रवृत्तिः ब्रह्मात्मनोरेकतयाऽधिगत्या । इदं न जानेऽप्यनिदं न जाने किं वा कियद्वा सुखमस्त्यपारम्
verses.transliteration: vyutthāya buddhirvinaṣṭā galitā pravṛttiḥ brahmātmanorekatayā'dhigatyā | idaṃ na jāne'pyanidaṃ na jāne kiṃ vā kiyadvā sukhamastyapāram
verses.translation: "On rising, my intellect is destroyed and activity has slipped away, through the realisation of the oneness of Brahman and the Self. I do not know this, nor do I know 'not this'; I know neither what nor how much happiness there is — it is boundless."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: On rising, my intellect is destroyed and activity has slipped away, through the realisation of the oneness of परब्रह्म and आत्मा. I do not know this, nor do I know 'not this'; I know neither what nor how much happiness there is — it is boundless.।

verses.sanskrit: सुखमस्य पारम् वाचा वक्तुमशक्यमेव मनसा मन्तुं न वा शक्यते स्वानन्दामृतपूरपूरितपरब्रह्माम्बुधेर्वैभवम् । अम्भोराशिविशीर्णवार्षिकशिलाभावं भजन्मे मनो यस्यांशांशलवे विलीनमधुनाऽऽनन्दात्मना निर्वृतम्
verses.transliteration: sukhamasya pāram vācā vaktumaśakyameva manasā mantuṃ na vā śakyate svānandāmṛtapūrapūritaparabrahmāmbudhervaibhavam | ambhorāśiviśīrṇavārṣikaśilābhāvaṃ bhajanme mano yasyāṃśāṃśalave vilīnamadhunā''nandātmanā nirvṛtam
verses.translation: "The majesty of the ocean of Supreme Brahman, filled with the flood of the nectar of the bliss of the Self, cannot be told by speech or thought. My mind, taking on the nature of a hailstone dissolved in the ocean, has merged in a tiny fraction of it and is now at rest, of the nature of bliss."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The majesty of the ocean of Supreme परब्रह्म, filled with the flood of the nectar of the आनंद of आत्मा, cannot be told by speech or thought. My mind, taking on the nature of a hailstone dissolved in the ocean, has merged in a tiny fraction of it and is now at rest, of the nature of आनंद.।

verses.sanskrit: क्व गतं केन वा नीतं कुत्र लीनमिदं जगत् । अधुनैव मया दृष्टं नास्ति किं महदद्भुतम्
verses.transliteration: kva gataṃ kena vā nītaṃ kutra līnamidaṃ jagat | adhunaiva mayā dṛṣṭaṃ nāsti kiṃ mahadadbhutam
verses.translation: "Where has this world gone? By whom was it taken? In what has it dissolved? It was seen by me just now — and it is not; is that not a great wonder?"
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Where has this world gone? By whom was it taken? In what has it dissolved? It was seen by me just now — and it is not; is that not a great wonder?।

verses.sanskrit: किं हेयं किमुपादेयं किमन्यत्किं विलक्षणम् । अखण्डानन्दपीयूषपूर्णे ब्रह्ममहार्णवे
verses.transliteration: kiṃ heyaṃ kimupādeyaṃ kimanyatkiṃ vilakṣaṇam | akhaṇḍānandapīyūṣapūrṇe brahmamahārṇave
verses.translation: "What is to be given up, what to be taken? What is other, what is different, in the great ocean of Brahman, full of the nectar of undivided bliss?"
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: What is to be given up, what to be taken? What is other, what is different, in the great ocean of परब्रह्म, full of the nectar of undivided आनंद?।

verses.sanskrit: न किञ्चिदत्र पश्यामि न शृणोमि न वेद्म्यहम् । स्वात्मनैव सदानन्दरूपेणास्मि विलक्षणः
verses.transliteration: na kiñcidatra paśyāmi na śṛṇomi na vedmyaham | svātmanaiva sadānandarūpeṇāsmi vilakṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "I see nothing here, hear nothing, know nothing; I am distinct, by my own Self, of the form of ever-lasting bliss."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: I see nothing here, hear nothing, know nothing; I am distinct, by my own Self, of the form of ever-lasting आनंद.।

verses.sanskrit: नमो नमस्ते गुरवे महात्मने विमुक्तसङ्गाय सदुत्तमाय । नित्याद्वयानन्दरसस्वरूपिणे भूम्ने सदाऽपारदयाम्बुधाम्ने
verses.transliteration: namo namaste gurave mahātmane vimuktasaṅgāya saduttamāya | nityādvayānandarasasvarūpiṇe bhūmne sadā'pāradayāmbudhāmne
verses.translation: "Homage, homage to you, teacher, great soul, free from attachment, the best of the good; embodiment of the taste of eternal, non-dual bliss, vast, ever the abode of boundless compassion."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Homage, homage to you, teacher, great soul, से रहित attachment, the best of the good; embodiment of the taste of नित्य, अद्वैत आनंद, vast, ever the abode of boundless compassion.।

verses.sanskrit: यत्कटाक्षशशिसान्द्रचन्द्रिकापातधूतभवतापजश्रमः । प्राप्तवानहमखण्डवैभवानन्दमात्मपदमक्षयं क्षणात्
verses.transliteration: yatkaṭākṣaśaśisāndracandrikāpātadhūtabhavatāpajaśramaḥ | prāptavānahamakhaṇḍavaibhavānandamātmapadamakṣayaṃ kṣaṇāt
verses.translation: "By the falling of the thick moonlight of whose glance the weariness born of the heat of worldly existence has been shaken off, I have in a moment reached the imperishable state of the Self, the bliss of undivided majesty."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: By the falling of the thick moonlight of whose glance the weariness born of the heat of संसार has been shaken off, I have in a moment reached the imperishable state of आत्मा, the आनंद of undivided majesty.।

verses.sanskrit: धन्योऽहं कृतकृत्योऽहं विमुक्तोऽहं भवग्रहात् । नित्यानन्दस्वरूपोऽहं पूर्णोऽहं त्वदनुग्रहात्
verses.transliteration: dhanyo'haṃ kṛtakṛtyo'haṃ vimukto'haṃ bhavagrahāt | nityānandasvarūpo'haṃ pūrṇo'haṃ tvadanugrahāt
verses.translation: "Blessed am I, my task is done; I am liberated from the seizure of worldly existence; I am of the nature of eternal bliss, I am full, by your grace."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Blessed am I, my task is done; I am liberated from the seizure of संसार; I am of the nature of नित्य आनंद, I am full, by your grace.।

verses.sanskrit: असङ्गोऽहमनङ्गोऽहमलिङ्गोऽहमभङ्गुरः । प्रशान्तोऽहमनन्तोऽहममलोऽहं चिरन्तनः
verses.transliteration: asaṅgo'hamanaṅgo'hamaliṅgo'hamabhaṅguraḥ | praśānto'hamananto'hamamalo'haṃ cirantanaḥ
verses.translation: "I am unattached, I am bodiless, I am markless, I am imperishable; I am tranquil, I am infinite, I am stainless, I am ancient."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: I am unattached, I am bodiless, I am markless, I am imperishable; I am tranquil, I am infinite, I am stainless, I am ancient.।

verses.sanskrit: ऽहमतान्तोऽहं अकर्ताहमभोक्ताहमविकारोऽहमक्रियः । शुद्धबोधस्वरूपोऽहं केवलोऽहं सदाशिवः
verses.transliteration: 'hamatānto'haṃ akartāhamabhoktāhamavikāro'hamakriyaḥ | śuddhabodhasvarūpo'haṃ kevalo'haṃ sadāśivaḥ
verses.translation: "I am the unwearied; I am not the doer, not the enjoyer; I am unchanging, actionless; I am of the nature of pure knowledge; I am the alone, the ever-auspicious (Sadashiva)."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: I am the unwearied; I am not the doer, not the enjoyer; I am unchanging, actionless; I am of the nature of pure ज्ञान; I am the alone, the ever-auspicious (Sadashiva).।

verses.sanskrit: द्रष्टुः श्रोतुर्वक्तुः कर्तुर्भोक्तुर्विभिन्न एवाहम् । नित्यनिरन्तरनिष्क्रियनिःसीमासङ्गपूर्णबोधात्मा
verses.transliteration: draṣṭuḥ śroturvaktuḥ karturbhokturvibhinna evāham | nityanirantaraniṣkriyaniḥsīmāsaṅgapūrṇabodhātmā
verses.translation: I am different from the seer, hearer, speaker, doer and enjoyer; I am the Self of knowledge, eternal, continuous, actionless, limitless, unattached and full.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: I am different from the seer, hearer, speaker, doer and enjoyer; I am आत्मा of ज्ञान, नित्य, continuous, actionless, limitless, unattached and full.।

verses.sanskrit: नाहमिदं नाहमदोऽप्युभयोरवभासकं परं शुद्धम् । बाह्याभ्यन्तरशून्यं पूर्णं ब्रह्माद्वितीयमेवाहम्
verses.transliteration: nāhamidaṃ nāhamado'pyubhayoravabhāsakaṃ paraṃ śuddham | bāhyābhyantaraśūnyaṃ pūrṇaṃ brahmādvitīyamevāham
verses.translation: I am not this, nor that; I am the supreme, pure illuminator of both, empty of outside and inside — the full, non-dual Brahman.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: I am not this, nor that; I am परमेश्वर, pure illuminator of both, empty of outside and inside — the full, अद्वैत परब्रह्म.।

verses.sanskrit: निरुपममनादितत्त्वं त्वमहमिदमद इति कल्पनादूरम् । नित्यानन्दैकरसं सत्यं ब्रह्माद्वितीयमेवाहम्
verses.transliteration: nirupamamanāditattvaṃ tvamahamidamada iti kalpanādūram | nityānandaikarasaṃ satyaṃ brahmādvitīyamevāham
verses.translation: The incomparable, beginningless reality, far from the imagining "you, I, this, that," of one taste of eternal bliss, the truth — Brahman, non-dual, am I.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The incomparable, beginningless reality, far from the imagining "you, I, this, that," of one taste of नित्य आनंद, the truth — परब्रह्म, अद्वैत, am I.।

verses.sanskrit: नारायणोऽहं नरकान्तकोऽहं पुरान्तकोऽहं पुरुषोऽहमीशः । अखण्डबोधोऽहमशेषसाक्षी निरीश्वरोऽहं निरहं च निर्ममः
verses.transliteration: nārāyaṇo'haṃ narakāntako'haṃ purāntako'haṃ puruṣo'hamīśaḥ | akhaṇḍabodho'hamaśeṣasākṣī nirīśvaro'haṃ nirahaṃ ca nirmamaḥ
verses.translation: I am Narayana, I am the destroyer of Naraka, I am the destroyer of the (three) cities; I am the Person, I am the Lord. I am undivided knowledge, the witness of all; I have no Lord over me, no ego and no possessiveness.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: I am Narayana, I am the destroyer of Naraka, I am the destroyer of the (three) cities; I am the Person, I am the Lord. I am undivided ज्ञान, the witness of all; I have no Lord over me, no ego and no possessiveness.।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वेषु भूतेष्वहमेव संस्थितो ज्ञानात्मनाऽन्तर्बहिराश्रयः सन् । भोक्ता च भोग्यं स्वयमेव सर्वं यद्यत्पृथग्दृष्टमिदन्तया पुरा
verses.transliteration: sarveṣu bhūteṣvahameva saṃsthito jñānātmanā'ntarbahirāśrayaḥ san | bhoktā ca bhogyaṃ svayameva sarvaṃ yadyatpṛthagdṛṣṭamidantayā purā
verses.translation: I alone abide in all beings, as the Self of knowledge, the support within and without; I am the enjoyer and the enjoyed, myself all — whatever was seen before as separate "this."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: I alone abide in all beings, as आत्मा of ज्ञान, the support within and without; I am the enjoyer and the enjoyed, myself all — whatever was seen before as separate "this.।

verses.sanskrit: मय्यखण्डसुखाम्भोधौ बहुधा विश्ववीचयः । उत्पद्यन्ते विलीयन्ते मायामारुतविभ्रमात्
verses.transliteration: mayyakhaṇḍasukhāmbhodhau bahudhā viśvavīcayaḥ | utpadyante vilīyante māyāmārutavibhramāt
verses.translation: In me, the ocean of undivided bliss, the waves of the universe arise and dissolve in many ways, through the play of the wind of Maya.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: In me, the ocean of undivided आनंद, the waves of the universe arise and dissolve in many ways, through the play of the wind of Maya.।

verses.sanskrit: स्थुलादिभावा मयि कल्पिता भ्रमादारोपितानुस्फुरणेन लोकैः । काले यथा कल्पकवत्सरायणर्त्वादयो निष्कलनिर्विकल्पे
verses.transliteration: sthulādibhāvā mayi kalpitā bhramādāropitānusphuraṇena lokaiḥ | kāle yathā kalpakavatsarāyaṇartvādayo niṣkalanirvikalpe
verses.translation: Gross and other states are imagined in me through delusion, and are superimposed by people who perceive them, as, in time, the seasons, half-years, years and ages are imagined in the partless and free of alternatives.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Gross and other states are imagined in me through मोह/भ्रम, and are superimposed by people who perceive them, as, in time, the seasons, half-years, years and ages are imagined in the partless and free of alternatives.।

verses.sanskrit: आरोपितं नाश्रयदूषकं भवेत् कदापि मूढैरतिदोषदूषितैः । मूढैर्मति नार्द्रीकरोत्यूषरभूमिभागं मरीचिकावारि महाप्रवाहः
verses.transliteration: āropitaṃ nāśrayadūṣakaṃ bhavet kadāpi mūḍhairatidoṣadūṣitaiḥ | mūḍhairmati nārdrīkarotyūṣarabhūmibhāgaṃ marīcikāvāri mahāpravāhaḥ
verses.translation: What is superimposed never harms its substratum, though the deluded are affected by great faults; the great flood of a mirage does not moisten even a patch of barren ground.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: What is superimposed never harms its substratum, though the deluded are affected by great faults; the great flood of a mirage does not moisten even a patch of barren ground.।

verses.sanskrit: आकाशवल्लेपविदूरगोऽहं आदित्यवद्भास्यविलक्षणोऽहम् । अहार्यवन्नित्यविनिश्चलोऽहं अम्भोधिवत्पारविवर्जितोऽहम्
verses.transliteration: ākāśavallepavidūrago'haṃ ādityavadbhāsyavilakṣaṇo'ham | ahāryavannityaviniścalo'haṃ ambhodhivatpāravivarjito'ham
verses.translation: I am far from being tainted, like space; I am different from what is illumined, like the sun; I am always unmoving, like a mountain; I am without a shore, like the ocean.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: I am far from being tainted, like space; I am different from what is illumined, like the sun; I am always unmoving, like a mountain; I am without a shore, like the ocean.।

verses.sanskrit: न मे देहेन सम्बन्धो मेघेनेव विहायसः । अतः कुतो मे तद्धर्मा जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्तयः
verses.transliteration: na me dehena sambandho megheneva vihāyasaḥ | ataḥ kuto me taddharmā jāgratsvapnasuṣuptayaḥ
verses.translation: I have no connection with the body, as the sky has none with a cloud; so how can the states of waking, dream and deep sleep, which are its properties, be mine?
verses.hindi: शिष्य का अनुभव: ‘अहो! मैं धन्य हूँ, कृतकृत्य हूँ! मैं भव-बंधन से मुक्त हो गया! मैं नित्य, शुद्ध, बुद्ध, मुक्त, अद्वैत, परमानंद स्वरूप परब्रह्म हूँ!’

verses.sanskrit: उपाधिरायाति स एव गच्छति स एव कर्माणि करोति भुङ्क्ते । स एव जीर्यन् म्रियते सदाहं कुलाद्रिवन्निश्चल एव संस्थितः
verses.transliteration: upādhirāyāti sa eva gacchati sa eva karmāṇi karoti bhuṅkte | sa eva jīryan mriyate sadāhaṃ kulādrivanniścala eva saṃsthitaḥ
verses.translation: The adjunct comes and goes; it alone acts and enjoys; it alone decays and dies. I always stay unmoving like a great mountain.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The adjunct comes and goes; it alone acts and enjoys; it alone decays and dies. I always stay unmoving like a great mountain.।

verses.sanskrit: न मे प्रवृत्तिर्न च मे निवृत्तिः सदैकरूपस्य निरंशकस्य । एकात्मको यो निविडो निरन्तरो व्योमेव पूर्णः स कथं नु चेष्टते
verses.transliteration: na me pravṛttirna ca me nivṛttiḥ sadaikarūpasya niraṃśakasya | ekātmako yo niviḍo nirantaro vyomeva pūrṇaḥ sa kathaṃ nu ceṣṭate
verses.translation: I have neither engagement nor withdrawal, being always of one form and without parts. How can that which is one Self, dense, continuous, full like space, exert itself?
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: I have neither engagement nor withdrawal, being always of one form and without parts. How can that which is one Self, dense, continuous, full like space, exert itself?।

verses.sanskrit: पुण्यानि पापानि निरिन्द्रियस्य निश्चेतसो निर्विकृतेर्निराकृतेः । कुतो ममाखण्डसुखानुभूतेः ब्रूते ह्यनन्वागतमित्यपि श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: puṇyāni pāpāni nirindriyasya niścetaso nirvikṛternirākṛteḥ | kuto mamākhaṇḍasukhānubhūteḥ brūte hyananvāgatamityapi śrutiḥ
verses.translation: How can merit and sin belong to me, who am without senses, without mind, without change and without form, the experience of undivided bliss? Scripture says, "It is not followed by (good and evil)."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: How can merit and sin belong to me, who am without senses, without mind, without change and without form, the experience of undivided आनंद? Scripture says, "It is not followed by (good and evil).।

verses.sanskrit: छायया स्पृष्टमुष्णं वा शीतं वा सुष्ठु दुःष्ठु वा । न स्पृशत्येव यत्किञ्चित्पुरुषं तद्विलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: chāyayā spṛṣṭamuṣṇaṃ vā śītaṃ vā suṣṭhu duḥṣṭhu vā | na spṛśatyeva yatkiñcitpuruṣaṃ tadvilakṣaṇam
verses.translation: Whatever heat or cold, good or bad, touches the shadow does not touch the person at all, who is different from it.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Whatever heat or cold, good or bad, touches the shadow does not touch the person at all, who is different from it.।

verses.sanskrit: न साक्षिणं साक्ष्यधर्माः संस्पृशन्ति विलक्षणम् । अविकारमुदासीनं गृहधर्माः प्रदीपवत् । देहेन्द्रियमनोधर्मा नैवात्मानं स्पृशन्त्यहो
verses.transliteration: na sākṣiṇaṃ sākṣyadharmāḥ saṃspṛśanti vilakṣaṇam | avikāramudāsīnaṃ gṛhadharmāḥ pradīpavat | dehendriyamanodharmā naivātmānaṃ spṛśantyaho
verses.translation: The properties of what is witnessed do not touch the witness, who is distinct; like the properties of a house to the lamp that lights it, the properties of body, senses and mind never touch the Self.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The properties of what is witnessed do not touch the witness, who is distinct; like the properties of a house to the lamp that lights it, the properties of body, senses and mind never touch आत्मा.।

verses.sanskrit: extra रवेर्यथा कर्मणि साक्षिभावो वह्नेर्यथा दाहनियामकत्वम् । वाऽयसि दाहकत्वम् रज्जोर्यथाऽऽरोपितवस्तुसङ्गः तथैव कूटस्थचिदात्मनो मे
verses.transliteration: extra raveryathā karmaṇi sākṣibhāvo vahneryathā dāhaniyāmakatvam | vā'yasi dāhakatvam rajjoryathā''ropitavastusaṅgaḥ tathaiva kūṭasthacidātmano me
verses.translation: As the sun is the witness of actions, as fire has the power to burn (iron), and as a rope has connection with what is superimposed on it, so too is it with me, the unchanging Self of consciousness.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: As the sun is the witness of actions, as fire has the power to burn (iron), and as a rope has connection with what is superimposed on it, so too is it with me, the unchanging Self of चैतन्य.।

verses.sanskrit: कर्तापि वा कारयितापि नाहं भोक्तापि वा भोजयितापि नाहम् । द्रष्टापि वा दर्शयितापि नाहं सोऽहं स्वयञ्ज्योतिरनीदृगात्मा
verses.transliteration: kartāpi vā kārayitāpi nāhaṃ bhoktāpi vā bhojayitāpi nāham | draṣṭāpi vā darśayitāpi nāhaṃ so'haṃ svayañjyotiranīdṛgātmā
verses.translation: I am neither doer nor causer of action; neither enjoyer nor causer of enjoyment; neither seer nor causer of seeing. I am that self-luminous, incomparable Self.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: I am neither doer nor causer of action; neither enjoyer nor causer of enjoyment; neither seer nor causer of seeing. I am that self-luminous, incomparable Self.।

verses.sanskrit: चलत्युपाधौ प्रतिबिम्बलौल्यमौपाधिकं मूढधियो नयन्ति । स्वबिम्बभूतं रविवद्विनिष्क्रियं कर्तास्मि भोक्तास्मि हतोऽस्मि हेति
verses.transliteration: calatyupādhau pratibimbalaulyamaupādhikaṃ mūḍhadhiyo nayanti | svabimbabhūtaṃ ravivadviniṣkriyaṃ kartāsmi bhoktāsmi hato'smi heti
verses.translation: When the adjunct moves, the deluded attribute the trembling of the reflection to the original, like the sun, which is actionless: "I am the doer, I am the enjoyer, alas, I am killed!"
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: When the adjunct moves, the deluded attribute the trembling of the reflection to the original, like the sun, which is actionless: "I am the doer, I am the enjoyer, alas, I am killed!।

verses.sanskrit: जले वापि स्थले वापि लुठत्वेष जडात्मकः । नाहं विलिप्ये तद्धर्मैर्घटधर्मैर्नभो यथा
verses.transliteration: jale vāpi sthale vāpi luṭhatveṣa jaḍātmakaḥ | nāhaṃ vilipye taddharmairghaṭadharmairnabho yathā
verses.translation: Whether in water or on land, let this inert (body) roll about; I am not touched by its properties, as space by the properties of a pot.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Whether in water or on land, let this inert (body) roll about; I am not touched by its properties, as space by the properties of a pot.।

verses.sanskrit: कर्तृत्वभोक्तृत्वखलत्वमत्तताजडत्वबद्धत्वविमुक्ततादयः । बुद्धेर्विकल्पा न तु सन्ति वस्तुतः स्वस्मिन्परे ब्रह्मणि केवलेऽद्वये
verses.transliteration: kartṛtvabhoktṛtvakhalatvamattatājaḍatvabaddhatvavimuktatādayaḥ | buddhervikalpā na tu santi vastutaḥ svasminpare brahmaṇi kevale'dvaye
verses.translation: Agency, enjoyment, wickedness, intoxication, dullness, bondage, liberation and the like are alternatives of the intellect; in truth they do not exist in the Supreme Brahman, alone, non-dual, one's own Self.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Agency, enjoyment, wickedness, intoxication, dullness, bondage, मोक्ष and the like are alternatives of बुद्धि; in truth they do not exist in परमेश्वर परब्रह्म, alone, अद्वैत, one's own Self.।

verses.sanskrit: सन्तु विकाराः प्रकृतेर्दशधा शतधा सहस्रधा वापि । किं मेऽसङ्गचितस्तैर्न घनः क्वचिदम्बरं स्पृशति
verses.transliteration: santu vikārāḥ prakṛterdaśadhā śatadhā sahasradhā vāpi | kiṃ me'saṅgacitastairna ghanaḥ kvacidambaraṃ spṛśati
verses.translation: Let the modifications of Nature be ten, a hundred, or a thousand; what are they to me, the unattached consciousness? Does a cloud ever touch the sky?
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Let the modifications of Nature be ten, a hundred, or a thousand; what are they to me, the unattached चैतन्य? Does a cloud ever touch the sky?।

verses.sanskrit: तैः किं मेऽसङ्गचितेर्न ह्यम्बुदडम्बरोऽम्बरं अव्यक्तादिस्थूलपर्यन्तमेतत् विश्वं यत्राभासमात्रं प्रतीतम् । व्योमप्रख्यं सूक्ष्ममाद्यन्तहीनं ब्रह्माद्वैतं यत्तदेवाहमस्मि
verses.transliteration: taiḥ kiṃ me'saṅgaciterna hyambudaḍambaro'mbaraṃ avyaktādisthūlaparyantametat viśvaṃ yatrābhāsamātraṃ pratītam | vyomaprakhyaṃ sūkṣmamādyantahīnaṃ brahmādvaitaṃ yattadevāhamasmi
verses.translation: That in which this universe, from the Unmanifest to the gross, is perceived as a mere appearance, which is like space, subtle, without beginning or end — non-dual Brahman — that I am.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: That in which this universe, from the Unmanifest to the gross, is perceived as a mere appearance, which is like space, subtle, without beginning or end — अद्वैत परब्रह्म — that I am.।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वाधारं सर्ववस्तुप्रकाशं सर्वाकारं सर्वगं सर्वशून्यम् । नित्यं शुद्धं निश्चलं निर्विकल्पं ब्रह्माद्वैतं यत्तदेवाहमस्मि
verses.transliteration: sarvādhāraṃ sarvavastuprakāśaṃ sarvākāraṃ sarvagaṃ sarvaśūnyam | nityaṃ śuddhaṃ niścalaṃ nirvikalpaṃ brahmādvaitaṃ yattadevāhamasmi
verses.translation: The support of all, the illuminator of all things, having all forms, all-pervading, empty of everything, eternal, pure, unmoving, free of alternatives — non-dual Brahman — that I am.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The support of all, the illuminator of all things, having all forms, all-pervading, empty of everything, नित्य, pure, unmoving, free of alternatives — अद्वैत परब्रह्म — that I am.।

verses.sanskrit: यत्प्रत्यस्ताशेषमायाविशेषं प्रत्यग्रूपं प्रत्ययागम्यमानम् । सत्यज्ञानानन्तमानन्दरूपं ब्रह्माद्वैतं यत्तदेवाहमस्मि
verses.transliteration: yatpratyastāśeṣamāyāviśeṣaṃ pratyagrūpaṃ pratyayāgamyamānam | satyajñānānantamānandarūpaṃ brahmādvaitaṃ yattadevāhamasmi
verses.translation: In which all special features of Maya have been set aside, the inner reality, not reached by perceptions, truth, knowledge, infinite, of the form of bliss — non-dual Brahman — that I am.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: In which all special features of Maya have been set aside, the inner reality, not reached by perceptions, truth, ज्ञान, infinite, of the form of आनंद — अद्वैत परब्रह्म — that I am.।

verses.sanskrit: निष्क्रियोऽस्म्यविकारोऽस्मि निष्कलोऽस्मि निराकृतिः । निर्विकल्पोऽस्मि नित्योऽस्मि निरालम्बोऽस्मि निर्द्वयः
verses.transliteration: niṣkriyo'smyavikāro'smi niṣkalo'smi nirākṛtiḥ | nirvikalpo'smi nityo'smi nirālambo'smi nirdvayaḥ
verses.translation: I am actionless, I am unchanging, I am without parts, I am formless; I am free of alternatives, I am eternal, I am without support, I am without a second.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: I am actionless, I am unchanging, I am without parts, I am formless; I am free of alternatives, I am नित्य, I am without support, I am without a second.।

verses.sanskrit: सर्वात्मकोऽहं सर्वोऽहं सर्वातीतोऽहमद्वयः । केवलाखण्डबोधोऽहमानन्दोऽहं निरन्तरः
verses.transliteration: sarvātmako'haṃ sarvo'haṃ sarvātīto'hamadvayaḥ | kevalākhaṇḍabodho'hamānando'haṃ nirantaraḥ
verses.translation: I am the Self of all, I am all, I am beyond all, I am non-dual; I am alone, undivided knowledge, I am bliss, unbroken.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: I am आत्मा of all, I am all, I am beyond all, I am अद्वैत; I am alone, undivided ज्ञान, I am आनंद, unbroken.।

verses.sanskrit: स्वाराज्यसाम्राज्यविभूतिरेषा भवत्कृपाश्रीमहिमप्रसादात् । प्राप्ता मया श्रीगुरवे महात्मने नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु पुनर्नमोऽस्तु
verses.transliteration: svārājyasāmrājyavibhūtireṣā bhavatkṛpāśrīmahimaprasādāt | prāptā mayā śrīgurave mahātmane namo namaste'stu punarnamo'stu
verses.translation: This glory of the empire of self-rule has been gained by me through the grace of your glorious greatness. To you, great-souled revered teacher, homage, homage, and again homage.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: This glory of the empire of self-rule has been gained by me through the grace of your glorious greatness. To you, great-souled revered teacher, homage, homage, and again homage.।

verses.sanskrit: महास्वप्ने मायाकृतजनिजरामृत्युगहने भ्रमन्तं क्लिश्यन्तं बहुलतरतापैरनुदिनम् । रनुकलम् अहङ्कारव्याघ्रव्यथितमिममत्यन्तकृपया प्रबोध्य प्रस्वापात्परमवितवान्मामसि गुरो
verses.transliteration: mahāsvapne māyākṛtajanijarāmṛtyugahane bhramantaṃ kliśyantaṃ bahulataratāpairanudinam | ranukalam ahaṅkāravyāghravyathitamimamatyantakṛpayā prabodhya prasvāpātparamavitavānmāmasi guro
verses.translation: "In the great dream, wandering in the forest of birth, old age and death made by Maya, daily tormented by heavy afflictions, and distressed by the tiger of egoism, you, O teacher, out of great compassion have awakened me from sleep and protected me."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: In the great dream, wandering in the forest of birth, old age and death made by Maya, daily tormented by heavy afflictions, and distressed by the tiger of egoism, you, O teacher, out of great compassion have awakened me from sleep and protected me.।

verses.sanskrit: नमस्तस्मै सदैकस्मै कस्मैचिन्महसे नमः । सदेकस्मै नमश्चिन्महसे मुहुः यदेतद्विश्वरूपेण राजते गुरुराज ते
verses.transliteration: namastasmai sadaikasmai kasmaicinmahase namaḥ | sadekasmai namaścinmahase muhuḥ yadetadviśvarūpeṇa rājate gururāja te
verses.translation: Homage to that One, ever one, to some (indescribable) radiance; homage again and again to the one radiance of consciousness, which shines forth in the form of this universe — O king of teachers, yours.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Homage to that One, ever one, to some (indescribable) radiance; homage again and again to the one radiance of चैतन्य, which shines forth in the form of this universe — O king of teachers, yours.।

verses.sanskrit: इति नतमवलोक्य शिष्यवर्यं समधिगतात्मसुखं प्रबुद्धतत्त्वम् । प्रमुदितहृदयं स देशिकेन्द्रः पुनरिदमाह वचः परं महात्मा
verses.transliteration: iti natamavalokya śiṣyavaryaṃ samadhigatātmasukhaṃ prabuddhatattvam | pramuditahṛdayaṃ sa deśikendraḥ punaridamāha vacaḥ paraṃ mahātmā
verses.translation: Thus seeing the excellent disciple bowing, who had reached the happiness of the Self and awakened to the truth, the great-souled lord of teachers, with a delighted heart, spoke again this excellent word.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Thus seeing the excellent disciple bowing, who had reached the happiness of आत्मा and awakened to the truth, the great-souled lord of teachers, with a delighted heart, spoke again this excellent word.।

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मप्रत्ययसन्ततिर्जगदतो ब्रह्मैव तत्सर्वतः पश्याध्यात्मदृशा प्रशान्तमनसा सर्वास्ववस्थास्वपि । रूपादन्यदवेक्षितं किमभितश्चक्षुष्मतां दृश्यते तद्वद्ब्रह्मविदः सतः किमपरं बुद्धेर्विहारास्पदम्
verses.transliteration: brahmapratyayasantatirjagadato brahmaiva tatsarvataḥ paśyādhyātmadṛśā praśāntamanasā sarvāsvavasthāsvapi | rūpādanyadavekṣitaṃ kimabhitaścakṣuṣmatāṃ dṛśyate tadvadbrahmavidaḥ sataḥ kimaparaṃ buddhervihārāspadam
verses.translation: "Therefore the world is a continuous stream of the thought of Brahman; see everything as Brahman alone, with the eye of the Self and a tranquil mind, in all states. What else is seen by people with eyes than form? So for the knower of Brahman, what else is there as a field for the mind's play?"
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Therefore the world is a continuous stream of the thought of परब्रह्म; see everything as परब्रह्म alone, with the eye of आत्मा and a tranquil mind, in all states. What else is seen by people with eyes than form? So for the knower of परब्रह्म, what else is there as a field for मन's play?।

verses.sanskrit: कस्तां परानन्दरसानुभूतिमृत्सृज्य शून्येषु रमेत विद्वान् । मुत्सृज्य चन्द्रे महाह्लादिनि दीप्यमाने चित्रेन्दुमालोकयितुं क इच्छेत्
verses.transliteration: kastāṃ parānandarasānubhūtimṛtsṛjya śūnyeṣu rameta vidvān | mutsṛjya candre mahāhlādini dīpyamāne citrendumālokayituṃ ka icchet
verses.translation: "Who, having tasted that experience of the taste of supreme bliss, would delight in empty things? When the moon, greatly delightful, is shining, who would wish to look at a painted moon?"
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Who, having tasted that experience of the taste of supreme आनंद, would delight in empty things? When the moon, greatly delightful, is shining, who would wish to look at a painted moon?।

verses.sanskrit: असत्पदार्थानुभवेन किञ्चिन् न ह्यस्ति तृप्तिर्न च दुःखहानिः । तदद्वयानन्दरसानुभूत्या तृप्तः सुखं तिष्ठ सदात्मनिष्ठया
verses.transliteration: asatpadārthānubhavena kiñcin na hyasti tṛptirna ca duḥkhahāniḥ | tadadvayānandarasānubhūtyā tṛptaḥ sukhaṃ tiṣṭha sadātmaniṣṭhayā
verses.translation: "By experiencing unreal things there is no contentment and no removal of sorrow; therefore, contented with the experience of the taste of non-dual bliss, remain happily in steadfastness in the real Self."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: By experiencing मिथ्या things there is no contentment and no removal of sorrow; therefore, contented with the experience of the taste of अद्वैत आनंद, remain happily in steadfastness in the सत्य Self.।

verses.sanskrit: स्वमेव सर्वथा पश्यन्मन्यमानः स्वमद्वयम् । सर्वतः स्वानन्दमनुभुञ्जानः कालं नय महामते
verses.transliteration: svameva sarvathā paśyanmanyamānaḥ svamadvayam | sarvataḥ svānandamanubhuñjānaḥ kālaṃ naya mahāmate
verses.translation: "Seeing only yourself in every way, thinking of yourself as non-dual, enjoying your own bliss everywhere — pass your time, O great-minded one."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Seeing only yourself in every way, thinking of yourself as अद्वैत, enjoying your own आनंद everywhere — pass your time, O great-minded one.।

verses.sanskrit: अखण्डबोधात्मनि निर्विकल्पे विकल्पनं व्योम्नि पुरप्रकल्पनम् । तदद्वयानन्दमयात्मना सदा शान्तिं परामेत्य भजस्व मौनम्
verses.transliteration: akhaṇḍabodhātmani nirvikalpe vikalpanaṃ vyomni puraprakalpanam | tadadvayānandamayātmanā sadā śāntiṃ parāmetya bhajasva maunam
verses.translation: "Imagining alternatives in the Self of undivided knowledge, free of alternatives, is like imagining a city in the sky; therefore, always in the non-dual form of bliss, having attained supreme peace, practise silence."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Imagining alternatives in आत्मा of undivided ज्ञान, free of alternatives, is like imagining a city in the sky; therefore, always in the अद्वैत form of आनंद, having attained supreme peace, practise silence.।

verses.sanskrit: तूष्णीमवस्था परमोपशान्तिः बुद्धेरसत्कल्पविकल्पहेतोः । ब्रह्मात्मनो ब्रह्मविदो महात्मनो यत्राद्वयानन्दसुखं निरन्तरम्
verses.transliteration: tūṣṇīmavasthā paramopaśāntiḥ buddherasatkalpavikalpahetoḥ | brahmātmano brahmavido mahātmano yatrādvayānandasukhaṃ nirantaram
verses.translation: "The state of silence is supreme calm, of the intellect that is the cause of imagined alternatives of the unreal; for the great soul, the knower of Brahman, the Self of Brahman, in whom is the bliss of non-dual happiness, unbroken."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The state of silence is supreme calm, of बुद्धि that is the cause of imagined alternatives of the मिथ्या; for the great soul, the knower of परब्रह्म, आत्मा of परब्रह्म, in whom is the आनंद of अद्वैत happiness, unbroken.।

verses.sanskrit: नास्ति निर्वासनान्मौनात्परं सुखकृदुत्तमम् । विज्ञातात्मस्वरूपस्य स्वानन्दरसपायिनः
verses.transliteration: nāsti nirvāsanānmaunātparaṃ sukhakṛduttamam | vijñātātmasvarūpasya svānandarasapāyinaḥ
verses.translation: "There is no higher happiness-giving state than silence free of habit-impressions, for one who has known the nature of the Self and drinks the taste of his own bliss."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: There is no higher happiness-giving state than silence free of habit-impressions, for one who has known the nature of आत्मा and drinks the taste of his own आनंद.।

verses.sanskrit: गच्छंस्तिष्ठन्नुपविशञ्छयानो वाऽन्यथापि वा । यथेच्छया वसेद्विद्वानात्मारामः सदा मुनिः
verses.transliteration: gacchaṃstiṣṭhannupaviśañchayāno vā'nyathāpi vā | yathecchayā vasedvidvānātmārāmaḥ sadā muniḥ
verses.translation: "Walking, standing, sitting, lying down, or in any other way, let the wise man live as he pleases, ever the sage delighting in the Self."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Walking, standing, sitting, lying down, or in any other way, let विद्वान्/ज्ञानी live as he pleases, ever the sage delighting in आत्मा.।

verses.sanskrit: न देशकालासनदिग्यमादिलक्ष्याद्यपेक्षाऽप्रतिबद्धवृत्तेः । प्रतिबद्ध संसिद्धतत्त्वस्य महात्मनोऽस्ति स्ववेदने का नियमाद्यवस्था
verses.transliteration: na deśakālāsanadigyamādilakṣyādyapekṣā'pratibaddhavṛtteḥ | pratibaddha saṃsiddhatattvasya mahātmano'sti svavedane kā niyamādyavasthā
verses.translation: "For the great soul who has perfected the truth, whose mind's activity is not bound by place, time, posture, direction, restraint and the like, or by a target and so on — what rule or condition is there for the knowledge of himself?"
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: For the great soul who has perfected the truth, whose mind's activity is not bound by place, time, posture, direction, restraint and the like, or by a target and so on — what rule or condition is there for the ज्ञान of himself?।

verses.sanskrit: घटोऽयमिति विज्ञातुं नियमः कोऽन्ववेक्षते । अपेक्ष्यते विना प्रमाणसुष्ठुत्वं यस्मिन्सति पदार्थधीः
verses.transliteration: ghaṭo'yamiti vijñātuṃ niyamaḥ ko'nvavekṣate | apekṣyate vinā pramāṇasuṣṭhutvaṃ yasminsati padārthadhīḥ
verses.translation: "For knowing 'this is a pot,' what rule is required? Only the soundness of the means of knowledge is needed, when it exists the perception of the thing arises."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: For knowing 'this is a pot,' what rule is required? Only the soundness of the means of ज्ञान is needed, when it exists the perception of the thing arises.।

verses.sanskrit: अयमात्मा नित्यसिद्धः प्रमाणे सति भासते । न देशं नापि वा कालं न शुद्धिं वाप्यपेक्षते
verses.transliteration: ayamātmā nityasiddhaḥ pramāṇe sati bhāsate | na deśaṃ nāpi vā kālaṃ na śuddhiṃ vāpyapekṣate
verses.translation: "This Self, eternally established, is revealed when the means of knowledge exists; it requires no place, no time, no purification."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: This Self, eternally established, is revealed when the means of ज्ञान exists; it requires no place, no time, no purification.।

verses.sanskrit: देवदत्तोऽहमित्येतद्विज्ञानं निरपेक्षकम् । तद्वद्ब्रह्मविदोऽप्यस्य ब्रह्माहमिति वेदनम्
verses.transliteration: devadatto'hamityetadvijñānaṃ nirapekṣakam | tadvadbrahmavido'pyasya brahmāhamiti vedanam
verses.translation: "The knowledge 'I am Devadatta' is independent of anything; so too is this knowledge 'I am Brahman' of the knower of Brahman."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The ज्ञान 'I am Devadatta' is independent of anything; so too is this ज्ञान 'I am परब्रह्म' of the knower of परब्रह्म.।

verses.sanskrit: भानुनेव जगत्सर्वं भासते यस्य तेजसा । अनात्मकमसत्तुच्छं किं नु तस्यावभासकम्
verses.transliteration: bhānuneva jagatsarvaṃ bhāsate yasya tejasā | anātmakamasattucchaṃ kiṃ nu tasyāvabhāsakam
verses.translation: "By whose light all this world shines, as by the sun — what could illumine that (Self), when the not-Self is unreal and worthless?"
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: By whose light all this world shines, as by the sun — what could illumine that (Self), when अनात्मा is मिथ्या and worthless?।

verses.sanskrit: वेदशास्त्रपुराणानि भूतानि सकलान्यपि । येनार्थवन्ति तं किन्नु विज्ञातारं प्रकाशयेत्
verses.transliteration: vedaśāstrapurāṇāni bhūtāni sakalānyapi | yenārthavanti taṃ kinnu vijñātāraṃ prakāśayet
verses.translation: "The Vedas, the scriptures, the Puranas and all beings are meaningful through Him; what could illumine that knower?"
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The Vedas, the scriptures, the Puranas and all beings are meaningful through Him; what could illumine that knower?।

verses.sanskrit: एष स्वयञ्ज्योतिरनन्तशक्तिः आत्माऽप्रमेयः सकलानुभूतिः । यमेव विज्ञाय विमुक्तबन्धो जयत्ययं ब्रह्मविदुत्तमोत्तमः
verses.transliteration: eṣa svayañjyotiranantaśaktiḥ ātmā'prameyaḥ sakalānubhūtiḥ | yameva vijñāya vimuktabandho jayatyayaṃ brahmaviduttamottamaḥ
verses.translation: "This self-luminous Self of infinite power, immeasurable, the experience of all — knowing whom alone one is freed from bondage — this best of the knowers of Brahman is victorious."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: This self-luminous Self of infinite power, immeasurable, the experience of all — knowing whom alone one is freed from bondage — this best of the knowers of परब्रह्म is victorious.।

verses.sanskrit: न खिद्यते नो विषयैः प्रमोदते न सज्जते नापि विरज्यते च । स्वस्मिन्सदा क्रीडति नन्दति स्वयं निरन्तरानन्दरसेन तृप्तः
verses.transliteration: na khidyate no viṣayaiḥ pramodate na sajjate nāpi virajyate ca | svasminsadā krīḍati nandati svayaṃ nirantarānandarasena tṛptaḥ
verses.translation: "He is neither distressed nor delighted by objects, neither attached nor averse; he plays always in himself, rejoicing, satisfied with the taste of unbroken bliss."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: He is neither distressed nor delighted by objects, neither attached nor averse; he plays always in himself, rejoicing, satisfied with the taste of unbroken आनंद.।

verses.sanskrit: क्षुधां देहव्यथां त्यक्त्वा बालः क्रीडति वस्तुनिः । वस्तुनि तथैव विद्वान् रमते निर्ममो निरहं सुखी
verses.transliteration: kṣudhāṃ dehavyathāṃ tyaktvā bālaḥ krīḍati vastuniḥ | vastuni tathaiva vidvān ramate nirmamo nirahaṃ sukhī
verses.translation: "As a child forgets hunger and bodily pain and plays with a toy, so the wise man, free of possessiveness and ego, is happy and delights (in the Self)."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: As a child forgets hunger and bodily pain and plays with a toy, so विद्वान्/ज्ञानी, free of possessiveness and ego, is happy and delights (in आत्मा).।

verses.sanskrit: चिन्ताशून्यमदैन्यभैक्षमशनं पानं सरिद्वारिषु स्वातन्त्र्येण निरङ्कुशा स्थितिरभीर्निद्रा श्मशाने वने । वस्त्रं क्षालनशोषणादिरहितं दिग्वास्तु शय्या मही सञ्चारो निगमान्तवीथिषु विदां क्रीडा परे ब्रह्मणि
verses.transliteration: cintāśūnyamadainyabhaikṣamaśanaṃ pānaṃ saridvāriṣu svātantryeṇa niraṅkuśā sthitirabhīrnidrā śmaśāne vane | vastraṃ kṣālanaśoṣaṇādirahitaṃ digvāstu śayyā mahī sañcāro nigamāntavīthiṣu vidāṃ krīḍā pare brahmaṇi
verses.translation: "Free from worry, alms without humiliation as food, water from rivers to drink, an unhindered life in independence, fearless sleep in a cemetery or forest, clothes needing no washing or drying, the quarters for dress, the earth for bed, wandering along the paths of the Vedanta — the play of the knowers in the Supreme Brahman."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: से रहित worry, alms without humiliation as food, water from rivers to drink, an unhindered life in independence, fearless sleep in a cemetery or forest, clothes needing no washing or drying, the quarters for dress, the earth for bed, wandering along the paths of the Vedanta — the play of the knowers in परमेश्वर परब्रह्म.।

verses.sanskrit: विमानमालम्ब्य शरीरमेतद् भुनक्त्यशेषान्विषयानुपस्थितान् । परेच्छया बालवदात्मवेत्ता योऽव्यक्तलिङ्गोऽननुषक्तबाह्यः
verses.transliteration: vimānamālambya śarīrametad bhunaktyaśeṣānviṣayānupasthitān | parecchayā bālavadātmavettā yo'vyaktaliṅgo'nanuṣaktabāhyaḥ
verses.translation: "Using this body as a vehicle, he enjoys all the objects that come, at the will of others, like a child — the knower of the Self, whose marks are hidden and whose outward life is unattached."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Using this body as a vehicle, he enjoys all the objects that come, at the will of others, like a child — the knower of आत्मा, whose marks are hidden and whose outward life is unattached.।

verses.sanskrit: दिगम्बरो वापि च साम्बरो वा त्वगम्बरो वापि चिदम्बरस्थः । उन्मत्तवद्वापि च बालवद्वा पिशाचवद्वापि चरत्यवन्याम्
verses.transliteration: digambaro vāpi ca sāmbaro vā tvagambaro vāpi cidambarasthaḥ | unmattavadvāpi ca bālavadvā piśācavadvāpi caratyavanyām
verses.translation: "Whether naked or clothed, or wearing skin, or dwelling in the garment of consciousness, he moves on the earth like a madman, or like a child, or like a ghoul."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Whether naked or clothed, or wearing skin, or dwelling in the garment of चैतन्य, he moves on the earth like a madman, or like a child, or like a ghoul.।

verses.sanskrit: कामान्निष्कामरूपी संश्चरत्येकचरो मुनिः । कामान्नी कामरूपी स्वात्मनैव सदा तुष्टः स्वयं सर्वात्मना स्थितः
verses.transliteration: kāmānniṣkāmarūpī saṃścaratyekacaro muniḥ | kāmānnī kāmarūpī svātmanaiva sadā tuṣṭaḥ svayaṃ sarvātmanā sthitaḥ
verses.translation: "The sage wanders alone, without desire though seeming to desire; always contented in himself, himself established as the Self of all."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The sage wanders alone, without desire though seeming to desire; always contented in himself, himself established as आत्मा of all.।

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिन्मूढो विद्वान् क्वचिदपि महाराजविभवः क्वचिद्भ्रान्तः सौम्यः क्वचिदजगराचारकलितः । क्वचित्पात्रीभूतः क्वचिदवमतः क्वाप्यविदितः चरत्येवं प्राज्ञः सततपरमानन्दसुखितः
verses.transliteration: kvacinmūḍho vidvān kvacidapi mahārājavibhavaḥ kvacidbhrāntaḥ saumyaḥ kvacidajagarācārakalitaḥ | kvacitpātrībhūtaḥ kvacidavamataḥ kvāpyaviditaḥ caratyevaṃ prājñaḥ satataparamānandasukhitaḥ
verses.translation: "Sometimes a fool, sometimes a sage, sometimes with the splendour of a great king, sometimes wandering, sometimes gentle, sometimes behaving like a python, sometimes honoured, sometimes despised, sometimes unknown — thus the wise man moves, ever happy with supreme bliss."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Sometimes a fool, sometimes a sage, sometimes with the splendour of a great king, sometimes wandering, sometimes gentle, sometimes behaving like a python, sometimes honoured, sometimes despised, sometimes unknown — thus विद्वान्/ज्ञानी moves, ever happy with supreme आनंद.।

verses.sanskrit: निर्धनोऽपि सदा तुष्टोऽप्यसहायो महाबलः । नित्यतृप्तोऽप्यभुञ्जानोऽप्यसमः समदर्शनः
verses.transliteration: nirdhano'pi sadā tuṣṭo'pyasahāyo mahābalaḥ | nityatṛpto'pyabhuñjāno'pyasamaḥ samadarśanaḥ
verses.translation: "Though without wealth, always contented; though without help, very strong; though not eating, always satisfied; though without equal, seeing all alike."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Though without wealth, always contented; though without help, very strong; though not eating, always satisfied; though without equal, seeing all alike.।

verses.sanskrit: अपि कुर्वन्नकुर्वाणश्चाभोक्ता फलभोग्यपि । शरीर्यप्यशरीर्येष परिच्छिन्नोऽपि सर्वगः
verses.transliteration: api kurvannakurvāṇaścābhoktā phalabhogyapi | śarīryapyaśarīryeṣa paricchinno'pi sarvagaḥ
verses.translation: "Though acting, not acting; though enjoying fruits, not an enjoyer; though embodied, bodiless; though limited, all-pervading."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Though acting, not acting; though enjoying fruits, not an enjoyer; though embodied, bodiless; though limited, all-pervading.।

verses.sanskrit: अशरीरं सदा सन्तमिमं ब्रह्मविदं क्वचित् । प्रियाप्रिये न स्पृशतस्तथैव च शुभाशुभे
verses.transliteration: aśarīraṃ sadā santamimaṃ brahmavidaṃ kvacit | priyāpriye na spṛśatastathaiva ca śubhāśubhe
verses.translation: "Neither the pleasant nor the unpleasant, neither the good nor the evil, ever touches this knower of Brahman, who is always without a body."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Neither the pleasant nor the unpleasant, neither the good nor the evil, ever touches this knower of परब्रह्म, who is always without a body.।

verses.sanskrit: स्थूलादिसम्बन्धवतोऽभिमानिनः सुखं च दुःखं च शुभाशुभे च । विध्वस्तबन्धस्य सदात्मनो मुनेः कुतः शुभं वाऽप्यशुभं फलं वा
verses.transliteration: sthūlādisambandhavato'bhimāninaḥ sukhaṃ ca duḥkhaṃ ca śubhāśubhe ca | vidhvastabandhasya sadātmano muneḥ kutaḥ śubhaṃ vā'pyaśubhaṃ phalaṃ vā
verses.translation: "For the proud one who is connected with the gross body and the like, there are happiness and sorrow, good and evil; but for the sage whose bonds are destroyed, the real Self, whence good or evil, or their fruit?"
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: For the proud one who is connected with the gross body and the like, there are happiness and sorrow, good and evil; but for the sage whose bonds are destroyed, the सत्य Self, whence good or evil, or their fruit?।

verses.sanskrit: तमसा ग्रस्तवद्भानादग्रस्तोऽपि रविर्जनैः । ग्रस्त इत्युच्यते भ्रान्त्यां ह्यज्ञात्वा वस्तुलक्षणम्
verses.transliteration: tamasā grastavadbhānādagrasto'pi ravirjanaiḥ | grasta ityucyate bhrāntyāṃ hyajñātvā vastulakṣaṇam
verses.translation: "As the sun, though not swallowed, is said by people to be swallowed (in an eclipse) through delusion, being ignorant of the nature of the thing —"
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: As the sun, though not swallowed, is said by people to be swallowed (in an eclipse) through मोह/भ्रम, being ignorant of the nature of the thing —।

verses.sanskrit: भ्रान्त्या तद्वद्देहादिबन्धेभ्यो विमुक्तं ब्रह्मवित्तमम् । पश्यन्ति देहिवन्मूढाः शरीराभासदर्शनात्
verses.transliteration: bhrāntyā tadvaddehādibandhebhyo vimuktaṃ brahmavittamam | paśyanti dehivanmūḍhāḥ śarīrābhāsadarśanāt
verses.translation: "so the fools, seeing the appearance of a body, through delusion see the best of the knowers of Brahman, though free of the bonds of body and the like, as if embodied."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: so the fools, seeing the appearance of a body, through मोह/भ्रम see the best of the knowers of परब्रह्म, though free of the bonds of body and the like, as if embodied.।

verses.sanskrit: अहिर्निर्ल्वयनीं वायं मुक्त्वा देहं तु तिष्ठति । अहिनि इतस्ततश्चाल्यमानो यत्किञ्चित्प्राणवायुना
verses.transliteration: ahirnirlvayanīṃ vāyaṃ muktvā dehaṃ tu tiṣṭhati | ahini itastataścālyamāno yatkiñcitprāṇavāyunā
verses.translation: "A snake, having cast off its sloughed skin, stays apart from it, moved here and there by the wind; (so the knower's body is moved by the breath)."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: A snake, having cast off its sloughed skin, stays apart from it, moved here and there by the wind; (so the knower's body is moved by the breath).।

verses.sanskrit: स्त्रोतसा नीयते दारु यथा निम्नोन्नतस्थलम् । दैवेन नीयते देहो यथाकालोपभुक्तिषु
verses.transliteration: strotasā nīyate dāru yathā nimnonnatasthalam | daivena nīyate deho yathākālopabhuktiṣu
verses.translation: "As a log is carried by the current to low or high ground, so the body is carried by fate to its enjoyments, at the proper times."
verses.hindi: जैसे रस्सी के ज्ञान से सर्प का भ्रम नष्ट हो जाता है, वैसे ही आत्म-ज्ञान से यह संपूर्ण दृश्य प्रपंच विलीन हो जाता है।

verses.sanskrit: प्रारब्धकर्मपरिकल्पितवासनाभिः संसारिवच्चरति भुक्तिषु मुक्तदेहः । सिद्धः स्वयं वसति साक्षिवदत्र तूष्णीं चक्रस्य मूलमिव कल्पविकल्पशून्यः
verses.transliteration: prārabdhakarmaparikalpitavāsanābhiḥ saṃsārivaccarati bhuktiṣu muktadehaḥ | siddhaḥ svayaṃ vasati sākṣivadatra tūṣṇīṃ cakrasya mūlamiva kalpavikalpaśūnyaḥ
verses.translation: "With the habit-impressions shaped by prarabdha karma, the one whose body is free acts in enjoyments like a worldly person; the perfected one himself dwells here as a witness, silent, like the hub of a wheel, free of alternatives and imaginings."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: With the habit-impressions shaped by prarabdha karma, the one whose body is free acts in enjoyments like a worldly person; the perfected one himself dwells here as a witness, silent, like the hub of a wheel, free of alternatives and imaginings.।

verses.sanskrit: नैवेन्द्रियाणि विषयेषु नियुङ्क्त एष नैवापयुङ्क्त उपदर्शनलक्षणस्थः । नैव क्रियाफलमपीषदवेक्षते स स्वानन्दसान्द्ररसपानसुमत्तचित्तः
verses.transliteration: naivendriyāṇi viṣayeṣu niyuṅkta eṣa naivāpayuṅkta upadarśanalakṣaṇasthaḥ | naiva kriyāphalamapīṣadavekṣate sa svānandasāndrarasapānasumattacittaḥ
verses.translation: "He neither directs the senses to objects nor withdraws them, standing as a mere spectator; nor does he look even slightly for the fruit of action, his mind intoxicated with drinking the thick taste of his own bliss."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: He neither directs इन्द्रियाँ to objects nor withdraws them, standing as a mere spectator; nor does he look even slightly for the fruit of action, his mind intoxicated with drinking the thick taste of his own आनंद.।

verses.sanskrit: लक्ष्यालक्ष्यगतिं त्यक्त्वा यस्तिष्ठेत्केवलात्मना । शिव एव स्वयं साक्षादयं ब्रह्मविदुत्तमः
verses.transliteration: lakṣyālakṣyagatiṃ tyaktvā yastiṣṭhetkevalātmanā | śiva eva svayaṃ sākṣādayaṃ brahmaviduttamaḥ
verses.translation: "He who, giving up the path of the seen and the unseen, stays as the Self alone — that best of the knowers of Brahman is himself directly Shiva."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: He who, giving up the path of the seen and the unseen, stays as आत्मा alone — that best of the knowers of परब्रह्म is himself directly Shiva.।

verses.sanskrit: जीवन्नेव सदा मुक्तः कृतार्थो ब्रह्मवित्तमः । उपाधिनाशाद्ब्रह्मैव सन् ब्रह्माप्येति निर्द्वयम्
verses.transliteration: jīvanneva sadā muktaḥ kṛtārtho brahmavittamaḥ | upādhināśādbrahmaiva san brahmāpyeti nirdvayam
verses.translation: "The best of the knowers of Brahman is always liberated even while living, his purpose fulfilled; on the destruction of the adjunct, being Brahman, he merges into the non-dual Brahman."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The best of the knowers of परब्रह्म is always liberated even while living, his purpose fulfilled; on the नाश the adjunct, being परब्रह्म, he merges into the अद्वैत परब्रह्म.।

verses.sanskrit: शैलूषो वेषसद्भावाभावयोश्च यथा पुमान् । तथैव ब्रह्मविच्छ्रेष्ठः सदा ब्रह्मैव नापरः
verses.transliteration: śailūṣo veṣasadbhāvābhāvayośca yathā pumān | tathaiva brahmavicchreṣṭhaḥ sadā brahmaiva nāparaḥ
verses.translation: "As an actor is the same whether he has his costume on or off, so the best of the knowers of Brahman is always Brahman alone, nothing else."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: As an actor is the same whether he has his costume on or off, so the best of the knowers of परब्रह्म is always परब्रह्म alone, nothing else.।

verses.sanskrit: यत्र क्वापि विशीर्णं सत्पर्णमिव तरोर्वपुः पततात् । विशीर्णं पर्णमिव ब्रह्मीभूतस्य यतेः प्रागेव तच्चिदग्निना दग्धम्
verses.transliteration: yatra kvāpi viśīrṇaṃ satparṇamiva tarorvapuḥ patatāt | viśīrṇaṃ parṇamiva brahmībhūtasya yateḥ prāgeva taccidagninā dagdham
verses.translation: "Wherever this body falls, like a withered leaf of a tree, for the ascetic who has become Brahman, it was burned before by the fire of consciousness."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Wherever this body falls, like a withered leaf of a tree, for the ascetic who has become परब्रह्म, it was burned before by the fire of चैतन्य.।

verses.sanskrit: सदात्मनि ब्रह्मणि तिष्ठतो मुनेः पूर्णाऽद्वयानन्दमयात्मना सदा । न देशकालाद्युचितप्रतीक्षा त्वङ्मांसविट्पिण्डविसर्जनाय
verses.transliteration: sadātmani brahmaṇi tiṣṭhato muneḥ pūrṇā'dvayānandamayātmanā sadā | na deśakālādyucitapratīkṣā tvaṅmāṃsaviṭpiṇḍavisarjanāya
verses.translation: "For the sage established in the real Self, Brahman, always in the nature of full, non-dual bliss, there is no waiting for a suitable place or time for laying down this heap of skin, flesh and filth."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: For the sage established in the सत्य Self, परब्रह्म, always in the nature of full, अद्वैत आनंद, there is no waiting for a suitable place or time for laying down this heap of skin, flesh and filth.।

verses.sanskrit: देहस्य मोक्षो नो मोक्षो न दण्डस्य कमण्डलोः । अविद्याहृदयग्रन्थिमोक्षो मोक्षो यतस्ततः
verses.transliteration: dehasya mokṣo no mokṣo na daṇḍasya kamaṇḍaloḥ | avidyāhṛdayagranthimokṣo mokṣo yatastataḥ
verses.translation: "The release of the body is not liberation, nor is that of the staff and water-pot; the release of the knot of ignorance in the heart is liberation, from which (all follows)."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The release of शरीर/देह is not मोक्ष, nor is that of the staff and water-pot; the release of the knot of अविद्या/अज्ञान in the heart is मोक्ष, from which (all follows).।

verses.sanskrit: कुल्यायामथ नद्यां वा शिवक्षेत्रेऽपि चत्वरे । पर्णं पतति चेत्तेन तरोः किं नु शुभाशुभम्
verses.transliteration: kulyāyāmatha nadyāṃ vā śivakṣetre'pi catvare | parṇaṃ patati cettena taroḥ kiṃ nu śubhāśubham
verses.translation: "If a leaf falls in a ditch, or a river, or a holy place, or a crossroads — what good or bad is that to the tree?"
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: If a leaf falls in a ditch, or a river, or a holy place, or a crossroads — what good or bad is that to the tree?।

verses.sanskrit: पत्रस्य पुष्पस्य फलस्य नाशवद्देहेन्द्रियप्राणधियां विनाशः । नैवात्मनः स्वस्य सदात्मकस्यानन्दाकृतेर्वृक्षवदस्ति चैषः
verses.transliteration: patrasya puṣpasya phalasya nāśavaddehendriyaprāṇadhiyāṃ vināśaḥ | naivātmanaḥ svasya sadātmakasyānandākṛtervṛkṣavadasti caiṣaḥ
verses.translation: "The destruction of body, senses, breath and mind is like the destruction of a leaf, flower or fruit; it is not that of the Self, whose nature is being and bliss, for this does not hold for it as for a tree."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The नाश body, senses, breath and mind is like the नाश a leaf, flower or fruit; it is not that of आत्मा, whose nature is being and आनंद, for this does not hold for it as for a tree.।

verses.sanskrit: वदास्त एषः प्रज्ञानघन इत्यात्मलक्षणं सत्यसूचकम् । अनूद्यौपाधिकस्यैव कथयन्ति विनाशनम्
verses.transliteration: vadāsta eṣaḥ prajñānaghana ityātmalakṣaṇaṃ satyasūcakam | anūdyaupādhikasyaiva kathayanti vināśanam
verses.translation: "'This is a mass of knowledge' — this indication of the Self, pointing to the truth, is repeated and used to speak of the destruction of the adjunct-bound (self) only."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: 'This is a mass of ज्ञान' — this indication of आत्मा, pointing to the truth, is repeated and used to speak of the नाश the adjunct-bound (self) only.।

verses.sanskrit: अविनाशी वा अरेऽयमात्मेति श्रुतिरात्मनः । प्रब्रवीत्यविनाशित्वं विनश्यत्सु विकारिषु
verses.transliteration: avināśī vā are'yamātmeti śrutirātmanaḥ | prabravītyavināśitvaṃ vinaśyatsu vikāriṣu
verses.translation: "'Indeed, this Self is imperishable,' says scripture, teaching the imperishability of the Self amid perishing, changing things."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: 'Indeed, this Self is imperishable,' says scripture, teaching the imperishability of आत्मा amid perishing, changing things.।

verses.sanskrit: पाषाणवृक्षतृणधान्यकडङ्कराद्या दग्धा भवन्ति हि मृदेव यथा तथैव । देहेन्द्रियासुमन आदि समस्तदृश्यं ज्ञानाग्निदग्धमुपयाति परात्मभावम्
verses.transliteration: pāṣāṇavṛkṣatṛṇadhānyakaḍaṅkarādyā dagdhā bhavanti hi mṛdeva yathā tathaiva | dehendriyāsumana ādi samastadṛśyaṃ jñānāgnidagdhamupayāti parātmabhāvam
verses.translation: "As stones, trees, grass, grain, husks and the like, when burned, become only earth, so the whole visible world — body, senses, breath, mind and the rest — burned by the fire of knowledge, goes to the state of the Supreme Self."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: As stones, trees, grass, grain, husks and the like, when burned, become only earth, so the whole visible world — body, senses, breath, mind and the rest — burned by the fire of ज्ञान, goes to the state of परमात्मा.।

verses.sanskrit: विलक्षणं यथा ध्वान्तं लीयते भानुतेजसि । तथैव सकलं दृश्यं ब्रह्मणि प्रविलीयते
verses.transliteration: vilakṣaṇaṃ yathā dhvāntaṃ līyate bhānutejasi | tathaiva sakalaṃ dṛśyaṃ brahmaṇi pravilīyate
verses.translation: "As darkness, being of a different nature, dissolves in the light of the sun, so the whole visible world dissolves in Brahman."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: As darkness, being of a different nature, dissolves in the light of the sun, so the whole visible world dissolves in परब्रह्म.।

verses.sanskrit: घटे नष्टे यथा व्योम व्योमैव भवति स्फुटम् । तथैवोपाधिविलये ब्रह्मैव ब्रह्मवित्स्वयम्
verses.transliteration: ghaṭe naṣṭe yathā vyoma vyomaiva bhavati sphuṭam | tathaivopādhivilaye brahmaiva brahmavitsvayam
verses.translation: "When a pot is destroyed, the space (in it) clearly becomes space; so, on the dissolution of the adjunct, the knower of Brahman himself is Brahman."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: When a pot is destroyed, the space (in it) clearly becomes space; so, on the dissolution of the adjunct, the knower of परब्रह्म himself is परब्रह्म.।

verses.sanskrit: क्षीरं क्षीरे यथा क्षिप्तं तैलं तैले जलं जले । संयुक्तमेकतां याति तथाऽऽत्मन्यात्मविन्मुनिः
verses.transliteration: kṣīraṃ kṣīre yathā kṣiptaṃ tailaṃ taile jalaṃ jale | saṃyuktamekatāṃ yāti tathā''tmanyātmavinmuniḥ
verses.translation: "As milk poured into milk, oil into oil, water into water becomes one, so the sage who knows the Self (becomes one) in the Self."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: As milk poured into milk, oil into oil, water into water becomes one, so the sage who knows आत्मा (becomes one) in आत्मा.।

verses.sanskrit: एवं विदेहकैवल्यं सन्मात्रत्वमखण्डितम् । ब्रह्मभावं प्रपद्यैष यतिर्नावर्तते पुनः
verses.transliteration: evaṃ videhakaivalyaṃ sanmātratvamakhaṇḍitam | brahmabhāvaṃ prapadyaiṣa yatirnāvartate punaḥ
verses.translation: "Thus, having reached bodiless isolation, undivided being, and the state of Brahman, this ascetic does not return again."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Thus, having reached bodiless isolation, undivided being, and the state of परब्रह्म, this ascetic does not return again.।

verses.sanskrit: सदात्मैकत्वविज्ञानदग्धाविद्यादिवर्ष्मणः । अमुष्य ब्रह्मभूतत्वाद् ब्रह्मणः कुत उद्भवः
verses.transliteration: sadātmaikatvavijñānadagdhāvidyādivarṣmaṇaḥ | amuṣya brahmabhūtatvād brahmaṇaḥ kuta udbhavaḥ
verses.translation: "For him whose ignorance and the rest that make up the body have been burned by the knowledge of oneness with the real Self, being Brahman already, how can there be any birth from Brahman?"
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: For him whose अविद्या/अज्ञान and the rest that make up शरीर/देह have been burned by the ज्ञान of oneness with the सत्य Self, being परब्रह्म already, how can there be any birth from परब्रह्म?।

verses.sanskrit: मायाक्लृप्तौ बन्धमोक्षौ न स्तः स्वात्मनि वस्तुतः । यथा रज्जौ निष्क्रियायां सर्पाभासविनिर्गमौ
verses.transliteration: māyāklṛptau bandhamokṣau na staḥ svātmani vastutaḥ | yathā rajjau niṣkriyāyāṃ sarpābhāsavinirgamau
verses.translation: "Bondage and liberation made by Maya do not really exist in one's own Self, as the appearance and disappearance of a snake do not exist in a motionless rope."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Bondage and मोक्ष made by Maya do not really exist in one's own Self, as the appearance and disappearance of a snake do not exist in a motionless rope.।

verses.sanskrit: आवृतेः सदसत्त्वाभ्यां वक्तव्ये बन्धमोक्षणे । नावृतिर्ब्रह्मणः काचिदन्याभावादनावृतम् । यद्यस्त्यद्वैतहानिः स्याद् द्वैतं नो सहते श्रुतिः
verses.transliteration: āvṛteḥ sadasattvābhyāṃ vaktavye bandhamokṣaṇe | nāvṛtirbrahmaṇaḥ kācidanyābhāvādanāvṛtam | yadyastyadvaitahāniḥ syād dvaitaṃ no sahate śrutiḥ
verses.translation: "Bondage and release would have to be spoken of in terms of the covering, as existent or non-existent; but there is no covering of Brahman, since there is nothing else; if there were, non-duality would be lost, and scripture does not tolerate duality."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Bondage and release would have to be spoken of in terms of the covering, as existent or non-existent; but there is no covering of परब्रह्म, since there is nothing else; if there were, non-duality would be lost, and scripture does not tolerate duality.।

verses.sanskrit: बन्धञ्च मोक्षञ्च मृषैव मूढा बुद्धेर्गुणं वस्तुनि कल्पयन्ति । दृगावृतिं मेघकृतां यथा रवौ यतोऽद्वयाऽसङ्गचिदेतदक्षरम्
verses.transliteration: bandhañca mokṣañca mṛṣaiva mūḍhā buddherguṇaṃ vastuni kalpayanti | dṛgāvṛtiṃ meghakṛtāṃ yathā ravau yato'dvayā'saṅgacidetadakṣaram
