verses.translation: "The deluded falsely attribute bondage and liberation, qualities of the intellect, to the Reality, like the covering of the eye by a cloud attributed to the sun; for this Imperishable is consciousness, non-dual and unattached."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The deluded falsely attribute bondage and मोक्ष, qualities of बुद्धि, to परमतत्त्व, like the covering of the eye by a cloud attributed to the sun; for this Imperishable is चैतन्य, अद्वैत and unattached.।

verses.sanskrit: चिदेकमक्षरम् अस्तीति प्रत्ययो यश्च यश्च नास्तीति वस्तुनि । बुद्धेरेव गुणावेतौ न तु नित्यस्य वस्तुनः
verses.transliteration: cidekamakṣaram astīti pratyayo yaśca yaśca nāstīti vastuni | buddhereva guṇāvetau na tu nityasya vastunaḥ
verses.translation: "The notions 'it exists' and 'it does not exist' about the Reality are only qualities of the intellect, not of the eternal Reality."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: The notions 'it exists' and 'it does not exist' about परमतत्त्व are only qualities of बुद्धि, not of the नित्य Reality.।

verses.sanskrit: अतस्तौ मायया क्लृप्तौ बन्धमोक्षौ न चात्मनि । निष्कले निष्क्रिये शान्ते निरवद्ये निरञ्जने । अद्वितीये परे तत्त्वे व्योमवत्कल्पना कुतः
verses.transliteration: atastau māyayā klṛptau bandhamokṣau na cātmani | niṣkale niṣkriye śānte niravadye nirañjane | advitīye pare tattve vyomavatkalpanā kutaḥ
verses.translation: "Therefore bondage and liberation are imagined by Maya and do not belong to the Self. In the Supreme Truth, without parts, actionless, tranquil, blameless, stainless, without a second — how can there be imagination, as of space?"
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Therefore bondage and मोक्ष are imagined by Maya and do not belong to आत्मा. In परमेश्वर Truth, without parts, actionless, tranquil, blameless, stainless, without a second — how can there be imagination, as of space?।

verses.sanskrit: न निरोधो न चोत्पत्तिर्न बद्धो न च साधकः । न मुमुक्षुर्न वै मुक्त इत्येषा परमार्थता
verses.transliteration: na nirodho na cotpattirna baddho na ca sādhakaḥ | na mumukṣurna vai mukta ityeṣā paramārthatā
verses.translation: "There is no dissolution and no origin, no bound one and no aspirant, no seeker of liberation and no liberated one: this is the ultimate truth."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: There is no dissolution and no origin, no bound one and no aspirant, no seeker of मोक्ष and no liberated one: this is the ultimate truth.।

verses.sanskrit: सकलनिगमचूडास्वान्तसिद्धान्तरूपं परमिदमतिगुह्यं दर्शितं ते मयाद्य । अपगतकलिदोषं कामनिर्मुक्तबुद्धिं स्वसुतवदसकृत्त्वां भावयित्वा मुमुक्षुम्
verses.transliteration: sakalanigamacūḍāsvāntasiddhāntarūpaṃ paramidamatiguhyaṃ darśitaṃ te mayādya | apagatakalidoṣaṃ kāmanirmuktabuddhiṃ svasutavadasakṛttvāṃ bhāvayitvā mumukṣum
verses.translation: "This supreme, most secret teaching, the essence of the inner conclusion of the crest of all the Vedas (the Upanishads), has been shown to you today by me — to you, who are free of the faults of the Kali age, whose mind is free from desire, and whom I have repeatedly regarded as a seeker of liberation like my own son."
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: This supreme, most secret teaching, the essence of the inner conclusion of the crest of all the Vedas (the Upanishads), has been shown to you today by me — to you, who are free of the faults of the Kali age, whose mind is से रहित desire, and whom I have repeatedly regarded as a seeker of मोक्ष like my own son.।

verses.sanskrit: इति श्रुत्वा गुरोर्वाक्यं प्रश्रयेण कृतानतिः । स तेन समनुज्ञातो ययौ निर्मुक्तबन्धनः
verses.transliteration: iti śrutvā gurorvākyaṃ praśrayeṇa kṛtānatiḥ | sa tena samanujñāto yayau nirmuktabandhanaḥ
verses.translation: Having thus heard the words of the teacher, bowing with humility, and permitted by him, he went, freed from bondage.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Having thus heard the words of सद्गुरु, bowing with humility, and permitted by him, he went, freed from bondage.।

verses.sanskrit: गुरुरेव सदानन्दसिन्धौ निर्मग्नमानसः । गुरुरेष पावयन्वसुधां सर्वां विचचार निरन्तरः
verses.transliteration: gurureva sadānandasindhau nirmagnamānasaḥ | gurureṣa pāvayanvasudhāṃ sarvāṃ vicacāra nirantaraḥ
verses.translation: The teacher himself, his mind immersed in the ocean of ever-lasting bliss, roamed the whole earth, purifying it, without interruption.
verses.hindi: जो इस संसार के मार्ग में ताप से पीड़ित हैं और शांति की खोज में हैं, उनके लिए यह विवेकचूडामणि परमानंद-रूपी अमृत का सरोवर सिद्ध हो।

verses.sanskrit: इत्याचार्यस्य शिष्यस्य संवादेनात्मलक्षणम् । निरूपितं मुमुक्षूणां सुखबोधोपपत्तये
verses.transliteration: ityācāryasya śiṣyasya saṃvādenātmalakṣaṇam | nirūpitaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ sukhabodhopapattaye
verses.translation: Thus, through the dialogue of the teacher and the disciple, the nature of the Self has been set forth, for the easy understanding of seekers of liberation.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Thus, through the dialogue of सद्गुरु and शिष्य, the nature of आत्मा has been set forth, for the easy understanding of seekers of मोक्ष.।

verses.sanskrit: हितमिदमुपदेशमाद्रियन्तां विहितनिरस्तसमस्तचित्तदोषाः । भवसुखविरताः प्रशान्तचित्ताः श्रुतिरसिका यतयो मुमुक्षवो ये
verses.transliteration: hitamidamupadeśamādriyantāṃ vihitanirastasamastacittadoṣāḥ | bhavasukhaviratāḥ praśāntacittāḥ śrutirasikā yatayo mumukṣavo ye
verses.translation: Let those ascetics who are seekers of liberation, free of all faults of mind that have been prescribed and removed, weary of worldly pleasures, tranquil of mind and fond of the essence of the scriptures, welcome this wholesome teaching.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: Let those ascetics who are seekers of मोक्ष, free of all faults of mind that have been prescribed and removed, weary of worldly pleasures, tranquil of mind and fond of the essence of the scriptures, welcome this wholesome teaching.।

verses.sanskrit: संसाराध्वनि तापभानुकिरणप्रोद्भूतदाहव्यथाखिन्नानां जलकाङ्क्षया मरुभुवि भ्रान्त्या परिभ्राम्यताम् । अत्यासन्नसुधाम्बुधिं सुखकरं ब्रह्माद्वयं दर्शयत्येषा शङ्करभारती विजयते निर्वाणसन्दायिनी
verses.transliteration: saṃsārādhvani tāpabhānukiraṇaprodbhūtadāhavyathākhinnānāṃ jalakāṅkṣayā marubhuvi bhrāntyā paribhrāmyatām | atyāsannasudhāmbudhiṃ sukhakaraṃ brahmādvayaṃ darśayatyeṣā śaṅkarabhāratī vijayate nirvāṇasandāyinī
verses.translation: For those wearied by the burning pain arising from the rays of the sun of affliction on the path of worldly existence, who wander in delusion in a desert seeking water — this speech of Shankara points out to them Brahman, the non-dual, the giver of happiness, the sea of nectar very near at hand; may it be victorious, the bestower of liberation.
verses.hindi: आत्मा और परब्रह्म के यथार्थ विवेक से: For those wearied by the burning pain arising from the rays of the sun of affliction on the path of संसार, who wander in मोह/भ्रम in a desert seeking water — this speech of Shankara points out to them परब्रह्म, the अद्वैत, the giver of happiness, the sea of nectar very near at hand; may it be victorious, the bestower of मोक्ष.।
